items.english_text: Unto Thee I direct all my heart and mind, and all love of both soul and body, unto my Creator and Deliverer, O Sovereign Three-Sun Light; and I cry unto Thee: Save me Thy servant from tribulations and all afflictions!

items.slavonic_text: гнⷭ҇а гдⷭ҇а, по́йте и҆ превозноситѐ є҆го̀ вовѣ́ки .
items.english_text: Exalt our mind and thought unto Thee on high, and illumine us with Thy most pure radiance, O Father, Word, and Comforter, Who dwellest in unapproachable light, O Sun and light-holding Lord of glory: that we may ever glorify Thee, the one Principle, the tri-hypostatic God.

items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆разли́чныхъ мѧ̀ страсте́й тр҃це нераз
items.english_text: One Light in three Hypostases, distinguished in Persons: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, by Whom all creation subsists; Who descending renewed it, and rose on the third day.

items.slavonic_text: дѣ́лнаѧ, є҆ди́нице несли́тнаѧ, ѡ҆мраче́
items.english_text: Save those that believe in Thee, O Lord, and proclaim Thine unoriginate, eternal, single essence, and the three God-originating and con-formable Persons of Thy Lordship; and make them worthy of divine glory, through the supplications of the pure Mother of God.

items.slavonic_text: Сп҃сѝ втѧ̀ вѣ́рꙋющыѧ гдⷭ҇и, и҆ проповѣ́
items.english_text: *At Matins, at "God is the Lord", the Resurrection Troparion, Tone 4:*

items.slavonic_text: дающыѧ безнача́лно прⷭ҇но сꙋ́щество є҆ди́
items.english_text: Having learned the radiant proclamation of the Resurrection from the angel, and having cast off the ancestral condemnation, the women disciples of the Lord boasting said unto the apostles: Death is overthrown, and Christ God is risen, granting great mercy unto the world![^86]

items.slavonic_text: но, три́ же ли́ца бг҃онача́лна и҆ соѡ́бразна
items.english_text: *Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, both now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.*

items.slavonic_text: твое́го гдⷭ҇ствїа . и҆ бж҃тве́ннѣй сла́вѣ
items.english_text: The mystery hidden from the ages and unknown unto angels, through thee, O Mother of God, was manifested unto those on earth: God incarnate in unconfused union, Who voluntarily accepted the Cross for our sake; and having raised up the first-fashioned man, He saved our souls from death.

items.slavonic_text: сподо́би, мольба́ми чтⷭ҇ыѧ бг҃ома́тере .
items.english_text: *After the First Kathisma, Resurrection Sessional Hymn, Tone 4:*

items.slavonic_text: На ѻ҆́ꙋтрни, на Бг҃ъ Гдⷭ҇ь . Тр҃о, воскрⷭ҇нъ . Гла́съ, д҃ .
items.english_text: Beholding the entrance of the tomb and unable to endure the angelic flame, the myrrh-bearing women marvelled in trembling, saying: Was He stolen away, Who opened paradise unto the thief? Or is He risen, Who before His passion proclaimed resurrection? Truly Christ is risen, granting life and resurrection unto those in Hades!

items.slavonic_text: Свѣ́тлꙋю воскрⷭ҇нїѧ проповѣ́дь, ѿ а҆́гг҃ла
items.english_text: *Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, both now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.*

items.slavonic_text: оу҆вѣ́дѣвше гн҃ѧ оу҆чн҃ца . и҆ пра́дѣднее
items.english_text: Thee we magnify, O Mother of God, crying aloud: Thou art the mountain from which the stone was cut without hands, and which crushed the gates of Hades.

items.slavonic_text: ѡ҆сꙋжде́нїе ѿве́ргъше, а҆пл҃ѡмъ хвалѧ́
items.english_text: *After the Second Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 4:*

items.slavonic_text: щеесѧ гла́хꙋ . и҆спрове́ржесѧ сме́рть и҆ во
items.english_text: Of Thine own will didst Thou endure crucifixion, O Savior, and mortal men laid Thee in a new tomb, Who by Word didst establish the ends of the earth; therefore was the stranger bound, and death was grievously despoiled; and those in Hades all cried out unto Thy life-bearing resurrection: Christ the Giver of life is risen, abiding unto all ages!

items.slavonic_text: а҆́дѣ всѝ взыва́хꙋ, живоно́сному воста́нїю
items.english_text: *Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, both now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.*

items.slavonic_text: твое́му . х҃с воскр҃се жизнода́вецъ пребы
items.english_text: Joseph was amazed, beholding that which was beyond nature, and considered in mind the dew upon the fleece in thy seedless conception, O Mother of God: the bush unburnt by fire, the rod of Aaron that budded; and bearing witness as thy betrothed and guardian, he cried aloud unto the priests: A Virgin gives birth, and after childbirth remains Virgin again![^87]

items.slavonic_text: ва́ѧй вовѣ́ки . Сла́ва, и҆ Нн҃ѣ, Бг҃о .
items.english_text: Forestalling the dawn of Thy most glorious resurrection, the myrrh-bearing women proclaimed unto the apostles that Christ is risen as God, granting great mercy unto the world.

items.slavonic_text: Оу҆диви́сѧ Ἰ҆ѡ́сифъ, па́че є҆стестве́нное
items.english_text: *The Gradual Hymns (Anabathmoi), Tone 4. Antiphon 1:*

items.slavonic_text: зрѧ̀, и҆ внима́ше мы́слїю рꙋно́внаго до
items.english_text: From my youth many passions war against me; but do Thou Thyself defend and save me, O my Savior.

items.slavonic_text: ждѧ̀, вобезсѣ́меннѣмъ зача́тїи твое́мъ
items.english_text: Ye that hate Zion, be put to shame before the Lord; for as grass by fire shall ye be dried up.

items.slavonic_text: бц҃е . кꙋпи́нꙋ ѻ҆гне́мъ неѡпали́мꙋ, же́злъ
items.english_text: By the Holy Spirit every soul is quickened, and by purity exalted, illuminated by the Trinitarian Unity in sacred mystery.

items.slavonic_text: А҆аро́новъ прозѧ́бшїй . и҆ свидѣ́телствꙋ
items.english_text: I have cried unto Thee fervently, O Lord, from the depths of my soul; let Thy divine ears be attentive unto me.

items.slavonic_text: етъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ѡ҆брꙋ́чникъ тво́й и҆ храни́тель .
items.english_text: Whosoever has acquired hope in the Lord is higher than all who grieve.

items.slavonic_text: сщ҃е́нникѡмъ вопїѧ́ше, дв҃а ражда́етъ,
items.english_text: By the Holy Spirit stream forth the waters of grace, watering all creation unto revitalization.

items.slavonic_text: и҆ поржⷭ҇твѣ̀ па́ки дв҃ою пребыва́етъ .
items.english_text: Let my heart be lifted up unto Thee, O Word, and let none of the world's allurements beguile me unto weakness.

items.slavonic_text: Срⷭ҇це моѐ ктебѣ̀ сло́ве да вознесе́тсѧ .
items.english_text: As one has love toward his mother, with warmer affection are we indebted to love the Lord.[^88]

items.slavonic_text: и҆ ничто́же да неоу҆слади́тъ ми́ сѧ ѿ мі́р
items.english_text: By the Holy Spirit is the wealth of divine knowledge, contemplation, and wisdom; for in Him the Word reveals all the Father's decrees.

items.slavonic_text: Кма́тери свое́й ꙗ҆́кѡже и҆́матъ кто̀ лю
items.english_text: *Prokeimenon, Tone 4:* Arise, O Lord, help us, and redeem us for Thy name's sake. *Verse:* O God, with our ears have we heard. *Let every breath praise the Lord. Verse:* Praise God in His saints. *The Gospel.*

items.slavonic_text: бо́, кгдⷭ҇у теплѣ́е люблені́емъ до́лжни є҆смы̀ .
items.english_text: *Canon of the Resurrection, Tone 4. Ode 1. Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: Ст҃ы́мъ дх҃омъ бг҃осло́вїа бога́тство,
items.english_text: Traversing the depth of the Red Sea of old with dry feet, Israel, by the cross-wise stretched hands of Moses, overcame the power of Amalek in the wilderness.

items.slavonic_text: бг҃овидѣ́нїа и҆ премꙋ́дрости . всѧ̑ бо въто́мъ
items.english_text: Thou wast lifted up upon the most pure wood of the Cross, setting right our fall, healing the ancient murder, O Master, as good and all-powerful.

items.slavonic_text: Проки́менъ, Гла́съ д҃ . Воскрⷭ҇нѝ Гдⷭ҇и помозѝ на́мъ .
items.english_text: In the tomb bodily, in Hades with Thy soul as God, in Paradise with the thief, and on the throne wast Thou, O Christ, with the Father and the Spirit, filling all things, Thyself uncircumscribed.

items.slavonic_text: Ст҃хъ, Бж҃е оу҆ши́ма на́шима оу҆слы́шахомъ . Всѧ́ко
items.english_text: Without seed, by the Father's will, from the divine Spirit of God thou didst conceive the Son, and in the flesh gavest birth unto Him Who from the Father was without mother, and for our sake from thee without father.

items.slavonic_text: дыха́нїе . Ст҃хъ . Хвали́те Бг҃а во ст҃ы́хъ є҆гѡ̀ . є҆ѵ,
items.english_text: *Another Canon, of the Cross and Resurrection, Tone 4. Ode 1. Heirmos: I shall open my mouth:*

items.slavonic_text: Кано́нъ Воскре́сенъ, Гла́съ д҃ . Пѣ́снь а҃ І҆рмо́съ .
items.english_text: Healing the brokenness of mankind, O Lord, by this Thy divine blood Thou didst renew it, and didst shatter the one strong in might who of old had shattered Thy creation.

items.slavonic_text: [Инициал 'М'] Мо́рѧ чермна́го пꙋчи́нꙋ, немо́крыми
items.english_text: Resurrection came unto the dead by reason of His putting to death; for power was taken away from death, which became food unto eternal life, when God, Who rules over all, became incarnate.

items.slavonic_text: нїю . бра́шна сожи́тїю вѣ́чнои, и҆́же всѣ́
items.english_text: Fair and exalted above the heavenly hosts was thy divine ensouled temple, O Virgin, when in thy womb thou didst carry the holy mountain of our God.[^89]

items.slavonic_text: ми влⷣчествꙋющꙋ воплоще́номꙋ бг҃ꙋ . Бг҃о .
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Most Holy Mother of God, the same Tone. Heirmos: The captains:*

items.slavonic_text: Кра́сенъ превы́шши нены́хъ си́лъ, бж҃е
items.english_text: The peoples were shaken, the nations were troubled, and mighty kingdoms yielded, O pure one, from awe at thy childbearing; for my King came, cast down the tormentor, and delivered the world from corruption.

items.slavonic_text: ственны тво́й бы́сть хра́мъ ѡ҆дꙋшевленый .
items.english_text: Descending unto men, O Christ, Who dwellest on high, Thou didst sanctify Thine abode and showed it forth unshaken; for after childbirth the only Virgin vessel preserved the Creator Whom she bare.

items.slavonic_text: вооу҆тро́бѣ носи́вши дв҃о, го́рꙋ ст҃ꙋю бг҃а на́[шего] .
items.english_text: Thy church rejoices in Thee, O Christ, crying aloud: Thou art my strength, O Lord, my refuge and my firm support!

items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ Кано́нъ прⷭ҇тѣ́й Бц҃и, гла́съ то́йже, І҆рмо́ . Триста́тыщѧ .
items.english_text: The living tree, the true noetic vine, hangs upon the wood, pouring forth incorruption unto all.

items.slavonic_text: Сотрѧсо́шасѧ лю́дїе, смꙋти́шасѧ ꙗ҆зы́
items.english_text: How great, how awesome! He cast down the arrogance of Hades, and as incorruptible God is now risen bodily from the tomb.

items.slavonic_text: цы . црⷭ҇твїа держа́внаѧ оу҆клони́шасѧ
items.english_text: Thou alone upon earth wast made the mediatress of blessings beyond nature, Mother of God; therefore do we cry unto thee: Rejoice!

items.slavonic_text: чтⷭ҇аѧ, ѿ стра́ха ржⷭ҇тва твоего̀ . прїи́де бо цр҃ь
items.english_text: *Another Canon (of the Cross and Resurrection). Ode 3. Heirmos: Thy singers:*

items.slavonic_text: мо́й, низложѝ мꙋчи́телѧ, и҆ мі́ръ ѿ тлѧ̀ и҆зба́ви .
items.english_text: The serpent plunged his venom-filled fangs into me, O Savior; but Thou, O Almighty Lord, didst shatter them with the nails of Thy hands; for there is none holy among the saints save Thee, O Lord.

items.slavonic_text: Жили́ще своѐ живы́й ввы́шнихъ, кчл҃кѡ[мъ]
items.english_text: Thou wast seen voluntarily in the tomb, O Lover of mankind, dead yet life-giving, and didst burst open the gates of Hades for the souls bound from the ages; for there is none holy among the saints save Thee, O Lord.

items.slavonic_text: соше́дъ ѡ҆ст҃ѝ х҃е, и҆ непоколеби́мо ꙗ҆вѝ,
items.english_text: Thou wast shown forth as the unplowed furrow, having brought forth the living ear of wheat, the mediator of immortality unto all who partake of Him Who rests as Holy among the saints.

items.slavonic_text: Неѡ́ранаѧ бра́зда ꙗ҆ви́ласѧ є҆сѝ, кла́съ жи
items.english_text: *Another Canon (to the Theotokos). Ode 3. Heirmos: He Who is on high:*

items.slavonic_text: во́тный ро́ждши . и҆́же всѣ́мъ причаща́ю
items.english_text: The essence of earthly mortals is purified, having conversed with the unendurable divine fire; for mystically, O all-pure Virgin, within thee was the Bread baked by Him Who preserved thee unharmed.[^90]

items.slavonic_text: щымсѧ безсме́ртїа хода́та . и҆́же вост҃ы́хъ
items.english_text: Who is this who truly is close unto God, having surpassed the angelic ranks, shining alone through the beauty of maidenhood as the Mother of the Almighty?

items.slavonic_text: ст҃го почива́ющаго . И҆́нъ І҆рмо́ . Свы́шнихъ .
items.english_text: *Canon of the Resurrection. Ode 4. Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆чища́етсѧ земны́хъ сꙋ́щество, бесѣ́
items.english_text: Beholding Thee, the Sun of righteousness, lifted up upon the Cross, the church stood in her order, worthily crying aloud: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.slavonic_text: ѻ҆гню̀ . ꙗ҆́кѡ вта́инѣ пречтⷭ҇аѧ дв҃о, вте
items.english_text: Having tasted of the sinless and life-creating body of Thine, death was worthily put to death, O Master; and we cry aloud unto Thee: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.slavonic_text: бѣ̀ хлѣ́бъ и҆спекши́сѧ, є҆́же и҆ тебѐ невре
items.english_text: Thou didst come healing my passions, when Thy most pure flesh, wherein Thou wast willingly clothed, suffered upon the Cross; therefore we cry unto Thee: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.slavonic_text: Что́ сїѧ̀ ꙗ҆́же вои́стиннꙋ бли́зъ бг҃а, ꙗ҆́кѡ
items.english_text: Without knowing wedlock didst thou give birth, O Virgin, and after childbirth wast shown forth still a Virgin; therefore with frail voices, with undoubting faith, we cry unto thee: Rejoice, O Sovereign Lady!

items.slavonic_text: превозше́дши а҆́гг҃лскїѧ чи́новы . є҆ди́на
items.english_text: *Another Canon (of the Cross and Resurrection). Ode 4. Heirmos: Unto the inscrutable divine counsel:*

items.slavonic_text: доброто́ю дѣ́тства, ꙗ҆́кѡ мт҃и сїѧ́юще все
items.english_text: The lawful Israel did not recognize Thee, O Christ, the God Who gave the Law; but as lawless, transgressing the law, unworthy of the legislation, nailed Thee to the Cross.

items.slavonic_text: [Инициал 'В'] Воздви́женна тѧ̀ ви́дѣвши цр҃кви,
items.english_text: Thy deified soul, O Savior, despoiled the treasuries of Hades and raised the souls bound from the ages; and Thy life-bearing body poured forth incorruption unto all.

items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆бже́на твоѧ̀ сп҃се дш҃а, а҆́дова сокро́ви
items.english_text: Thee, the truly ever-virgin, the only Mother of God, do we glorify: whom Moses prefigured in the bush that was mingled with fire unconsumed, O most pure one.[^91]

items.slavonic_text: ща плѣни́вши, ꙗ҆́же ѿвѣ́ка воздви́же
items.english_text: *Another Canon (to the Theotokos). Ode 4. The same Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: дш҃ѧ: живоно́сное же тѣ́ло, всѣ́мъ не
items.english_text: Bearing our corruption, the Invisible One became visible, being in the fullness of invisible Godhead, and taking form from thee, O Virgin, to save from the alien one those who know thee as the pure Mother of God.

items.slavonic_text: Тебѐ прⷭ҇но дв҃ꙋ вои́стиннꙋ, є҆ди́нꙋ бц҃у сла́
items.english_text: Materially the Virgin received the Immaterial One in the midst of matter, become an Infant from her; therefore is He now known in two natures: God bearing flesh, and an earthly mortal above nature.

items.slavonic_text: вимъ: и҆́же проѡ́бразоваше вгоби́нцꙋ
items.english_text: He Who took up His abode in thee, a virgin, after childbirth remained Word and God, born without seed; and in childbirth He preserved thee a Virgin, as Master and Creator.

items.slavonic_text: мѡѷсе́и, неѡпа́лно прчⷭ҇таѧ кꙋпина̀ ѻ҆гню̀
items.english_text: *Canon of the Resurrection. Ode 5. Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: Но́жнаѧ сотлѣ́нїѧ, ви́димъ бы́сть неви́ди
items.english_text: Thou, my Lord, art a light come into the world: a holy light turning those that hymn Thee in faith from the darkness of ignorance.

items.slavonic_text: мый, возра́стѣ сы́й неви́димаго бж҃тва̀,
items.english_text: Thou, O Lord, didst mercifully descend unto the earth; Thou didst raise up fallen human nature when Thou wast lifted up upon the tree.

items.slavonic_text: и҆ воѡ́бразсѧ нетебѐ дв҃о, ѿчужда́го сп҃стѝ
items.english_text: Thou didst take away from me, O Christ, the condemnation of transgressions; Thou didst dissolve the pangs of death, O Compassionate One, by Thy divine resurrection.

items.slavonic_text: вѣ́дащихъ тѧ̀ чтⷭ҇ꙋю, бг҃ороди́тельницꙋ .
items.english_text: Thee we set forth as an invincible weapon against enemies; thee have we acquired as the confirmation and hope of our salvation, O Bride of God.

items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ І҆рмо́съ . Оу҆диви́шасѧ всѧ́ческаѧ .
items.english_text: *Another Canon (of the Cross and Resurrection). Ode 5. Heirmos: All things were amazed:*

items.slavonic_text: Прїѧ́тъ тѧ̀ всего̀ оу҆сты̀ а҆́дъ безꙋ́мный:
items.english_text: Senseless Hades received Thee wholly into his mouth; for beholding Thee nailed to the Cross and pierced with a spear, lifeless, the living God, he deemed Thee mere man; yet he recognized Thee when he experienced the might of Thy Godhead.[^92]

items.slavonic_text: на крⷭ҇тѣ бо пригвожде́нна тѧ̀ видѣ́въ,
items.english_text: The tomb and Hades shared the destroyed temple of Thy body, O Lover of mankind; unwillingly both were despoiled: the one sending back the souls of Thy saints, and the other their bodies, O Immortal One.

items.slavonic_text: копїе́мъ прободе́на, бездыха́нїа жива́го
items.english_text: Behold, now is fulfilled the prophetic utterance; for thou, unwedded Virgin, didst receive in thy womb God Who is over all, and gavest birth unto the timeless Son, Who grants peace unto all who hymn thee.

items.slavonic_text: бг҃а, про́ста вмѣнѧ́ше чл҃ка: разꙋмѣ́
items.english_text: *Another Canon (to the Theotokos). Ode 5. Heirmos: Now will I arise prophetically:*

items.slavonic_text: же, и҆скꙋси́въ крѣ́пость твое́го бж҃тва̀ .
items.english_text: A house of glory and a holy mountain of God, O pure one; a bride, a bridal chamber, a temple of sanctification: in thee the Son of God made His dwelling, and made for us an everlasting paradise of delight.

items.slavonic_text: Разоре́нꙋ чл҃колюбче цр҃ковь твое́го тѣ
items.english_text: Flesh from virgin blood didst Thou receive, O Christ: seedless, most pure and substantial, endowed with reason, mind, and soul, active, willing, self-governing, and free.

items.slavonic_text: лесе, гро́бъ раздѣлѝ, и҆ а҆́дъ: нево́лею ѻ҆́ба
items.english_text: The virginal womb put to shame the understanding of the tyrants; for as an Infant He explored with His hand the soul-destroying hole of the asp, and casting down the proud apostate, made him a footstool for the faithful.

items.slavonic_text: лѣ́тїе и҆стѧза́етсѧ . ѡ҆́въ оу҆́бѡ ст҃ы́хъ
items.english_text: *Canon of the Resurrection. Ode 6. Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: твои́хъ дш҃ѧ, телеса́ же дрꙋгі́й со́возы
items.english_text: I will sacrifice unto Thee with the voice of praise, O Lord, the church cries out unto Thee, having been cleansed from the blood of demons by the blood that flowed in mercy from Thy side.

items.slavonic_text: Се́ нн҃ѣ и҆спо́лнися пррⷦ҇ческое прорече́нїе:
items.english_text: Thou didst ascend upon the Cross, girded with power, and wrestling with the tormentor, as God Thou didst cast that adversary down from the heights; and by Thine unconquerable power Thou didst raise up Adam.

items.slavonic_text: Возше́лъ є҆сѝ на крⷭ҇тъ, си́лою препоѧ́сасѧ,
items.english_text: Risen radiant and fair from the tomb, O Christ, Thou didst scatter all enemies by divine power, and as God filled all things with gladness.[^93]

items.slavonic_text: и҆ сплете́ся мꙋчи́телемъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ бг҃ъ с высо
items.english_text: O wonder newest of all wonders! For the Virgin in her womb received without knowing man Him Who upholds all things by His word, and contained Him without constriction.

items.slavonic_text: ты̀ того̀ све́рже . а҆да́ма же непобѣди́мою
items.english_text: *Another Canon (of the Cross and Resurrection). Ode 6. Heirmos: We traversed the depths of the sea:*

items.slavonic_text: Воскре́съ блиста́ѧ кра́сно и҆з̾гро́ба хрⷭ҇те:
items.english_text: Hades opened his gullet and dilated it, senseless one, and swallowed down me and my soul; but Thou, O Christ, descending, didst raise up my life, as the Lover of mankind.

items.slavonic_text: и҆ разгна́лъ є҆сѝ всѧ̑ врагѝ бж҃твенною си́лою .
items.english_text: Death perished by death; for He Who died is risen, granting me incorruption; and appearing unto the women, He proclaimed immortal joy.

items.slavonic_text: и҆ всѧ̑ ꙗ҆́кѡ бг҃ъ весе́лїа и҆спо́лнивъ . Бг҃о .
items.english_text: A tranquil haven of unendurable Godhead was shown forth in thy pure womb, O Mother of God, which without fear the heavenly hosts cannot behold.

items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ чꙋ́до и҆́же всѣ́хъ чꙋде́съ новѣ́йшее . ꙗ҆́кѡ
items.english_text: *Another Canon (to the Theotokos). Ode 6. The same Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: дв҃а вооу҆тро́бѣ, и҆́же всѧ́ческаѧ содержа́
items.english_text: Of old the serpent beguiled and slew me because of my foremother Eve; but now, O pure one, He Who created me recalled me from incorruption for thy sake.

items.slavonic_text: щаго сло́вомъ, неискꙋсомꙋ́жно прїе́мши,
items.english_text: The abyss of ineffable loving-kindness, O Maiden, showed thee forth as an abyss chosen for miracles; for from thee, with the lightning of the Godhead, shone forth the pearl, Christ.

items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ І҆рмо́съ . Прейдо́хомъ вогльбенны морскіѧ ,
items.english_text: *Canon of the Resurrection. Ode 7. Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: слове́нъ є҆сѝ вце́ркви сла́вы твое́ѧ гдⷭ҇и .
items.english_text: In the Persian furnace, the Abrahamic children, rather burned by love of true piety than by the flame, cried aloud: Blessed art Thou in the temple of Thy glory, O Lord! blessed art Thou in the temple of Thy glory, O Lord.[^94]

items.slavonic_text: Къ нетлѣ́нїю чл҃чество возведе́но бы́сть,
items.english_text: Mankind was led back unto incorruption, washed by the divine Blood of Christ, as we thankfully hymn: Blessed art Thou in the temple of Thy glory, O Lord.

items.slavonic_text: бж҃твенною и҆змове́но кро́вїю х҃вою . бл҃го
items.english_text: As life-bearing, as truly fairer than paradise, and brighter than any royal bridal chamber, was Thy tomb revealed, O Christ, the fountain of our resurrection.

items.slavonic_text: да́рно воспѣва́юще, бл҃гве́нъ є҆сѝ вце́ркви
items.english_text: Rejoice, O sanctified, divine dwelling-place of the Most High! For through thee joy is given unto those who cry unto thee, O Theotokos: Blessed art thou among women, O all-immaculate Sovereign Lady.

items.slavonic_text: [Инициал 'Ꙗ'] Ꙗ҆́кѡ живоно́сецъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ ра́ѧ краснѣ́йши
items.english_text: *Canon of the Cross and Resurrection. Another Heirmos: Disobedient...:*

items.slavonic_text: вои́стиннꙋ, и҆ черто́га всѧ́каго црⷭ҇ска ,
items.english_text: Being lifted up upon the Wood, Thou didst humble the lofty eye, casting down exalted pride unto the earth; and Thou didst save man, O praised God of our fathers: Blessed art Thou!

items.slavonic_text: ꙗ҆ви́сѧ свѣтлѣ́йши х҃е гро́бъ тво́й, и҆
items.english_text: By Thy power, O Christ, Who didst rise from the dead, exalt the horn of us who serve Thee, and exhaust the wealth of the deceiver of many men, O praised God of our fathers: Blessed art Thou!

items.slavonic_text: сто́чникъ на́шемꙋ воскресе́нїю . Бг҃о .
items.english_text: Following the divine utterances, we glorify the one Godhead as in three lights, unmingled, indivisible, and as one flame: O praised God of our fathers: Blessed art Thou!

items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнѧго ѡ҆сщ҃енно бж҃їе селе́нїе, ра́дꙋй
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos. Another Heirmos: The three youths...:*

items.slavonic_text: сѧ: тебе́ бо ра́ди дае́тьсѧ ра́дость бц҃е во
items.english_text: Virginal love draws me unto hymning, and the fire has stirred me up to cry aloud unto the Mother and Virgin: Blessed art thou, the Lord of hosts is with thee!

items.slavonic_text: пїю́щимъ тѝ . бл҃гве́нна ты̀ вжена́хъ пре
items.english_text: Thou art higher than all creatures, since thou didst bear the Creator and Lord; therefore do I cry unto thee, O Theotokos: Blessed art thou, the Lord of hosts is with thee!

items.slavonic_text: непоро́чнаѧ блчⷢ҇це . И҆́нъ . І҆рмо́ . Непослꙋ́шн .
items.english_text: I revere one Lordship in three hypostases, indivisible, and I sing the tri-hypostatic Nature:

items.slavonic_text: бл҃гве́нъ є҆сѝ гдⷭ҇и бж҃е ѿц҃ъ на́шихъ .
items.english_text: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers![^95]

items.slavonic_text: Рꙋ́цѣ распросте́ръ Данїи́лъ, лвѡ́ва зна́
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos: Spreading out his hands, Daniel:*

items.slavonic_text: нїа вро́вѣ затчѐ . ѡ҆́гненꙋю же си́лꙋ оу҆га
items.english_text: Spreading out his hands, Daniel shut the lions' gaping mouths in the pit; and, girded with virtue, the youths, lovers of piety, quenched the power of the fire, crying aloud: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

items.slavonic_text: си́ша, добродѣ́телїю препоѧ́савшесѧ, и҆́же
items.english_text: Spreading out Thy hands upon the Cross, Thou didst gather all nations unto Thyself; and Thou didst show forth one Church, O Master, hymning Thee, as earthly and heavenly beings sing in harmony: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing and exalt Him above all unto all ages!

items.slavonic_text: бл҃гоче́стїа люби́тели ѿро́ци . взыва́ю
items.english_text: Appearing white-robed unto the women, radiant with unapproachable light, the Angel of the Resurrection cried aloud: Why seek ye the living among the dead? In truth Christ is risen! Unto Whom we cry: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing and exalt Him above all unto all ages!

items.slavonic_text: ще, бл҃ги́те всѧ̑каѧ дѣ́ла гнⷭ҇ѧ гдⷭ҇а .
items.english_text: Thou alone among all generations, O most pure Virgin, wast revealed as Mother unto God; thou becamest the dwelling of the Godhead, O all-immaculate one, unconsumed by the fire of unapproachable Light. Therefore do we all bless thee, O Mary, Bride of God.

items.slavonic_text: [Инициал 'Р'] Рꙋ́цѣ распросте́ръ на крⷭ҇тѣ, ꙗ҆зы́ки всѧ̑
items.english_text: *Canon of the Cross and Resurrection. Another Heirmos: The pious youths in the furnace...:*

items.slavonic_text: ксебѣ̀ собра̀ . и҆ є҆ди́нꙋ ꙗ҆ви́лъ є҆сѝ вл҃ко цр҃ковь
items.english_text: Beholding Thine unjust slaughter, creation was darkened and wept; for while the earth was shaken, the sun was clothed in darkness as in a dark mantle; yet we hymn Thee, O Christ, and exalt Thee above all unto all ages.

items.slavonic_text: воспѣва́ющи тѧ̀, зе́мнымъ и҆ нб҃нымъ,
items.english_text: Having descended with me even unto Hades, Thou didst make the Resurrection a pathway for all; and Thou didst ascend again, bearing me upon Thy shoulders, and didst bring me unto the Father. Therefore I cry unto Thee: Hymn the Lord, all ye works, and exalt Him above all unto all ages!

items.slavonic_text: ва́йте дѣ́ла, и҆ превозноси́те є҆го̀ вовѣ́ки . Тр҃о .
items.english_text: Proclaiming Thee as the primal Mind and the Cause of all, the only uncaused God of all, the unoriginate Begetter of the Word, and the Projector of the Spirit, and the Creator of all: we bow down before the harmonious Trinity and exalt Thee above all unto all ages.[^96]

items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆у҆ма̀ пе́рваго и҆ вино́внаго всѣ̑мъ, бг҃а
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos. Another Heirmos: Redeemer of all...:*

items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́наго непови́нна всѣ́ми . сло́вꙋ тѧ̀ про
items.english_text: He Who fashioned thee from the rib of Adam, the Cause of all, is incarnate of thy virginity; hymning Whom, we cry aloud: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing and exalt Him above all unto all ages!

items.slavonic_text: повѣ́дающе безна́чална роди́телѧ, и҆ пре
items.english_text: In shadow Abraham beheld the mystery concerning thee, O Theotokos; for he received Thy bodiless Son, singing: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing and exalt Him above all unto all ages!

items.slavonic_text: ложи́телѧ дх҃ꙋ, и҆ содѣ́телѧ всѣ̑мъ тр҃ци
items.english_text: O Savior, the youths prefigured the virginity of Thy equal-numbered Trinity; for with virginal body they trampled the flame, crying: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing and exalt Him above all unto all ages!

items.slavonic_text: согла́снѣй покланѧ́емсѧ, и҆ превозно́сим
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos: A stone cut without hands:*

items.slavonic_text: вовсѧ̑ вѣ́ки . И҆́нъ І҆рмо́ . И҆зба́вителю всѣ́хъ .
items.english_text: A cornerstone was cut without hands from an uncut mountain, even from thee, O Virgin: Christ, Who joined together the parted natures; therefore rejoicing, we magnify thee, O Theotokos.

items.slavonic_text: Ѿребра̀ А҆да́мова созда́выи тѧ̀, ѿтвое́
items.english_text: Wholly taking all of me unto Himself in unmingled union, granting me total salvation, O my God, through Thy Passion which Thou didst endure bodily upon the Cross out of the bowels of Thy compassion, O Christ.

items.slavonic_text: го дѣ́вства воплоща́етсѧ, и҆́же всѣ́хъ ви
items.english_text: Beholding Thy tomb opened, and the God-bearing burial-linens [Plashchanytsia] made empty by Thy resurrection, Thy disciples said with the Angel: In truth the Lord is risen!

items.slavonic_text: вои́стиннꙋ воста̀ гдⷭ҇ь . Тро́иченъ .
items.english_text: All we faithful praise the unity of the divine essence, yet the Trinity in Hypostases, in unconfused Persons: the Father supremely unoriginate, the Son, and the all-holy Spirit.[^97]

items.slavonic_text: Є҆ди́нство оу҆́бѡ бж҃тве́нное сꙋ́щество,
items.english_text: *Canon of the Cross and Resurrection. Another Heirmos: Let every earthborn mortal leap for joy...:*

items.slavonic_text: но соста́вми трⷪ҇цꙋ, всѝ вѣ́рнїи восхва́
items.english_text: Creeping deceitfully, the serpent took me captive from Eden; yet the Lord Almighty, having dashed that serpent against the hard rock on the Place of the Skull like an infant, opened unto me once again the entrance of delight, by reason of the Wood of the Cross.

items.slavonic_text: лимъ, в неслїѧ́ныхъ соста́вѣхъ: ѻ҆ц҃а
items.english_text: Thou didst lay waste the strong bulwarks of the enemy, and with Thine almighty hand Thou didst plunder his riches, O Christ, and didst raise Adam up with Thyself; and him who of old boasted immeasurably, Thou didst show forth as mocked with derision.

items.slavonic_text: пребезна́чална, сн҃а и҆ дх҃а всест҃а́го .
items.english_text: Come, visiting the affliction of Thy poor people; and with Thy merciful and mighty hand strengthen the cross-bearing king against blasphemous enemies, to deliver Thine elect inheritance, as the Lover of mankind.

items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ І҆рмо́съ . Всѧ́къ земноро́дный да возигра́етсѧ .
items.english_text: *Canon to the Theotokos. Another Heirmos: O most pure mystery of God...:*

items.slavonic_text: поѧ́тъ мѧ̀ плѣне́на . накра́нїевѣ же на
items.english_text: We behold thee, O pure one, clothed like a lily, O all-immaculate one, shining in the midst of thorns through the Divine Spirit, and filling with fragrance those who sincerely magnify thee.

items.slavonic_text: тве́рдѣмъ ка́мени, раздрази́въ сего̀ все
items.english_text: Taking corruptible earthly nature from thine all-immaculate womb, the Incorruptible One showed it forth in Himself as entirely incorruptible through the bowels of His compassion; therefore do we magnify thee as the Theotokos.

items.slavonic_text: велича́емъ . На̀ хвали́те: Ст҃ры воскр҃ . гла́ д҃ .
items.english_text: O Sovereign Lady Who rulest over all creatures, grant unto Thy people victorious overcome; subdue the disobedient under the feet of the king, that we may magnify thee.[^98]

items.slavonic_text: [Инициал 'И'] И҆́же распѧ́тїе претерпѣ́въ и҆ сме́рть * и҆
items.english_text: *At the Praises: Resurrection Stichera, Tone 4:*

items.slavonic_text: воскресы́й и҆зме́ртвы * всеси́лне гдⷭ҇и сла́
items.english_text: Thou Who didst endure the Cross and death, and didst rise from the dead: almighty Lord, we glorify Thy Resurrection.

items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇то́мъ твои́мъ х҃е * дре́внѧѧ клѧ́твы
items.english_text: By Thy Cross, O Christ, Thou didst deliver us from the ancient curse; and by Thy death Thou didst abolish the devil that tormented our nature; and by Thy rising Thou didst fill all things with joy; therefore we cry unto Thee: O Thou Who didst rise from the dead, Lord, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: свободи́лъ є҆сѝ на́съ * и҆ сме́ртїю свое́ю , и҆
items.english_text: By Thy Cross, O Christ Savior, guide us unto Thy truth, and deliver us from the snares of the enemy; O Thou Who didst rise from the dead, raise us who are fallen through sin, stretching forth Thy hand, O Lord, Lover of mankind, through the prayers of Thy saints.

items.slavonic_text: є҆стество̀ на́ше мꙋ́чащаго дїѧ́вола оу҆пра
items.english_text: Without departing from Thy Father's bosom, O only-begotten Word of God, Thou camest down to earth for love of mankind, becoming man without undergoing change; and Thou didst endure crucifixion and death in the flesh, Who art impassible in Thy Godhead; and rising from the dead, Thou didst grant immortality unto the race of men, as the only Almighty One.

items.slavonic_text: здни́лъ є҆сѝ * воста́нїемъ же свои́мъ ра́до
items.english_text: Thou didst accept death in the flesh, dispensing immortality unto us, O Savior, and didst take up Thy dwelling in the tomb, that Thou mightest free us from Hades, raising us up together with Thyself: Thou didst suffer indeed as man, but Thou didst rise as God; therefore do we cry: Glory to Thee, O Giver of life, Lord, only Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: сти всѧ̑ и҆спо́лнилъ є҆сѝ * тѣ́мже вопїе́м
items.english_text: The rocks were rent, O Savior, when Thy Cross was set up on the Place of the Skull; the gatekeepers of Hades were terrified when Thou wast laid in the tomb as dead; for abolishing the power of death, Thou didst grant incorruption unto all the dead by Thy Resurrection, O Christ: Giver of life, Lord, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: ти оу҆праздни́лъ є҆сѝ крѣ́пость ме́ртвымъ
items.english_text: The women longed to see Thy Resurrection; and Mary Magdalene came beforehand, and found the stone rolled away from the tomb, and an Angel sitting and saying: Why seek ye the living among the dead? He is risen as God, that He may save all things; let us worship Him![^99]

items.slavonic_text: всѣ̑мъ нетлѣ́нїе пода́лъ є҆сѝ * воскресе́нїемъ
items.english_text: Where is Jesus Whom ye thought to guard? Tell us, O Jews! Where is He Whom ye laid in the tomb, sealing the stone? Give up the dead man, ye that have rejected Life! Give up the Buried One, or else believe in Him Who is risen! Even though ye keep silence concerning the Lord's rising, the stones shall cry out, and most of all the one rolled away from the tomb! Great is Thy mercy, great is the mystery of Thy dispensation: our Savior, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: твои́мъ х҃е * живода́вче гдⷭ҇и сла́ва тебѣ̀ .
items.english_text: *Glory: Evangelical Sticheron. Both now: Most blessed art thou, O Theotokos.*

items.slavonic_text: Вожделѣ́ша же́ны ви́дѣти твоѐ воскрⷭ҇нїе
items.english_text: By reason of the tree Adam was banished from paradise, but by reason of the tree of the Cross the thief took up his dwelling in paradise. For the one, having tasted, transgressed the commandment of Him Who made him; but the other, being crucified together with Thee, confessed Thee as the hidden God, crying aloud: Remember me in Thy Kingdom!

items.slavonic_text: прїи́де предвари́вши мр҃їа магдалыни
items.english_text: Having the Cross of Christ in our thoughts, let us all strive to mortify worldly pleasures, making our souls a temple of the Holy Spirit, sending up the voice of the wise thief in faith unto Him: Remember us also in Thy Kingdom!

items.slavonic_text: ѡ҆брѣ́те ка́мень ѿвале́нъ ѿгро́ба * и҆ а҆́гг҃ла
items.english_text: Unto Him Who is risen from the dead and plundered the power of Hades, and appeared unto the myrrh-bearing women, crying unto them: Rejoice!

items.slavonic_text: мѵроно́сицамъ, ра́дꙋйтесѧ вопїѧ̀ и҆́мъ .
items.english_text: Let us the faithful pray that He deliver mankind from corruption, ever crying aloud unto Him in the voice of the wise thief: Remember us also in Thy Kingdom![^100]

items.slavonic_text: вѣ́рнїи оу҆мо́лимъ, ѿ тлѣ́нїа и҆зба́ви
items.english_text: Unto Thy tomb, O Christ, the myrrh-bearing women came to anoint Thee; and not finding Thy life-bearing and most pure body, O Blessed One, they were at a loss, and seeking Thee, they wept with tears; but beholding Thee revealed, O Master, they cried unto Thee: Remember us in Thy Kingdom!

items.slavonic_text: ти чл҃чество: зовꙋ́ще всегда̀ разбо́йни
items.english_text: Truly Christ is risen, and the tomb bears witness unto it, O ye transgressors of the Law! For leaving His burial wrappings behind, He rose on the third day; the stone was sealed, and the guards stood before the tomb; Hades was despoiled, death was put to death! He was not stolen, O Christ: believe with us in His resurrection!

items.slavonic_text: ка бл҃горазꙋ́мнаго гла́ къ немꙋ̀, помѧнѝ
items.english_text: Coming unto the disciples, granting them peace, and assuring the doubting Thomas through the showing of Thy wounds, Thou didst raise up all the ends of the earth, O Lord, to glorify Thee; and being now entreated, save those who cry aloud, O Master: Remember us in Thy Kingdom!

items.slavonic_text: На̀ гро́бъ тво́й х҃е, мѵроно́сица прїидо́
items.english_text: With one accord let all of us the faithful pray worthily to doxologize the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit: the Unity of the Godhead abiding unconfused in three Hypostases, simple, undivided, and unapproachable, which delivers us from the torment of the fire.

items.slavonic_text: ша пома́зати тѧ̀ . и҆ неѡ҆брѣ́тше бл҃же
items.english_text: Thy Mother, O Christ, who bore Thee in the flesh without seed, and truly remained an incorrupt Virgin after childbearing: her do we offer unto Thee in prayer, O exceedingly merciful Master, to grant forgiveness of sins unto those who ever cry in faith:

items.slavonic_text: нїемъ проще́нїе дарова́ти, всегда̀ вопїю́
items.english_text: Rejoice, in truth, O treasury of life![^101]

items.slavonic_text: щимъ вѣ́рно . ра́дꙋйсѧ оу҆́бѡ вои́стиннꙋ
items.english_text: *On Sunday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 4.*

items.slavonic_text: Внеде́лю ве́черъ, на Гдⷭ҇и возва́хъ, Стїхи̑ры пока
items.english_text: I have sinned against Thee, O Lover of mankind, not according to human nature that I might seek forgiveness, but beyond man and beyond nature, and beyond forgiveness; yet Thou Who hast mouths beyond nature and beyond comprehension of intellect, having become man, O my Savior, and possessing a love for mankind that passes understanding: have mercy on me who turn unto Thee!

items.slavonic_text: ѧ́нны . Гла́съ д҃ . Подо́бенъ: Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе .
items.english_text: Thou didst appoint repentance for sinners and not for the righteous; for having as patterns the thief, the prodigal, Manasseh, the harlot, the persecutor, the publican, and the blasphemer: not easily do we despair, knowing Thy love for mankind and Thy supreme goodness, O Christ my Savior; turning unto Thee and pouring forth tears, I am of good hope that Thou wilt receive me.

items.slavonic_text: [Инициал 'С'] Согрѣши́хъ ктебѣ̀ чл҃колꙋ́бче * не по є҆сте
items.english_text: Grant me compunction, estrangement from evils, and perfect amendment, unto me who am now plunged in bodily passions, far removed from Thee, O God, King of all, and possessing no hope whatever: save me, the prodigal, for the sake of Thy great goodness, O all-powerful Jesus, Savior of our souls!

items.slavonic_text: ствꙋ̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ чл҃къ * да̀ и҆спрошꙋ̀ проще́нїе
items.english_text: *Other Stichera to the Bodiless Angels, Tone 4.*

items.slavonic_text: но̀ па́че чл҃ка и҆ пре́зъ є҆стество̀ * и҆ па́че про
items.english_text: Thou didst create the angelic hosts and divine assemblies as acceptable dwellings and all-radiant receptacles of divine brightness, spectators and ministers of Thy glory, O Immortal One; appoint them as a protection in power to accomplish Thy Word, not knowing hesitation before Thine all-effecting and simple will.

items.slavonic_text: вскрѣ́пости скончава́ти твоѐ сло́во * и҆
items.english_text: Wishing to reveal an abyss of goodness, O God Who art unoriginate, Thou didst first create by Thine almighty nod the angelic choirs and the ranks of the Powers; for truly it was fitting that Goodness should pour forth and go forward, that many might be recipients of Thy bounty, O Master.[^102]

items.slavonic_text: хотѣ́нїе непозна́юща вседѣ́телное и҆ прⷭ҇тое .
items.english_text: The six-winged Seraphim, the many-eyed Cherubim, and the exalted Thrones stand around Thee, partaking immediately of Thine all-effecting radiance; Dominions, Principalities, and Powers, Archangels and Angels, the divine Hosts, praising Thy glory, O Almighty One, pray unto Thee for us.

items.slavonic_text: Бл҃гти пꙋчи́нꙋ ꙗ҆ви́ти восхотѣ́въ * бг҃ъ
items.english_text: Exceeding the angelic ranks, O all-immaculate one, ever pray with the Angels unto Him Who with the Angels rules over all creation, to grant us remission of transgressions, and deliverance from passions, and to make us then worthy to be singers of His glory and inheritors of incorruptible delight.

items.slavonic_text: сы́й безнача́лне * пе́рвѣе созда́лъ є҆сѝ все
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha: Penitential Stichera, Tone 4:*

items.slavonic_text: си́лнымъ сѝ манове́нїемъ а҆́гг҃лскїѧ ли́ки
items.english_text: I desired to wash away the handwriting of my transgressions with my tears, O Lord, and for the rest of my life to be well-pleasing unto Thee through repentance; but the enemy deceives me and wars against my soul: O Lord, before I perish utterly, save me!

items.slavonic_text: и҆ си́ламъ чи́ны * вои́стиннꙋ бо подоба́ше
items.english_text: Who that is tempest-tossed and flees unto this harbor is not saved? Or who that is diseased and falls down before this remedy is not healed? O Creator of all and Physician of the ailing: O Lord, before I perish utterly, save me!

items.slavonic_text: свои́хъ х҃е бж҃е, и҆ ѿни́хъ оу҆моле́нъ быва́ѧ,
items.english_text: Thou Who art glorified in the memorials of Thy saints, O Christ God, and art entreated by them: send down upon us Thy great mercy.[^103]

items.slavonic_text: нипослѝ на́съ ве́лїю мл҃ть . Сла́, и҆ Нн҃ѣ . Бг҃о .
items.english_text: Rejoice, cloud of light! Rejoice, radiant lamp! Rejoice, urn wherein was the manna! Rejoice, rod of Aaron! Rejoice, unburnt bush! Rejoice, bridal chamber! Rejoice, throne! Rejoice, holy mountain! Rejoice, refuge! Rejoice, divine table! Rejoice, mystical gate! Rejoice, joy of all!

items.slavonic_text: Ра́дꙋйсѧ свѣ́та ѡ҆́блаче: ра́дꙋйсѧ свѣти́л
items.english_text: *In the Resurrection Book of the Octoechos.*

items.slavonic_text: ниче свѣ́тлый: ра́дꙋйсѧ рꙋ́чко вне́йже
items.english_text: By Thy precious Cross, O Christ, Thou didst put the devil to shame; and by Thy Resurrection Thou didst blunt the sting of sin; and Thou didst save us from the gates of death: we glorify Thee, O Only-begotten One.

items.slavonic_text: сѧ є҆го̀ кнѧ́зи а҆́дестїи * и҆ взѧ́шасѧ вра́та плаче́внаѧ * вни́де бо цр҃ь сла́вы х҃с * гл҃ѧ сꙋ́щимъ во оу҆́захъ и҆зыйдѣ́те * и҆ и҆́же во тмѣ̀ ѡ҆кры́йтесѧ .
items.english_text: He Who grants resurrection unto the human race was led as a sheep to the slaughter; the rulers of Hades were terrified at Him, and the gates of wailing were lifted up; for Christ, the King of glory, entered in, saying unto those in bonds: "Come forth!" and unto those in darkness: "Show yourselves!"[^104]

items.slavonic_text: Ве́лїе чꙋ́до и҆́же неви́димыхъ содѣ́тель * за чл҃колю́бїе пло́тїю пострада́въ * и҆ воскр҃се безсмр҃тный * прїидѣ́те ѡ҆́тчїа ꙗ҆зы́къ томꙋ̀ покло́нимъсѧ * милосе́рдїемъ бо є҆гѡ̀ ѿ ле́сти и҆зба́вльшесѧ * во трїе́хъ соста́вѣхъ є҆ди́наго бг҃а пѣ́ти навыкохо́м .
items.english_text: A great wonder! The Creator of things invisible, having suffered in the flesh out of love for mankind, is risen, the Immortal One! Come, families of the nations, let us worship Him; for having been delivered from deceit through His tender mercy, we have learned to hymn the one God in three Persons.

items.slavonic_text: Вече́рнее поклоне́нїе прино́симъ тебѣ̀ невече́рнемꙋ свѣ́тꙋ * и҆́же на коне́цъ вѣкѡ́мъ * ꙗ҆́кѡ взерца́лѣ пло́тїю возсїѧ́вшꙋ мі́рови * и҆ да́же до а҆́да соше́дшꙋ * и҆ та́мо сꙋ́щꙋю тмꙋ̀ разрꙋши́вшꙋ * и҆ свѣ́тъ вскрⷭ҇нїа ꙗ҆зы́комъ показа́вшꙋ * свѣтода́че гдⷭ҇и сла́ва тебѣ̀ .
items.english_text: An evening worship we offer unto Thee, the Unwaning Light, Who at the end of the ages hast shone forth through the flesh as in a mirror unto the world, and descended even unto Hades, and destroyed the darkness there, and shown the light of the Resurrection unto the nations: O Giver of light, Lord, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: Нача́лника сп҃се́нїю на́шемꙋ х҃а славосло́вимъ * томꙋ́ бо и҆з̾ ме́ртвыхъ воскрⷭ҇шꙋ, мі́ръ ѿ ле́сти сп҃се́нъ бы́сть * ра́дꙋетсѧ ли́къ а҆́гг҃льскїй * бѣ́гаетъ же бѣсо́вскаѧ ле́сть * А҆да́мъ пады́й востае́тъ * и҆ дїа́волъ оу҆праздни́сѧ .
items.english_text: Let us hymn in praise Christ, the Author of our salvation; for when He rose from the dead, the world was saved from deceit; the angelic choir rejoices, and demonic deceit flees; fallen Adam rises, and the devil is brought to naught.

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ѿ кꙋсто́дїа оу҆чи́ми быва́хꙋ ѿ беззако́нникъ * покры́йте хв҃о воскресе́нїе * и҆ прїими́те сре́бреники * и҆ рцы́те ꙗ҆́кѡ на́мъ спѧ́щимъ * ѿ гро́ба оу҆кра́денъ бы́сть ме́ртвецъ * кто̀ ви́дѣ и҆лѝ кто̀ слы́ша, ме́ртвеца оу҆кра́дена когда̀ * па́че змѵ́рною пома́занна и҆ на́га * ѡ҆ста́вльша и҆ во гро́бѣ погреба́телнаѧ * нельсти́тесѧ і҆ꙋде́е * навы́кнѣте рече́нїа прⷪ҇ро́ческаѧ * и҆ разꙋмѣ́йте ꙗ҆́кѡ то́й є҆́стъ вои́стиннꙋ и҆зба́вител мі́рꙋ, и҆ всеси́ленъ .
items.english_text: Those of the guard were instructed by the lawless ones: "Conceal the Resurrection of Christ, and receive pieces of silver, and say: While we slept, the dead man was stolen from the tomb." Who has seen, or who has heard of a dead man being ever stolen, especially one anointed with myrrh and naked, who also left the grave clothes behind in the tomb? Be not deceived, O Judeans! Learn the sayings of the prophets, and understand that He is in truth the Redeemer of the world, and Almighty.

items.slavonic_text: Гдⷭ҇и и҆́же а҆́да плѣни́въ, и҆ сме́рть попра́въ сп҃се на́шъ, и҆ просвѣти́вый мі́ръ крⷭ҇то́мъ чⷭ҇тны́мъ, поми́лꙋй на́съ . Сла́, и҆ Нн҃ѣ . Бг҃о .
items.english_text: O Lord, Who didst lead Hades captive, and trample down death, O our Savior, and enlighten the world by Thy precious Cross: have mercy on us!

items.slavonic_text: [Инициал 'В'] Въ чермнѣ́мъ мо́ри, бра́кꙋ неискꙋсобра́чныѧ невѣ́сты, ѡ҆́бразъ написа́сѧ дре́вле: та́мо мѡѷсе́й раздѣли́тель водѣ̀, здѣ́же гаврїи́лъ слꙋжи́тель чꙋдесѝ: тогда̀ глꙋбинꙋ̀ немо́кро ше́ствоваше і҆и҃ль: нн҃ѣ же хрⷭ҇та̀ родѝ безсѣ́меннѡ дв҃аа . мо́ре попроше́ствїи і҆и҃левѣ пребы́сть непроходи́мо: непоро́чнаѧ же порожⷭ҇твѣ̀ є҆мманꙋ́илевѣ пребы́сть нетлѣ́нна . сы́й пре́жде сы́й, ꙗ҆ви́сѧ ꙗ҆́кѡ чл҃къ, бж҃е поми́лꙋй на́съ .
items.english_text: *Glory, both now: Theotokion (Dogmatikon):*

items.slavonic_text: На̀ стихо́внѣ Стїхи̑ры, Воскрⷭ҇ны, Гла́съ є҃ .
items.english_text: In the Red Sea an image of the unwedded Bride was inscribed of old: there Moses was the divider of the water; and here Gabriel is the minister of the wonder. Then Israel traversed the deep dryshod; and now the Virgin has given birth unto Christ without seed. The sea remained impassable after the passage of Israel; and the undefiled one remained incorrupt after the birth of Emmanuel. He Who is, and Who was before, has appeared as man: O God, have mercy on us![^105]

items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ вопло́щшасѧ сп҃са хрⷭ҇та̀, и҆ нб҃съ неразлꙋ́чшасѧ: вогла́сѣхъ пѣ́нїѧ возвели́чимъ * ꙗ҆́кѡ крⷭ҇тъ и҆ сме́рть прїѧ́тъ за̀
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha: Stichera, Resurrection, Tone 5:*

items.slavonic_text: ро́дъ на́шъ * ꙗ҆́кѡ чл҃колю́бецъ гдⷭ҇ь * сокрꙋши́въ а҆́дова врата́ * тридне́вно воскре́се сп҃са́ѧ дꙋ́ша на́ша . И҆ны Стїхи̑ры .
items.english_text: Thee, Christ the Savior, Who wast incarnate and yet wast not separated from heaven, we magnify with voices of song; for Thou didst accept the Cross and death for our race, as the Lord Who lovest mankind; and having shattered the gates of Hades, Thou didst rise on the third day, saving our souls.

items.slavonic_text: Прободе́нномꙋ тѝ ребрѡ́мъ жизнода́вче * то́ки ѡ҆ставле́нїа всѣ́мъ и҆сточи́лъ є҆сѝ * жи́знь и҆ сп҃се́нїе * пло́тїю же сме́рть воспрїѧ́тъ * безсме́ртїе на́мъ дарова̀ * всели́вжесѧ во гро́бъ, на́съ свободи́лъ є҆сѝ * совоскрѣси́въ ссобо́ю сла́вно ꙗ҆́кѡ бг҃ъ * сегѡ̀ ра́ди вопїе́м * чл҃колю́бче гдⷭ҇и сла́ва тебѣ̀ .
items.english_text: When Thy side was pierced, O Life-giver, Thou didst pour forth streams of remission, life, and salvation unto all; and having accepted death in the flesh, Thou didst grant immortality unto us; and having dwelt in the tomb, Thou didst set us free, co-resurrecting us with Thyself gloriously as God. Therefore we cry aloud: O Lord, Lover of mankind, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: Стра́нно твоѐ распѧ́тїе * и҆ во а҆́дъ соше́ствїе чл҃колю́бче є҆́стъ * плѣни́въ бо є҆го̀, и҆ дре́внѧѧ оу҆́зники совоскрѣси́въ ссобо́ю сла́вно ꙗ҆́кѡ бг҃ъ * ра́й ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ * наслади́тисѧ того̀ сподо́билъ є҆сѝ * тѣ́мже и҆ на́мъ сла́вѧщымъ твоѐ тридне́вное воста́нїе * да́рꙋй ѡ҆чище́нїе грѣхѡ́мъ * ра́йски
items.english_text: Strange is Thy Crucifixion and descent into Hades, O Lover of mankind; for having despoiled it, and having co-resurrected the ancient prisoners with Thyself gloriously as God, Thou didst open Paradise and make them worthy to delight therein. Therefore, unto us also who glorify Thy third-day Rising, grant cleansing of sins, making us paradise-dwellers, as the only Compassionate One!

items.slavonic_text: жи́телѧ сотворѧ́ѧ ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ млⷭ҇рдъ .
items.english_text: Thou Who for our sake didst accept suffering in the flesh, and didst rise from the dead on the third day: heal our carnal passions, and raise us up from grievous transgressions, O Lover of mankind, and save us!

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же на́съ ра́ди пло́тїю ст҃рть прїе́мъ * и҆ тридне́вно и҆зме́ртвыхъ воскр҃съ, плотскїа на́ша стра́сти и҆сцѣлѝ, и҆ воста́ви ѡ҆согрѣше́нїй лю́ты, чл҃колю́бче сп҃си на́съ .
items.english_text: Being the church and gate, the palace and throne of the King, O all-comely Virgin, through whom my Redeemer, Christ the Lord, appeared unto those who sat in darkness, being the Sun of Righteousness, wishing to enlighten those whom He fashioned according to His image with His own hand: therefore, O all-hymned one, as thou hast acquired maternal boldness toward Him, unceasingly pray that He save our souls.

items.slavonic_text: Цр҃кви и҆ вра́та сꙋ́щи: пола́та и҆ прⷭ҇то́лъ цесаре́въ, дв҃о всекра́снаѧ . є҆́нже и҆зба́витель мо́й х҃с гдⷭ҇ь . и҆́же во тмѣ̀ сѣдѧ́щым ꙗ҆ви́сѧ слн҃це сы́й пра́ведное, просвѣти́ти хотѧ̀ и҆́же созда̀ по ѡ҆́бразꙋ свое́мꙋ рꙋко́ю свое́ю . тѣ́мже всепѣ́таѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ ма́терне дерзнове́нїе кнемꙋ̀ стѧжа́вши . непреста́нно молѝ сп҃сти дꙋ́ша на́ша .
items.english_text: The Co-unoriginate Word with the Father and the Spirit, Who was born of the Virgin for our salvation, let us the faithful hymn and worship; for He was well-pleased to ascend the Cross in the flesh, and to endure death, and to raise the dead by His glorious Resurrection.

items.slavonic_text: Тропа́рь Воскре́сенъ . Гла́съ, Пѧ́тый .
items.english_text: Rejoice, impassable gate of the Lord! Rejoice, wall and protection of those who flee unto thee! Rejoice, stormless haven and unwedded one, who didst bear in the flesh thy Creator and God! Despise not those who pray and hymn and bow down before thy childbearing![^106]

items.slavonic_text: Собезнача́лное сло́во ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ и҆ дх҃ови: є҆́же ѿ дв҃ы ро́ждшеесѧ насп҃се́нїе на́ше, воспои́мъ вѣ́рнїи
items.english_text: *At the Midnight Office: Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, Tone 5. Ode 1. Heirmos: "Horse and rider":*

items.slavonic_text: вѣ́рнїи и҆ покло́нимсѧ : ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гоизво́ли пло́тїю взы́йти на̀ крⷭ҇тъ, и҆ сме́рть претерпѣ́ти, и҆ воскр҃си́ти оу҆ме́ршаѧ во сла́вное воскресе́нїе своѐ . Сла́ва . и҆ Нн҃ѣ . Бг҃о .
items.english_text: Hymning the dominion of the unitary and thrice-radiant form, we cry aloud: Enlighten our mind, O almighty God, and raise it up, O Master, unto Thine ineffable glory!

items.slavonic_text: Ра́дꙋйсѧ две́ри гнⷭ҇ѧ непроходи́маѧ: ра́дꙋйсѧ стѣ́но и҆ покро́ве прибѣга́ющымъ ктебѣ̀ : ра́дꙋйсѧ небꙋ́рное приста́нище, и҆ неискꙋсобра́чнаѧ, ро́ждшаѧ пло́тїю тво́рца своего̀ и҆ бг҃а : молѧ́щи непре́зри, ѡ҆воспѣва́ющихъ и҆ кланѧ́ющихъсѧ рожествꙋ̀ твое́мꙋ .
items.english_text: On high, the intelligible angelic beauties unceasingly hymn with thrice-holy songs the Unity thrice-radiant, and the Trinity con-formed, supersubstantial, and almighty.

items.slavonic_text: мо́лчно пою́тъ трист҃ы́ми пѣ́сньми, є҆ди́ницꙋ трислꙋ́чнꙋ, и҆ трⷪ҇цꙋ соѡ҆́бразнꙋ: и҆ пресꙋ́щественнꙋ и҆ всеси́лнꙋ .
items.english_text: Grant unto my soul the divine drink of Thy love, sweet and light-working, O Trinity, light-originating Unity, and divine cleansing compunction, O Master of all creation, abounding in mercy.

items.slavonic_text: Бж҃тве́нное пи́во твое́ѧ любвѐ, сла́дкое свѣтодѣ́йственное, дш҃и мое́й пода́ждь, трⷪ҇це є҆ди́нице свѣтонача́лнаѧ, и҆ бж҃тве́нное оу҆миле́нїе ѡ҆чисти́телное, вл҃ко многомл҃тиве всеѧ̀ тва́ри . Бг҃оро́диченъ .
items.english_text: Even as the divine rain came down noiselessly upon the fleece into thy womb, O Virgin, into thy blessed chamber, and saved the dried-up human nature, O all-pure one.[^107]

items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ же на̀ рꙋно̀ сни́де безшꙋ́ма вочре́во дв҃о, до́ждь бл҃гоже́сна твоѧ̀ бж҃твенный . и҆ сп҃сѐ и҆ссо́хшее чл҃чкое є҆стество̀ пречⷭ҇таѧ .
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos: "Who established upon nothing":*

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь г҃, І҆рмо́съ: Оу҆тверже́й ниначе́мже .
items.english_text: Having willed it, Thou didst establish the noetic essences as unceasing singers of Thy Godhead, O Thrice-holy God and Creator of all; yet receive also the praise and entreaty of us who are clay and earthborn, as Thou art merciful.

items.slavonic_text: Помы́сливъ оу҆́мныѧ сꙋ́щества соста́вилъ є҆сѝ, пѣвца̀ непреста́нныѧ твое́го бж҃тва̀ . трїст҃е бж҃е и҆ вседѣ́телю: но̀ и҆ бренныхъ и҆ земноро́дныхъ прїимѝ хвалꙋ̀ и҆ мольбꙋ̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ милосе́рдъ .
items.english_text: Thou Who by nature admittest no alteration: unto us who are subject to change and hymn Thee, an untraceable fountain of Thy goodness, grant forgiveness of transgressions, O thrice-radiant Sun of glory!

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же всѧ́каго по є҆стествꙋ̀ превраще́нїа непрїѧ́тенъ: и҆змѣнѧ́емымъ на́мъ и҆ пою́щымъ . неизслѣди́мый и҆сто́чникъ твоеѧ̀ бл҃гти . прегрѣше́нїем да́ждь проще́нїе: слн҃це сла́вы трислꙋ́чне .
items.english_text: We glorify Father, Son, and Spirit in the immutable form of the Godhead, Thee, the unitary and thrice-shining Lord of all, even as the ranks were plainly taught by Thee.

items.slavonic_text: ѻ҆ц҃а̀ и҆ сн҃а и҆ дх҃а сла́вимъ, внепремѣ́ннѣмъ зра́цѣ бж҃тва̀, тебѐ є҆ди́нственаго и҆ трисїѧ́ннаго гдⷭ҇а всѣ́хъ: ꙗ҆́кѡ же ли́ци на пли́ ѿ тебѐ ꙗ҆́вѣ наꙋчи́шасѧ . Бг҃о .
items.english_text: Thou didst appear unto Moses in the bush as the Angel of Great Counsel of the Almighty, prefiguring Thine incarnation of the Virgin, O Word of God, Who didst refashion us and lead us up unto the heavens.

items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ мѡѷсе́и вкꙋпинѣ̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́гг҃лъ совѣ́та вели́ка вседержи́телевъ, твоѐ ѡ҆ дв҃ы проꙗ҆влѧ́ѧ воплоще́нїе бж҃їй сло́ве: и҆́же на́съ претво́рилъ є҆сѝ, и҆ на̀ нб҃са возведѐ .
items.english_text: Thou art merciful, O undivided Trinity; for Thou hast mercy upon all as Thou art almighty, and as the all-bountiful and most merciful God. Therefore we flee unto Thee, weighed down by many transgressions, crying aloud: Cleanse Thy servants, and deliver them from every torment!

items.slavonic_text: прибѣга́емъ ктебѣ̀: согрѣше́нїи мно́гими ѡ҆тѧча́еми . взыва́юще ѡ҆чи́сти своѧ̀ рабы̀: и҆ и҆зба́ви всѧ́каго мꙋче́нїа . Бг҃о .
items.english_text: O all-holy Virgin, have mercy on us who flee unto thee, the tender-hearted, and ask for thy warm protection; for thou art able, as thou art good, to save all, being the Mother of God Most High, ever embracing us with thy maternal prayers, O thou who hast been gladdened by God!

items.slavonic_text: Всест҃а́ѧ дв҃о на́съ поми́лꙋй притѣка́ющих ктебѣ̀ бл҃гоꙋтро́бной, и҆ просѧ́щихъ те́плое твоѐ застꙋпле́нїе: мо́жеши бо ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃га всѣ́хъ сп҃сти: ꙗ҆́кѡ сꙋ́щи мт҃и бг҃а вы́шнагѡ, ма́терними тѝ мл҃твами, при́сно ѡ҆б̾емлющи бг҃орадо́ваннаѧ .
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos: Perceiving Thy divine condescension with prophetic insight, O...*

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃ . І҆рмо́съ . Бж҃твенное твоѐ разꙋмѣ́въ .
items.english_text: Daniel was taught the thrice-shining nature of the one Lordship, having beheld Christ the Judge coming unto the Father, and making manifest the vision of the Spirit.[^108]

items.slavonic_text: Наꙋча́етсѧ є҆ди́наго гдⷭ҇тва трїсїѧ́нное данїи́лъ: хрⷭ҇та̀ сꙋдїю̀ оу҆зрѣ́въ ко ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ̀ и҆дꙋ́ща . и҆ дх҃а проꙗ҆влѧ́ѧ видѣ́нїе .
items.english_text: Make us who hymn Thee with lips of clay—Thee, the supersubstantial God, threefold in hypostases, yet unitary in essence—worthy of angelic glory.

items.slavonic_text: Бре́нными пою́щихъ тѧ̀ оу҆сты̀: пресꙋ́щественнаго бг҃а тро́ична соста́вми, є҆ди́нственна же є҆стество́мъ . сла́вы а҆́гг҃льскїа сподо́би .
items.english_text: One power and one Lordship in three hypostatic properties we praise without division: O Father, Son, and Spirit, enlighten Thy servants!

items.slavonic_text: Є҆ди́нꙋ вла́сть и҆ є҆ди́но же гдⷭ҇тво во трїе́хъ сво́йствѣхъ неразлꙋ́чно сла́вимъ: ѻ҆́ч҃е и҆ сн҃е и҆ дш҃е просвѣтѝ на̀ рабы̀ своѧ̀ . Бг҃ .
items.english_text: The precious and overshadowing mountain which Habakkuk foresaw of old, from whence the Holy One came forth, foretold the mystery, difficult to behold, of thy virginal conception and childbearing.

items.slavonic_text: Гора̀ чⷭ҇тна́ѧ и҆ присѣ́нна, ю҆́же ви́дѣ пре́жде а҆ввакꙋ́мъ: и҆знеѧ́же про́йде ст҃ый . не оу҆до́бъ зри́мое ржⷭ҇тво̀ сказа́ше твое́го дв҃ы зача́тїа . Пѣ́снь є҃ . І҆рмо́ . Ѡ҆дѣѧ́йсѧ .
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos: Thou Who clothest Thyself with light as with...*

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же за бл҃гость созда́въ чл҃ка, и҆ по ѡ҆́бразꙋ свое́мꙋ сотво́ръ . вомнѣ̀ ѡ҆бита́й трист҃е бж҃е мо́й, ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гъ и҆ мл҃рдъ .
items.english_text: Thou Who out of goodness didst fashion man and make him according to Thine own image: dwell within me, O Thrice-holy God of mine, for Thou art good and compassionate.

items.slavonic_text: Ты́ мѧ̀ наста́ви є҆ди́нице трислꙋ́чнаѧ, костеза́мъ бж҃твенным сп҃се́нїа: и҆ твое́го сїѧ́нїа и҆спо́лни . ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆стество́мъ бг҃ъ неисче́тенно си́ленъ .
items.english_text: Do Thou guide me, O thrice-radiant Unity, unto the divine paths of salvation, and fill me with Thy brightness, as Thou art God by nature, incalculably mighty.

items.slavonic_text: Свѣ́тъ нераздѣ́лный зрѣ́ти твое́го є҆стества̀: раздѣ́леный начерта́нми, трисїѧ́нный, невече́рнїй . моѐ срⷣце лꙋча́ми твои́ми ѡ҆зарѝ .
items.english_text: To behold the undivided light of Thy nature, distinguished by hypostatic characters, thrice-shining, unwaning: illumine my heart with Thy beams!

items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́ко видѣ́ тѧ дре́ле чⷭ҇таѧ, прⷱ҇чтаѧ прⷪ҇ро́къ, зрѧ́щꙋю две́рь косвѣ́тꙋ незаходи́момꙋ дв҃це . позна̀ бж҃їе жили́ще .
items.english_text: When the prophet of old beheld thee, O pure and all-undefiled Maiden, as a door looking toward the unwaning light, he recognized the dwelling-place of God.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь ѕ҃, І҆рмо́съ . Волна́щеесѧ бꙋ́рею дш҃етлѣ́нꙋю,
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos: Surging with the storm of soul-corrupting passions, O...*

items.slavonic_text: Трисвѣ́тло сꙋ́щи, бг҃онача́лїе соста́вѣхъ: є҆ди́нство є҆сѝ . ꙗ҆́кѡ соѡ҆́бразно и҆ ра́вно дѣ́телно, и҆ пресꙋ́щество и҆ хотѣ́нїи .
items.english_text: Being thrice-radiant, O Godhead in hypostases, Thou art a Unity; for Thou art conformed and equal in operation, supersubstantial and one in will.

items.slavonic_text: Дово́лно сказа̀ прⷪ҇ро́къ, поѧ̀ ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ̀: твои́мъ свѣ́томъ оу҆́зримъ дх҃омъ свѣ́тъ сн҃а є҆ди́наго бг҃а трислꙋ́чнаго .
items.english_text: Sufficiently did the prophet declare, singing unto the Father: "In Thy light, through the Spirit, we shall see the light of the Son, the one thrice-radiant God."[^109]

items.slavonic_text: Несоста́вно сꙋ́щество, во трїе́хъ сво́йствѣхъ, є҆ди́нꙋ влⷭ҇ть и҆ держа́вꙋ и҆́мы, тѣ́мъ бо состо́итсѧ тва́рь всѧ́ческаѧ и҆ ѡ҆бновлѧ́етсѧ . Бг҃о .
items.english_text: A non-composite essence in three hypostatic properties, possessing one power and dominion: for by it all creation exists and is renewed.

items.slavonic_text: Прегрѣше́нїемъ и҆збавле́нїе, напа́стемъ вл҃ко бж҃е, є҆динстве́нне и҆ трїст҃е низпослѝ твои́мъ пѣвце́мъ мольба́ми бг҃ома́тере .
items.english_text: Deliverance from transgressions and from afflictions, O Master God, unitary and thrice-holy, send down upon Thy singers through the prayers of the Mother of God.

items.slavonic_text: Сѣда́лна, Гла́съ є҃ . По́ . Собезнача́лное сло́во .
items.english_text: Have mercy on me, O my Savior, have mercy on me, and rebuke me not in Thine anger, nor enter into judgment with Thy servant; for I know in truth that my countless transgressions cry out against me before Thee, O Bountiful One. Therefore I cry unto Thee: Have mercy on me!

items.slavonic_text: Поми́лꙋй мѧ̀ сп҃се мо́й поми́лꙋй мѧ̀, и҆ неѡ҆бличѝ менѐ мл҃тве гнѣ́вомъ твои́мъ, ни́же вни́ди в̾сꙋ́дъ сра́бо́мъ твои́мъ, а҆́зъ бо вѣ́мъ вои́стинꙋ ꙗ҆́кѡ на́мѧ глаго́лютъ моѧ̀ безчи́сленнаѧ согрѣше́нїа, предъ тобо́ю ще́дрый . тѣ́мъже тѝ зовꙋ̀, поми́лꙋй мѧ̀ . Сла́ва . и҆ Нн҃ѣ . Бг҃о .
items.english_text: Perplexed in all things, I have fled unto thee, the hope and refuge of all, sinful and lowly, crying: "I have sinned!" yet remaining in evils, unfeeling, wretch that I am. Have mercy on me before the end, convert me, and deliver Thy servant from every torment!

items.slavonic_text: Недоꙋмѣ́ваемъ ѡ҆ всѣ́хъ ктебѣ̀ прибѣго́хъ, оу҆пова́нїе всѣ́хъ и҆ прибѣ́жище, грѣ́шны[й] и҆ смире́нным . зовы́й согрѣши́хъ, и҆ пребыва́ѧ возлы́хъ, нечꙋ́вствꙋѧ ѡ҆клаѧ́нный . поми́лꙋй мѧ̀ пре́жде конца̀, ѡ҆братѝ мѧ̀ и҆ и҆зба́ви всѧ́кїѧ мꙋ́ки раба̀ своего .
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos: "Exalted by the fathers, the Lord":*

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь з҃ . І҆рмо́съ . Превозноси́мый ѻ҆тце́мъ Гдⷭ҇ь .
items.english_text: As Thou hast an abyss of mercy, O Lord, and an incalculable deep of bounty, O Bountiful One: have mercy on us who hymn Thee as the one, thrice-shining God of all.

items.slavonic_text: Неѡ҆б̾ъмысли́маго є҆динстве́нна и҆ трисвѣ́тла, бг҃а тѧ̀ и҆ гдⷭ҇а пою́щымъ, пода́ждь твои̑мъ рабо́м ѡ҆чїще́нїе согрѣше́нїем .
items.english_text: Unto those who hymn Thee as the incomprehensible, unitary, and thrice-radiant God and Lord, grant unto Thy servants cleansing of transgressions.

items.slavonic_text: Ра́вно соста́вы веди́ной держа́вѣ чтꙋ́ще раздѣлѧ́емъ, нераздѣ́лимо сꙋ́щество, бг҃а ѻ҆ц҃а̀ и҆ сн҃а и҆ ст҃го дх҃а . Бг҃о .
items.english_text: Equally honoring the hypostases in one dominion, we distinguish, without dividing the essence, God the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit.

items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆тра́сль проꙗ҆ви́ла є҆сѝ, ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ̀ собезнача́лна, цвѣ́тъ бж҃тва̀, сте́бль соприсносꙋ́щный дв҃о, да́ющаго жи́знь всѣ́мъ чл҃кѡмъ .
items.english_text: Thou hast revealed a shoot co-unoriginate with the Father, the Flower of the Godhead, the co-everlasting Branch, O Virgin, Who grants life unto all men.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, и҃ . І҆рмо́съ . Тебѣ̀ вседѣ́телю .
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos: Unto Thee, the Creator of all, the youth...*

items.slavonic_text: Да є҆ди́наго ѿкры́еши дре́вле ꙗ҆́вѣ гдⷭ҇а, трⷪ҇чный соста́въ, ꙗ҆ви́лъсѧ є҆сѝ бж҃е мо́й во ѡ҆́бразѣ чл҃ка А҆враа́мꙋ, пою́щꙋ твою̀ держа́вꙋ є҆динстве́ннꙋ .
items.english_text: That Thou mightest clearly reveal of old the one Lord in threefold hypostasis, Thou didst appear, O my God, in human form unto Abraham, who hymned Thy unitary dominion.[^110]

items.slavonic_text: Ты́ мѧ̀ ко твои̑мъ бл҃годѣ́тельнымъ лꙋча́м, зрѣ́ти сподо́би свѣ́те непристꙋ́пный, ѻ҆́ч҃е вседержи́телю, и҆ сло́ве и҆ дш҃е, є҆́же
items.english_text: Vouchsafe me to look upon Thy beneficent beams, O Inaccessible Light, Father Almighty, Word, and Spirit, that I may be well-pleasing unto Thee always, O Lord of all!

items.slavonic_text: бл҃гоꙋгожда́ти тебѣ̀ прⷭ҇но гдⷭ҇и всѣ́хъ .
items.english_text: Holy is the Father, God before all ages; and holy is the Son, begotten of the Father; and holy is the Life-creating Spirit, proceeding from the Father and made manifest through the Son.

items.slavonic_text: Ст҃ъ ѻ҆ц҃ъ бг҃ъ превѣ́чный: ст҃ъ же сн҃ъ и҆ ѿ ѻ҆ц҃а̀ рожде́нъ: ст҃ъ же и҆ животворѧ́щїй дх҃ъ, и҆сходѧ̀ и҆ ѻ҆ц҃а̀, сн҃ом же ꙗ҆влѧ́ем .
items.english_text: Thou hast shone forth upon us from the thrice-radiant beam the one Christ and Lord, O all-hymned one, teaching all to hymn the one Godhead in three Persons unto the ages.

items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆блиста́ла є҆сѝ на́мъ ѿ трислꙋ́чныѧ лꙋча̀, є҆ди́наго всепѣ́таѧ хрⷭ҇та̀ и҆ гдⷭ҇а, всѣ́хъ наꙋча́ющїа є҆ди́ное бг҃онача́лїе во трїе́хъ ли́цехъ пѣ́ти вовѣ́ки .
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos: Rejoice, O Isaiah! For a Virgin hath conceived...*

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃ . І҆рмо́съ . И҆са́їа ликꙋ́й дв҃аа бо .
items.english_text: Human tongues cannot hymn Thee worthily, O Divine Unity; yet as much as we are able, daring through faith, O Divine and Co-enthroned Trinity, we offer glory and praise unto Thy dominion!

items.slavonic_text: Гл҃ти чл҃чтїи по достоѧ́нїи бг҃онача́лнаѧ є҆дини́це немо́гꙋтъ воспѣва́ти, ѡ҆ба́че ꙗ҆́коже мо́щно дерза́юще ѿ вѣ́ры, бг҃онача́лнаѧ сопресто́лнаѧ трⷪ҇це, сла́вꙋ прино́симъ твое́й держа́вѣ и҆ хва́лꙋ .
items.english_text: Equally honoring, the Cherubim and Seraphim praise Thee with all-pure lips, the unitary and thrice-radiant God; and with them do Thou also receive us sinners, O Lord, who magnify Thy dominion!

items.slavonic_text: же и҆ на́съ грѣ́шныхъ прїимѝ гдⷭ҇и, твою̀ держа́вꙋ велича́ющихъ .
items.english_text: Isaiah beheld Thee upon the Cherubic throne, with the Seraphim standing round about Thee, veiling their faces with their wings and crying: "Holy, Holy, Holy, Thrice-holy God, glorified in three Hypostases!"

items.slavonic_text: И҆са́їа тѧ̀ ви́дѣ на̀ прⷭ҇то́лѣ херꙋві́мстѣ, и҆ серафі́ми стоѧ́ща ѡ҆́крⷭ҇тъ тебѐ, кри́лы ли́ца закрыва́юща, и҆ вопїю́ща, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, трїст҃ый бж҃е, сла́вимый во трїе́хъ соста́вѣхъ . Бг҃о .
items.english_text: As a pure and undefiled Virgin, thou didst bear the Son, the immutable God, delivering us from temptations; but even now we pray that remission of our transgressions be sent down.

items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чⷭ҇таѧ и҆ непоро́чнаѧ дв҃аа, роди́ла є҆сѝ сн҃а бг҃а неизмѣ́нна, и҆збавлѧ́ющи на́съ ѿ и҆скꙋше́нїй . но̀ и҆ нн҃ѣ ѡ҆ставле́нїе на́шымъ прегрѣше́нїемъ низпосла́ти мо́лимъсѧ .
items.english_text: *At the First Kathisma: Sessional Hymns, Resurrection, Tone 5:*

items.slavonic_text: На̀ а҃, стїхоло́гїи, Сѣда́лна: Воскрⷭ҇ны Гла́съ є҃ .
items.english_text: Let us praise the Cross of the Lord, and honor His holy burial with songs, and glorify His Resurrection; for as God He raised the dead from the tombs with Himself, having led captive the power of death and the might of the devil; and unto those in Hades He shone forth light.[^111]

items.slavonic_text: [Инициал 'К'] Крⷭ҇тъ гдⷭ҇нь да похва́лимъ, и҆ погребе́нїе ст҃о́е пѣ́сньми почте́мъ, и҆ воскрⷭ҇нїе є҆го̀ просла́вимъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ со воздви́же ме́ртвыѧ ѿ гро́бъ ꙗ҆́кѡ бг҃ъ, плѣни́въ сме́рти держа́вꙋ и҆ крѣ́пость дїа́волю . и҆ сꙋ́щым
items.english_text: The wonder of thy conception is marvelous, and ineffable is the manner of thy childbearing: in thee it has been made known, O pure Ever-Virgin! It astounds my mind and terrifies my thought; thy glory, O Theotokos, is spread abroad unto all, for the salvation of our souls.

items.slavonic_text: во а҆́дѣ свѣ́тъ возсїѧ̀ . в҃ . Сла́, и҆ Нн҃ѣ . Бг҃о .
items.english_text: *At the Second Kathisma: Sessional Hymn, Tone 5:*

items.slavonic_text: Ди́вно чꙋ́до зача́тїа: и҆ неизрече́ненъ ѡ҆́бразъ рожде́нїа, втебѣ̀ позна́сѧ чи́стаѧ прⷭ҇но дв҃о, оу҆дивла́етъ мѝ оу҆́мъ и҆ оу҆жаса́етъ по́мыслъ, сла́ва твоѧ̀ бцⷣе по всѣ́мъ простре́сѧ, во сп҃се́нїе дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ .
items.english_text: The Lord was named dead, Who put death to death; and He was laid in a tomb Who emptied the tombs! Above, soldiers guarded the tomb; while below, Thou didst raise the dead from the ages, O Almighty and Incomprehensible Lord: glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: На̀ в҃, Стїхоло́гїи . Сѣда́лна Гла́съ є҃ .
items.english_text: Rejoice, holy mountain, traversed by God! Rejoice, living and unburnt bush! Rejoice, only bridge of the world unto God, that leads the dead unto life everlasting! Rejoice, incorrupt Maiden, unwedded maiden, who didst bear the salvation of our souls!

items.slavonic_text: кови́це, неискꙋсобра́чнаѧ ро́ждєншїа сп҃се́нїе дꙋша́мъ на́шимъ . По непоро́чна . Ѵ҆пакоѝ .
items.english_text: *After the Amomos (Psalm 118): Hypakoe:*

items.slavonic_text: А҆́гг҃льскимъ зра́комъ оу҆́мъ смꙋща́юще, и҆ бж҃тве́ннымъ воста́нїемъ дш҃а просвѣща́юще: мѵроно́сица а҆пл҃ѡмъ бл҃говѣствова́хꙋ: возвѣсти́те во ꙗ҆зы́цѣхъ воскре́нїе, гдⷭ҇ꙋ поспѣ́шествꙋющꙋ чꙋдесы̀: подаю́щемꙋ на́мъ ве́лїю ми́лость .
items.english_text: Troubled in their minds by the angelic vision, yet enlightened in their souls by the divine Rising, the Myrrh-bearing Women announced the good tidings unto the Apostles: "Proclaim the Resurrection among the nations, while the Lord works with you by wonders, granting unto us great mercy!"[^112]

items.slavonic_text: Та́жъ степе́на, Гла́съ є҃ . А҆нтифо́нъ пе́рвый,
items.english_text: *Then the Gradual Hymns (Anavathmoi), Tone 5. Antiphon 1:*

items.slavonic_text: Внегда̀ скорби́ти мѝ, дв҃ски пою́ ти сп҃се мо́й . и҆зба́ви дш҃ꙋ мою̀ ѿ ꙗ҆зы́ка лести́ва .
items.english_text: When I am afflicted, like David I sing unto Thee, O my Savior: Deliver my soul from a deceitful tongue!

items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ннымъ живо́тъ бл҃же́нъ є҆́стъ: бж҃їимъ жела́нїемъ возвыша́ющимсѧ .
items.english_text: Blessed is the life of those who dwell in the wilderness, who are borne aloft by divine love.

items.slavonic_text: Ст҃ы́мъ дх҃ом ѡ҆держа́сѧ всѧ̀, ви́димаѧ же сневи́димыми: самодержа́венъ бо сы́й . ѿ ѻ҆ц҃а̀ є҆ди́нъ є҆́стъ нело́женъ . А҆нтифо́нъ, в҃ .
items.english_text: By the Holy Spirit all things are upheld, both visible and invisible; for He is sovereign, being truly one of the Trinity.

items.slavonic_text: На̀ го́ры дш҃ѐ воздви́гнемсѧ: грѧдѝ та́
items.english_text: Let us lift ourselves up unto the mountains, O soul: go thither, from whence help will come!

items.slavonic_text: Десна́ѧ тѝ рꙋка̀ и҆ мнѣ̀ х҃е простира́ема: ѿ пре́лести всѧ́кїа да сохра́нитъ .
items.english_text: May Thy right hand, stretched forth even unto me, O Christ, preserve me from all deceit!

items.slavonic_text: Ст҃о́мꙋ дх҃ꙋ бг҃осло́вѧще рце́мъ: ты̀ є҆сѝ бг҃ъ, живо́тъ, жела́нїе: свѣ́тъ, ра́зꙋмъ . ты̀ бл҃гостыни ты̀ цр҃твꙋеши вовѣ́ки . А҆нтифо́нъ, г҃ .
items.english_text: Speaking theology unto the Holy Spirit, let us say: Thou art God, life, love, light, and understanding; Thou art goodness, and Thou reignest unto the ages!

items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ре́кшыхъ мнѣ̀, провни́демъ вдо́мы гнⷭ҇ѧ: ра́дости мно́ги и҆спо́лнимсѧ, моли́твы возсыла́юще .
items.english_text: Over those who said unto me: "Let us enter into the courts of the Lord," we are filled with great joy, sending up prayers.

items.slavonic_text: Водо́мꙋ дв҃дѣ стра́шнаѧ соверша́ютсѧ: ѡ҆́гнь бо та́мо пала̀ всѧ́къ сра́менъ оу҆́мъ .
items.english_text: In the house of David fearful things are accomplished: for there is a burning fire consuming every shameful mind.

items.slavonic_text: Ст҃ы́мъ дх҃омъ живонача́лною вла́стїю, ѿ него́же всѧ́къ живо́тъ вдыха́етсѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ же ѡ҆́ ѻ҆ц҃ы, кꙋ́пно же и҆ ѡ҆ сло́вѣ .
items.english_text: By the Holy Spirit is the life-originating sovereignty, from Whom all life is breathed forth, as from the Father, together with the Word.

items.slavonic_text: Та́ . прокї . Гла́ є҃ . Воскрⷭ҇ни гдⷭ҇и бж҃е мо́й да вознесе́тсѧ рꙋка̀ твоѧ̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ ты̀ цр҃твꙋеши вовѣ́ки . Ст҃и .
items.english_text: *Then the Prokeimenon, Tone 5: Arise, O Lord my God, let Thy hand be lifted up, for Thou reignest unto the ages. Verse: I will confess Thee, O Lord my God, with my whole heart.*

items.slavonic_text: Всѧ́ко дыха́нїе да хва́литъ гдⷭ҇а . ст҃и, Хвали́те бг҃а во ст҃ы́хъ є҆го̀ . Є҆ѵⷢ҇лїе, воскрⷭ҇но . Ѱало́мъ н҃ . Канѡ̀ воскрⷭ҇нъ, гла́ є҃ . Пѣ́снь а҃, І҆рмо́съ .
items.english_text: *Let every breath praise the Lord. Verse: Praise God in His saints. Matins Gospel, Resurrection. Psalm 50. Resurrection Canon, Tone 5. Ode 1. Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: [Инициал 'К'] Конѧ̀ и҆ вса́дника вмо́ре че́рмное, сокрꙋша́ѧй бра́ни мышцею высо́кою х҃е, и҆стрѧ́слъ є҆: і҆и҃лѧ же сп҃се побѣ́днꙋю пою́ща .
items.english_text: The horse and rider into the Red Sea, He Who shatters battles with a high arm, Christ has shaken off; and He has saved Israel singing a victory song.[^113]

items.slavonic_text: Тебѐ терконо́сное є҆ѵре́йское собо́рище, х҃е вѣнча̀: любвѐ ктебѣ̀ несохранѝ ма́терна . родонача́лникꙋ, разрѣша́юще терно́вное запреще́нїе .
items.english_text: The thorn-bearing congregation of the Hebrews crowned Thee, O Christ, keeping not maternal love toward Thee, the Author of the race, while releasing the curse of thorns.

items.slavonic_text: Воздви́же мѧ̀ па́дшаго жизнода́вче, вро́въ прекло́нсѧ поиска́въ: и҆ моѐ ѕлосмра́днꙋю тлю̀ х҃е претерпѣ́въ, неискꙋ́сно бж҃твеннымъ сꙋ́ществомъ, мѵ́ромъ мѧ̀ ѡ҆слагоꙋха́лъ є҆сѝ . Бг҃о .
items.english_text: Thou didst raise me up who had fallen, O Life-giver, having bowed down into the pit seeking me out; and having endured my foul-smelling corruption, O Christ, without suffering in Thy divine nature, Thou didst perfume me with sweet myrrh.

items.slavonic_text: Раздрꙋши́сѧ кла́тва, печа́ль преста̀: бл҃гослове́ннаѧ бо и҆ ѡ҆брадо́ваннаѧ, вѣ́рнымъ
items.english_text: The curse was abolished, grief ceased; for the blessed and favored one shone forth joy unto the faithful, bearing Christ as a flower of blessing unto all ends of the earth.

items.slavonic_text: возсїѧ̀ ра́дость . бл҃гослове́нїе всѣ́мъ коце́мъ цвѣ́тъ носѧ́щи хрⷭ҇та̀ .
items.english_text: *Another Canon, of the Cross and Resurrection. Heirmos: "Unto God the Savior":*

items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ Кано́нъ крⷭ҇товоскрⷭ҇нъ . І҆рмо́ . Сп҃сителю бг҃ꙋ .
items.english_text: Unto Him Who was nailed to the Cross in the flesh by His own will, and delivered fallen man of old from the ancient condemnation: unto Him alone let us sing, for He is glorified!

items.slavonic_text: Свое́ю во́лею на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригвожде́нномꙋ пло́тїю: и҆ дре́внаго и҆зрече́нїа, и҆́же дре́вле ра́ди па́дшаго свобо́ждшемꙋ, томꙋ̀ є҆ди́номꙋ воспое́мъ ꙗ҆́кѡ просла́висѧ .
items.english_text: Unto Him Who shone forth from the tomb upon the dead, and raised up with Himself those who were in Hades, and adorned the throne at the Father's right hand: unto Him let us all sing, for He is glorified!

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же и҆згрѡ́ба ме́ртвымъ возсїѧ́вшаго: и҆ сꙋ́щыѧ во а҆́дѣ совоздви́гшаго, и҆ сосѣде́нїе ѻ҆́ч҃еское оу҆краси́вшаго, того̀ всѝ воспое́мъ ꙗ҆́кѡ просла́висѧ . Бг҃о .
items.english_text: O all-undefiled Mother of God: unceasingly pray unto God Who was incarnate of thee and not separated from the Father's bosom, to save from every affliction those whom He fashioned.

items.slavonic_text: Прⷱ҇чтаѧ мт҃и бж҃їа, воплоще́ннаго и҆стебѐ . и҆ ѿ нѣ́дръ роди́телѧ неразлꙋ́чшасѧ бг҃а, непреста́нно молѝ . ѿ всѧ́кїа напа́сти спастѝ и҆́хъже созда̀ .
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos. Heirmos: "Horse and rider":*

items.slavonic_text: свѣти́вша мíра лꙋча́ми бж҃тва̀ . х҃а мл҃и просвѣти́ти всѧ̀ пою́щыѧ тѧ̀ мт҃и дв҃о .
items.english_text: O Virgin Mother, pray unto Christ, the Light Who made His abode in thee, O all-undefiled one, and illumined the world with the rays of His divinity, to enlighten all who sing of thee.

items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ оу҆краша́ема доброто́ю добродѣ́телей ѡ҆брадо́ваннаѧ , добротво́рное бл҃голѣ́пїе лꙋче́ю дх҃а пода́ть всечⷭ҇таѧ , и҆́же всѧ́чєскаѧ оу҆добри́вшаго .
items.english_text: Adorned as thou art with the beauty of virtues, O full of grace, the beneficent splendor was granted thee by the ray of the Spirit, O all-pure one, by Him Who has beautified all things.

items.slavonic_text: Тебѐ дре́вле проѡ҆бразꙋ́юща ѧ҆ кꙋпина̀ всѣна́нъ , неѡ҆пали́ма дв҃це , ѻ҆гню̀ совокꙋпльшисѧ : дв҃а бо роди́ла є҆сѝ , и҆ дв҃ою пребы́сть , па́че смы́сла бг҃оневѣ́сто .
items.english_text: Prefiguring thee of old, the bush burned on Sinai unconsumed, O Virgin, united with the fire; for a virgin thou didst give birth, and a virgin didst thou remain, beyond all understanding, O Bride of God.

items.slavonic_text: [Инициал 'О'] Оу҆тверже́й ниначе́мъ же зе́млю повеле́нїемъ сѝ , и҆ распрост҃ра́ннꙋъ неѡ҆держи́мꙋю тѧ́готꙋ : нанедвижи́момъ х҃е ка́мени за́повѣдей твои́хъ , цр҃ковь свою̀ оу҆твердѝ , є҆ди́не бл҃же , и҆ чл҃колꙋ́бче .
items.english_text: He Who by His command established the earth upon nothing, and suspended its unrestrained weight: upon the immovable rock of Thy commandments, O Christ, establish Thy Church, O only good One and Lover of mankind.[^114]

items.slavonic_text: Же́лчь оу҆́бѡ и҆́же ѿ ка́мене ме́дъ соса́вше ,
items.english_text: Gall indeed did those who sucked honey from the rock offer unto Thee, O Christ, Who didst work wonders in the wilderness; and vinegar instead of manna did they return for Thy benefits, the foolish children of Israel.

items.slavonic_text: и҆́же впꙋсты́ни чꙋдодѣ́йствовавшемꙋ , тебѣ̀ принеслѝ сꙋ́ть х҃е : ѡ҆́цетъ же за ма́ннꙋ , бл҃годѣѧ́нїа тѝ возда́ша , дѣ́ти І҆и҃левы неразꙋ́мнїи .
items.english_text: They who of old were covered by the light-bearing cloud laid Christ, our Life, in the tomb; but by His own sovereign power He arose, and grants unto all the faithful the mystical overshadowing brilliance of the Spirit from on high.

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же дре́вле свѣтови́днымъ ѻ҆́блакомъ покрыва́еми , живо́тъ вогро́бѣ х҃а положи́ша : но самовла́стно воскр҃съ всѣ́мъ вѣ́рнымъ пода́стъ , та́йно ѡ҆сѣнѧ́ющее свы́шше дх҃а сїѧ́нїе . Бг҃о .
items.english_text: Thou art the Mother of God ineffably: for without maternal travail didst thou bear Him Who shone forth from the incorruptible Father; therefore in orthodox manner we proclaim thee as Theotokos, for thou didst bear the incarnate Word.

items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ мт҃и бж҃їа неисчета́но бы́сть , и҆́же ѡ҆ нетлѣ́нна ѻ҆ц҃а возсїѧ́вшаго , кро́мѣ же болѣ́зней ма́тернихъ : тѣ́мже тѧ̀ бцⷣꙋ воплоще́нна бо родила є҆сѝ сло́ва , правосла́вно проповѣ́даемъ . И҆́нъ І҆рмо̑ . Си́лою крⷭ҇та̀ .
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: "By the power of the Cross":*

items.slavonic_text: Воскре́се ѿ гро́ба х҃е , тлѧ̀ сме́ртныѧ и҆зба́вль , воспѣва́ющихъ жизнода́вче тридне́вное твоѐ воста́нїе .
items.english_text: Thou didst arise from the tomb, O Christ, delivering from mortal corruption those who sing of Thy third-day resurrection, O Giver of life.

items.slavonic_text: Пома́зати тѣ́ло твоѐ мѵроно́сица х҃е тща́хꙋсѧ , и҆ неѡ҆брѣ́тше возвраща́хꙋсѧ , воспѣва́юще твоѐ воста́нїе . Бг҃о ,
items.english_text: The myrrh-bearing women hastened to anoint Thy body, O Christ, and not finding it, they returned singing of Thy resurrection.

items.slavonic_text: Молѝ непреста́нно чт҃аѧ , проше́дшаго и҆зчре́слъ твои́хъ , и҆зба́вити ѿ ле́стныѧ во́лѧ пою́щихъ тѧ̀ бж҃їю мт҃ръ .
items.english_text: Unceasingly pray, O pure one, unto Him Who came forth from thy womb, to deliver from deceitful desire those who praise thee as Mother of God.
