items.slavonic_text: Неискꙋ́снꙋ менѐ сп҃се мо́й, лѣ́ностїю грѣхо́вною ѡ҆держи́ма: но воздви́гни ми помышле́нїе к покаѧ́нїю, и҆ твое́го виногра́да дѣ́лателя и҆скꙋ́сна ꙗ҆ви́ мя: дарꙋ́й
items.english_text: Unto me who am inexpert, O my Savior, held fast by sinful slothfulness: arouse in me the thought of repentance, and reveal me as an expert laborer of Thy vineyard (Matthew 20:1–16); grant unto me the reward of the eleventh hour and great mercy!

items.office: MONDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND THE BODILESS POWERS
items.slavonic_text: мѝ є҆динагона́десѧте ча́са мздꙋ̀ и҆ ве́лїю ми́лость.
items.english_text: Come, all ye people, let us honor the passion-bearers of Christ with songs and spiritual hymns: the enlighteners of the world and preachers of the faith, the ever-flowing springs from whom healings pour forth unto the faithful; by their prayers, O Christ our God, grant peace unto all the world, and unto our souls great mercy!

items.office: MONDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND THE BODILESS POWERS
items.slavonic_text: Стр҃тоте́рпцы хв҃ы, прїиди́те лю́дїе всѝ почте́мъ, пѣ́нми и҆ пѣ́снми дх҃овны́ми, просвѣ́щники мі́рꙋ, и҆ проповѣ́дники вѣ́рѣ, и҆сто́чники при́сно текꙋ́щїя, и҆з̾ ни́хъ же и҆сточа́ются вѣ́рнымъ и҆сцѣле́нїя: тѣ́хъ мл҃тва́ми х҃е бж҃е на́шъ, ми́ръ дарꙋ́й всемꙋ̀ мі́рꙋ, и҆ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ ве́лїи ми́лость.
items.english_text: Receiving the prayers of sinners, and despising not the sighs of the afflicted: pray Thy Son Who came forth from thy womb, that we may be saved, O most holy Virgin!

items.office: MONDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND THE BODILESS POWERS
items.slavonic_text: Грѣ́шныхъ мл҃твы прїе́млющи, и҆ скорбѧ́щихъ воздыха́нїя непрезира́ющи: молѝ и҆́же ѿ чре́вꙋ твое́ю сн҃а своего̀, спасти́ся на́мъ прест҃ая дв҃о.
items.english_text: *On Monday, Beatitudes of Repentance, Tone 1:*

items.office: MONDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND THE BODILESS POWERS
items.slavonic_text: помяни́ мя̀ вопїю́ща во црⷭ҇твїи сѝ.
items.english_text: For the sake of eating, the enemy led Adam out of Paradise, but by the Cross, O Christ, the thief was brought into it (Luke 23:42–43), crying: Remember me in Thy kingdom!

items.office: MONDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND THE BODILESS POWERS
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆миле́нїя и҆сто́чникъ мѝ дарꙋ́й, млⷭ҇рдія твое́го х҃е бж҃е, вся́кихъ мя̀ скве́рнъ ѕлы́хъ и҆ безмѣ́рныхъ ѡ҆чи́сти, и҆ црⷭ҇твїя твое́го бл҃годѣ́телю прича́стника мя̀ сотворѝ.
items.english_text: Grant me a fountain of compunction from Thy tender mercy, O Christ God; cleanse me from all evil and boundless defilements, and make me a partaker of Thy kingdom, O Benefactor!

items.office: MONDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND THE BODILESS POWERS
items.slavonic_text: А҆́гглъ твои́хъ чи́ны в моле́нїе тѝ приво́димъ, сп҃си и҆ оу҆ще́дри на́съ тѣ́хъ ра́ди, ꙗ҆́кѡ пребл҃гъ, вся̑ презира́я на́ша согрѣше́нїя, ꙗ҆́же в вѣ́дѣнїи и҆ невѣ́дѣнїи.
items.english_text: We bring before Thee the ranks of Thine angels in supplication; save and have compassion on us for their sake, as Thou art all-good, overlooking all our transgressions, both in knowledge and in ignorance!

items.office: MONDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND THE BODILESS POWERS
items.slavonic_text: Кро́вїй ва́шыхъ ст҃і́и тече́нїемъ, мы́сленаго фараѡ́на потопи́сте ꙗ҆́вѣ: нн҃ѣ же и҆сточа́ете чꙋде́семъ стрꙋя̀, пꙋчи́нꙋ и҆зсꙋша́юще болѣ́зней, тѣ́мже бл҃жи́ми є҆стѐ. Сла́.
items.english_text: By the outpouring of your blood, O holy ones, ye manifestly drowned the noetic Pharaoh; and now ye pour forth streams of wonders, drying up the deep of illnesses; therefore are ye blessed. *Glory:*

items.office: MONDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND THE BODILESS POWERS
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь трист҃ꙋю вѣ́рні́и гла́сомъ со а҆́гглы возопїе́мъ: ст҃ъ є҆сѝ ѿче со сн҃омъ же и҆ дх҃омъ: сп҃си на́съ вопїю́щихъ тѝ є҆дино-
items.english_text: With the angels, we the faithful with loud voice cry out the Thrice-Holy song: Holy art Thou, Father, with the Son and Spirit; save us who cry unto Thee: O Trinity consubstantial, one God! *Both now. Theotokion:*

items.office: MONDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND THE BODILESS POWERS
items.slavonic_text: сꙋ́щная трⷪ҇це є҆дини́це бж҃е. И҆ Нн҃ѣ .
items.english_text: O all-immaculate one who didst bear the unwaning Light: illumine my soul which is ever darkened by demonic assaults, and snatch me from the coming fire, O most holy one!

items.slavonic_text: Ро́ждшая свѣ́тъ незаходи́мый, всенепоро́чная ѡ҆мраче́ннꙋю мѝ при́сно бѣсо́вскими прило́ги дш҃ꙋ просвѣтѝ, и҆ ѻ҆гня̀ бꙋ́дꙋщаго прест҃ая и҆схытѝ.
items.english_text: *On Monday evening, at "Lord, I have cried": Idiomelon Stichera, Tone 2:*[^213]

items.slavonic_text: В Понеде́локъ ве́, на Гдⷭ҇и воззва̀: стїхи̑ры самогла́, Гла́с в҃.
items.english_text: I have surpassed all in sin; what repentance shall I learn? If I sigh as the publican (Luke 18:13), I think to weigh down the heavens; if I shed tears as the harlot (Luke 7:38), with my tears I defile the earth; but grant me forgiveness of sins, O God, have mercy on me!

items.slavonic_text: да́ждь мѝ и҆справле́нїе, є҆ди́не бл҃гі́й бж҃е и҆ поми́лꙋй.
items.english_text: Every sin have I committed; I have surpassed all in wantonness; if I wish to repent, I have no streams of tears; if I reap now in slothfulness, I shall be guilty of torment. But grant me amendment, O only Good God, and have mercy!

items.slavonic_text: Тꙋ́чꙋ мѝ пода́ждь х҃е слеза́мъ, бж҃твеннаго оу҆миле́нїя ꙗ҆́кѡ ще́дръ: ꙗ҆́кѡ да пла́чꙋся, и҆ ѡ҆мы́ю скве́рнꙋ и҆́же ѡ҆ сласте́й, и҆ ꙗ҆влю́ся тѝ ѡ҆чище́нъ: внегда̀ сꙋді́е съ нб҃се хо́щеши прїитѝ гдⷭ҇и, сꙋди́ти чл҃кѡмъ: ꙗ҆́кѡ сꙋді́и є҆ди́нъ пра́веденъ.
items.english_text: Grant me a cloud of tears, O Christ, of divine compunction, as Thou art compassionate, that I may weep and wash away the defilement that comes from pleasures, and appear unto Thee purified, when as Judge from heaven Thou shalt come, O Lord, to judge mankind, as the only righteous Judge!

items.slavonic_text: И҆́ны Стїхи̑ры, Ст҃о́мꙋ Пррⷱ҇кꙋ І҆ѡа́ннꙋ, Прⷱ҇те́чи,
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, to the Holy Prophet and Forerunner John, Tone 2.*

items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, в҃. Подо́бенъ, Е҆гда̀ ѿ дре́ва тя̀.
items.english_text: O preacher of Christ and Baptist: angel, apostle, martyr, prophet, forerunner, luminary, close friend, seal of the prophets, most honorable of those born of women, mediator of the Old and New grace, radiant voice of the Word: by thy sacred intercessions, set right our prayerful petitions unto the compassionate God!

items.slavonic_text: Проповѣ́дниче хв҃ъ и҆ крⷭ҇ти́телю: а҆́ггле, а҆пл҃е, мч҃нче, пррⷱ҇че, прⷱ҇те́че, свѣ́щниче, дрꙋ́же бли́жнїй, пррⷱ҇кѡмъ печа́ть, рожде́нныхъ пречестнѣ́йшій, хода́таи ве́тхой и҆ но́вой блгⷭ҇ти, свѣ́тлыи сло́вꙋ гла́се, твои́ми сщ҃еными хода́тайствы, мл҃твеннаѧ тво́ренїа, к бг҃ꙋ бл҃гоꙋтро́бномꙋ и҆спра́ви.
items.english_text: “Behold, the Lamb of God Who takes away the sin of the world!” (John 1:29) thou didst cry out, O blessed Forerunner, when thou sawest Christ walking upon the earth; pray Him therefore to grant forgiveness of sins unto those who honor thee: for thou hast indeed great boldness before Him, O Baptist, as mediator of the Law and grace!

items.slavonic_text: Сѐ а҆́гнецъ бж҃і́й, и҆́же грѣхѝ мі́рꙋ взе́мляй, возопи́лъ є҆сѝ прⷱ҇те́че бл҃же́нне, внегда̀ ви́дѣ х҃а на землѝ ходя́ща. того̀ оу҆́бѡ молѝ, грѣхѡ́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїе дарова́ти, тебѐ почита́ющимъ: и҆́маши бо к немꙋ̀ ве́лїе вои́стинꙋ дерзнове́нїе крести́телю, ꙗ҆́кѡ хода́таи зако́нꙋ и҆ блгⷭ҇ти.
items.english_text: Make haste and deliver me from temptations, O glorious prophet and intercessor of the Lord! For all have risen up against me, the bitter demons warring against me, seeking to seize the soul of thy unworthy servant as a bird; leave me not utterly, that they may know rather from thy deeds that thou art my refuge!

items.slavonic_text: шїе: м҃ти всѣ́хъ цр҃я, и҆ бж҃тве́нный пре́тече, мо́лбꙋ сотвори́те вкꙋ́пѣ ѡ҆ рабѣ̀ ѕѣ́ло прогнѣ́вавшемъ бл҃гоми́лостиваго, ꙗ҆́кѡ да оу҆ще́дритъ и҆ сп҃сетъ, ва́шими прекло́нся хода́тайствы, и҆ ѻ҆́гненнаго ро́дства и҆змѣ́нитъ мя̀.
items.english_text: As by natural kinship and prayerful agreement, with one soul O Mother of the King of all, and divine Forerunner, make supplication together for the servant who has greatly angered the merciful One, that being moved by your intercessions, He may have compassion and save, and deliver me from kinship with the fire!

items.slavonic_text: На стїхо́внѣ Стїхи̑ры Покаѧ́нны. Гла́съ, в҃.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of Repentance, Tone 2:*

items.slavonic_text: Согрѣши́хъ тѝ х҃е сп҃се, ꙗ҆́кѡ блꙋ́дный сн҃ъ, прїими́ мя ѿ́че ка́ющася, и҆ поми́лꙋй мя̀ бж҃е:
items.english_text: I have sinned against Thee, O Christ Savior, as the prodigal son (Luke 15:11–32); receive me, O Father, as I repent, and have mercy on me, O God!

items.slavonic_text: Вопїю́ ти х҃е сп҃се мыта́ревы гла́сы, ѡ҆чи́сти мя̀ ꙗ҆́коже ѡ҆́наго и҆ помл҃ꙋй мя̀ бж҃е. М҃.
items.english_text: I cry unto Thee, O Christ Savior, with the voices of the publican (Luke 18:13): Cleanse me as him, and have mercy on me, O God! *Martyrikon:*

items.slavonic_text: Ст҃ы̑мъ мч҃нкѡмъ молѧ́щимся ѡ҆ на́съ, и҆ х҃а пою́щимъ: вся́ка ле́сть преста̀, и҆ чл҃ческій ро́дъ вѣ́рнѡ сп҃са́ется. Сла́ и҆ нн҃ѣ, бг҃о.
items.english_text: While the holy martyrs pray for us and hymn Christ, all deceit has ceased, and the human race is faithfully saved. *Glory, both now. Theotokion:*

items.slavonic_text: Непроходи́мая две́ри, та́йно запеча́тлѣнная, блгⷭ҇ве́нная бц҃е дв҃о: прїими́ моли́-
items.english_text: O impassable gate, mystically sealed (Ezekiel 44:2), blessed Virgin Theotokos: receive our prayers and bring them unto thy Son and our God, that for thy sake He may save our souls!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: твы на́ша, и҆ принесѝ я̀ сн҃ꙋ твоемꙋ̀ и҆ бг҃ꙋ на́шемꙋ, да сп҃сетъ тебѐ ра́ди дꙋ́ша на́ша.
items.english_text: *On Tuesday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma: Sessional Hymns of Repentance, Tone 2:*[^215]

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: В Вто́рокъ на Оу҆́трни, по а҃. Стїхоло́гїи Сѣда́лна покаѧ́нны Гла́съ вторы́й.
items.english_text: Like sea waves, my transgressions have risen up against me, and like a ship in the deep, I alone am submerged by many sins; but guide me unto the calm haven of repentance, O Lord, and save me!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ во́лны морскі́я воста́ша на́ мя безако́нїа моя̀, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ кора́бль в пꙋчи́нѣ а҆́зъ є҆ди́нъ погрꙋжа́юся согрѣше́ньми мно́гими: но в ти́хое приста́нище покаѧ́нїа, наста́ви мя̀ гдⷭ҇и и҆ сп҃си́ мя.
items.english_text: I am a barren tree, O Lord (Luke 13:6–9); I have brought forth no fruit of repentance at all, and I fear the cutting down, and dread that unquenchable fire; therefore I pray Thee: before that calamity, turn me back and save me! *Glory, both now. Theotokion:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: А҆́зъ є҆́смъ дре́во непло́дное гдⷭ҇и, покаѧ́нїа пло́да непринесо́хъ ѿню́дъ, и҆ посѣче́нїа бою́ся, и҆ ѻ҆гня̀ ѡ҆́наго оу҆страша́юся негаси́маго: тѣ́мже тя̀ молѝ, пре́жде ѡ҆́ныя бѣды̀ ѡ҆брати́ и҆ сп҃си́ мя. Сла́ и҆ нн҃ѣ, бг҃о.
items.english_text: Partakers of the divine nature have we become through thee, O Virgin Theotokos (2 Peter 1:4); for thou didst bear God incarnate for us; therefore worthily we all piously magnify thee. *After the 2nd Kathisma: Sessional Hymns, Tone 2:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Поми́лꙋй мя̀ бж҃е речѐ дв҃дъ, и҆ а҆́зъ тебѣ̀ вопїю̀, согрѣши́хъ сп҃се: моя̑ грѣхѝ покаѧ́нїемъ ѡ҆чи́стивъ, и҆ поми́лꙋй мя̀.
items.english_text: “Have mercy on me, O God,” said David (Psalm 50:1), and I cry unto Thee: I have sinned, O Savior; having cleansed my sins through repentance, have mercy on me!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Поми́лꙋй мя̀ бж҃е поми́лꙋй мя̀, ѡ҆ дво́ю грѣхꙋ̀ пла́каше дв҃дъ, а҆́зъ же ѡ҆ тма́хъ прегрѣше́нїихъ вопїю́ ти. ѽ҆́нъ посте́лю слеза́ми ѡ҆мака́ше, а҆́зъ же ка́плю є҆ди́нꙋ нестажа́хъ: ѿча́явся и҆ молѝ: поми́лꙋй мя̀ бж҃е по вели́цей мл҃ти твое́й.
items.english_text: “Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy on me!” Over two sins wept David (2 Samuel 11–12), but I cry unto Thee concerning myriad transgressions; he bedewed his bed with tears (Psalm 6:6), yet I have acquired not a single tear; being in despair, I pray: Have mercy on me, O God, according to Thy great mercy!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: А҆́пли пррⷱ҇цы и҆ мч҃нци, ст҃и́телїе прпⷣбні́и и҆ пра́ведні́и, и҆́же до́брѣ по́двигъ сконча́вше, и҆ вѣ́рꙋ соблю́дше: дерзнове́нїе и҆мꙋ́ще ко сп҃сꙋ, ѡ҆ на́съ моли́те ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃га, сп҃ти́ся мо́лимся дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ. Сла́ и҆ Нн҃ѣ, Бг҃о.
items.english_text: Apostles, prophets, and martyrs, holy hierarchs, venerable and righteous ones, who have finished the good fight and kept the faith (2 Timothy 4:7): having boldness before the Savior, pray for us as He is good, we pray, that our souls may be saved! *Glory, both now. Theotokion:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Бц҃е непре́зри менѐ тре́бꙋющїя застꙋпле́нїя и҆ по́мощи ꙗ҆́же ѿ тебѐ, на́ тя бо оу҆пова̀ дꙋша̀ моя̀, и҆ поми́лꙋй мя̀.
items.english_text: O Theotokos, despise me not who need the protection and help that come from thee; for in thee my soul has put its hope, and have mercy on me!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: По г҃. стїхоло̃ Сѣда̃ Гла́съ, в҃. Милⷭ҇рдїя сꙋ́щи.
items.english_text: *After the 3rd Kathisma: Sessional Hymn, Tone 2.*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Млⷭ҇рдїя ра́ди мл҃ти бл҃же, сп҃тѝ своѐ созда́нїе х҃е прїи́де, прекло́нь нб҃са схожде́нїемъ свои́мъ: тѣ́мже стра́шное смотре́нїе твоѐ пою́ще вопїе́мъ тѝ: мольба́ми прⷱ҇те́ча твое́го, ѡ҆чище́нїе грѣхѡ́мъ пода́ждь на́мъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ бл҃гоꙋтро́бенъ. Сла́ и҆ Нн҃ѣ, Бг҃о.
items.english_text: For the sake of the mercy of Thy compassion, O Good One, Thou didst come to save Thy creation, O Christ, having bowed down the heavens by Thy descent (Psalm 17:9); therefore hymning Thy fearful dispensation, we cry unto Thee: By the supplications of Thy Forerunner, grant us cleansing of sins, as Thou alone art tenderly compassionate! *Glory, both now. Theotokion:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Предста́телнице те́плая хрⷭ҇тїа́нѡмъ, сн҃ꙋ моли́ся при́снѡ бц҃е, вся́каго злодѣ́йства и҆ ѡ҆горче́нїя и҆зба́вити на́съ борца̀, и҆ да́ти на́мъ проще́нїе вни́хже согрѣши́хомъ, за млⷭ҇рдїе щедро́тъ твои́ми моли́твами мт҃и дв҃о. *Та́жъ Ѱало́мъ н҃.
items.english_text: Fervent Protectress of Christians, pray unceasingly unto thy Son, O Theotokos, to deliver us from every malice and bitterness of the adversary, and to grant us forgiveness wherein we have sinned, for the tender compassion of His mercies, through thy prayers, O Mother Virgin! *Then Psalm 50.*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Кано́нъ оу҆миле́нїя. Гла́съ, в҃. Пѣ́снь а҃: І҆рмо́съ.
items.english_text: *Canon of Compunction, Tone 2. Ode 1: Heirmos:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Мѡѷсе́йскꙋю пѣ́снь воспрїи́мше возопі́й дш҃е: помо́щникъ и҆ покрови́тель, бы́сть мнѣ̀ во сп҃се́нїе, се́й ми бг҃ъ, и҆ просла́влю є҆го̀.
items.english_text: Taking up the song of Moses, cry aloud, O soul: He was unto me a Helper and Protector for salvation; this is my God, and I will glorify Him (Exodus 15:2)!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: ꙗ҆́кѡ да слеза́ми до́блими, оу҆бѣжи́мъ тогда̀ сле́зъ мꙋче́нїа ничто́же и҆мꙋ́щихъ поле́зно.
items.english_text: Let us weep bitterly for ourselves, brethren, before our departure that by valiant tears we may then escape the tears of torment, which have nothing beneficial!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Тма́ми х҃е завѣща́хъ пока́ѧтися, нечꙋ́вственнꙋ дш҃ꙋ и҆мѣ́я, во прегрѣше́нїя впада́ю, оу҆ще́дри сп҃се не́мощь мою̀. М҃.
items.english_text: A myriad of times, O Christ, have I promised to repent, yet having an insensible soul, I fall into transgressions; have compassion, O Savior, upon my infirmity! *Martyrikon:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же мꙋче́нїя ѻ҆́гнь претерпѣ́вше, бж҃е́ственны[мъ] ѡ҆роше́нїемъ страстоно́сцы хв҃и, ѻ҆гня̀ ге́енны и҆зба́вите мя̀, во страсте́хъ лю́тыхъ лежа́щаго. Мꙋ́чен[иченъ].
items.english_text: Ye who endured the fire of torment by divine dew, O passion-bearers of Christ, deliver me from the fire of Gehenna, who lie in grievous passions! *Martyrikon:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пци на врагѝ ꙗ҆́вльшеся, си́лою бж҃е́ственною: некрѣ́постнꙋю и҆́хъ низложи́сте си́лꙋ, мч҃нци хв҃и достобл҃же́нні́и. Бг҃о.
items.english_text: Shown forth as mighty against the enemies by divine power, ye cast down their powerless strength, O worthily blessed martyrs of Christ! *Theotokion:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Пламенноно́сная клѣ́ще, ꙗ҆́же І҆са́їа ви́дѣ и҆ногда̀, веще́ственныя срⷣца мое́го стра́сти дв҃о мт҃и попалѝ, и҆ до конца̀ потребѝ.
items.english_text: O tongs bearing the burning coal which Isaiah once beheld (Isaiah 6:6), burn up the material passions of my heart, O Virgin Mother, and destroy them utterly!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ Кано̃ Ст҃о́мꙋ Пррⷱ҇кꙋ Прⷱ҇те́чи І҆ѡа́ннꙋ.
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Holy Prophet and Forerunner John. Ode 1: Heirmos: Of old He drowned in the deep:*[^217]

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́нь, а҃. І҆рмо́съ. Воглꙋбинѣ̀ потопѝ дре́вле.
items.english_text: O Baptist and Forerunner of Christ, strengthen my mind which is ever submerged in bodily pleasures, and calm the waves of passions, that being in divine calm, I may ever glorify thee!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇ти́телю прⷱ҇тче хв҃ъ, погрꙋжа́емый всегда̀ сла́достми тѣле́сными оу҆́мъ мо́й оу҆крѣпѝ, и҆ во́лны страсте́й оу҆кротѝ: ꙗ҆́кѡ да в тишинѣ̀ бж҃тве́ннѣй бы́въ, прⷭ҇но сла́влю тя̀.
items.english_text: Thou wast illumined with unsearchable illumination; like a radiant star, thou didst run before the noetic Orient (Luke 1:78), by Whom pray, O Baptist, that my heart may be illumined, darkened by all demonic assaults!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Недоꙋмѣ́ннымъ просвѣти́ся просвѣще́нїемъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ многосвѣ́тлая ѕвѣзда̀, мы́сленномꙋ восто́кꙋ преди́те́клъ є҆сѝ, и҆́мже ѡ҆зари́тися срⷣцꙋ моемꙋ̀ крⷭ҇ти́телю молѝ, ѡ҆мраче́нномꙋ всѣ́ми бѣсо́вскими приложе́нїи.
items.english_text: In the river thou didst once immerse the Abyss, O all-wise one, causing the flood of all transgression to cease by grace; but I pray thee, O most rich one: dry up the streams of my transgressions by thy divine mediation! *Theotokion:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: бы́лъ є҆сѝ бл҃же́нне прⷱ҇те́че: с̾не́нже тя̀ чте́мъ и҆ мо́лимъ, и҆́же во нбⷭ҇нѣмъ хра́мѣ твое́мъ нн҃ѣ живꙋ́ще, хра́мы и҆ на́съ сотворѝ дх҃ꙋ ст҃о́мꙋ. *Пѣ́нь г҃, І҆рмо́съ.
items.english_text: The kinsman of the pure Virgin who bore God incarnate thou wast, O blessed Forerunner; therefore we honor and pray thee: living now in thy heavenly temple, make us also temples of the Holy Spirit (1 Corinthians 6:19)! *Ode 3: Heirmos:*[^218]

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Непло́днаго мѝ оу҆ма̀, плодоно́сна бж҃е ꙗ҆вствѝ: дѣ́лателю дꙋша́мъ, и҆ насади́телю бл҃ги́мъ милосе́рдїемъ сѝ.
items.english_text: Make my barren mind fruitful, O God, O Husbandman of souls and Planter of good things by Thy tender mercy!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Лѣ́ностнымъ дрѣма́нїемъ, ѡ҆тяготи́хъ дш҃ꙋ, воздви́гни мя̀ х҃е ко бдѣ́нїю покаѧ́нїа, твори́ти твоя̑ повелѣ́нїа.
items.english_text: With slumberous slothfulness have I weighed down my soul; arouse me, O Christ, unto the vigilance of repentance, to do Thy commandments!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Не ꙗ҆вѝ менѐ і҃се мо́й во дн҃ь стра́шный посрамле́нна, но пре́жде конца̀ ѡ҆врати́въ, лю́тыя и҆зба́ви мꙋ́ки. Мꙋ́ченъ.
items.english_text: Show me not to be put to shame, O my Jesus, in the fearful day, but turning me back before the end, deliver me from grievous torment! *Martyrikon:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же стра́стемъ хв҃ымъ оу҆подо́бльшееся до́брѣ, бж҃твенными ѡ҆́бразы страстоте́рпци честні́и, дш҃а моеѧ̀ го́ркїя стра́сти и҆сцѣли́те. Мꙋ́ченъ.
items.english_text: Having well imitated the sufferings of Christ in divine manners, O venerable passion-bearers, heal the bitter passions of my soul! *Martyrikon:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Да̀ и҆́же на нб҃се́хъ, присносꙋ́щнымъ благи̑мъ сподо́битеся, вся́ко и҆скꙋше́нїе лю́тыхъ, страстоно́сци на земли́ крѣ́пко претерпѣ́сте. Бг҃о,
items.english_text: That ye might be vouchsafed the everlasting good things in the heavens, O passion-bearers, ye steadfastly endured every temptation of afflictions on earth! *Theotokion:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Дои́ши ма́теролѣ́пно, пита́теля всѣ́мъ, и҆ но́сиши сего̀ на рꙋкꙋ̀ чтⷭ҇ая, и҆́же вся́ческаѧ рꙋко́ю нося́щаго. *И҆́нъ І҆рмо̃. На ка́ме̃.
items.english_text: In motherly manner thou sucklest the Nourisher of all, and holdest Him in thy arms, O pure one, Who upholds all things by His hand! *Another Heirmos: On the rock [of faith]:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣлѝ стро́пы дш҃а моеѧ̀ и҆ оу҆́мъ мо́й ѡ҆мраче́нный лѣ́ностїи, ѡ҆зарѝ бж҃твеннымъ сѝ хода́тайствомъ гнⷭ҇ь прⷱ҇те́че, и҆ вся́кихъ и҆зба́ви мя̀ сопроти́вныхъ ѡ҆бстоя́ні́й молю́ся.
items.english_text: Heal the wounds of my soul, and illumine my mind darkened by slothfulness through thy divine mediation, O Forerunner of the Lord, and deliver me from all hostile assaults, I pray!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Непло́дствїе раздрѣши́лъ є҆сѝ ро́ждшой, роди́вся бж҃їимъ промы́шле́нїемъ премꙋ́дре пррⷱ҇че. непло́дное оу҆́бѡ срⷣце моѐ, плодоно́сно нн҃ѣ содѣ́лай хода́тайствомъ сѝ, добродѣ́телей приноси́ти и҆зраще́нїа.
items.english_text: Thou didst loose the barrenness of her who bare thee, having been born by God's providence, O all-wise prophet (Luke 1:7, 57); make now therefore my barren heart fruitful through thy mediation, to bring forth the sprouts of virtues!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же любо́вїю тѝ созда́ннаго бж҃тве́ннаго хра́ма, вы́шнягѡ житїя̀ оу҆лꙋчи́ти молѝ. и҆́же вѣ́рою хра́мꙋ твое́мꙋ слꙋжа́щя, хра́мы дх҃ꙋ бж҃тве́нномꙋ сотворѝ, крⷭ҇ти́телю и҆ прⷱ҇те́че мл҃твами. Бг҃о.
items.english_text: Pray that he who built this divine temple unto thee with love may attain unto life on high; and those who serve thy temple with faith, make them temples of the divine Spirit by thy prayers, O Baptist and Forerunner! *Theotokion:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Весели́тся прⷱ҇те́ча в ложесна́хъ носи́мъ ма́тернихъ, и҆ покланя́шеся гдⷭ҇ꙋ носи́мꙋ во оу҆тро́бѣ твое́й бг҃орадо́ванная. є҆го́же молѝ, ѿ вся́кїя ско́рби и҆зба́вити на́съ.
items.english_text: The Forerunner rejoiced while being carried in his mother's womb, and bowed down before the Lord carried in thy womb, O woman full of grace (Luke 1:41, 44); pray Him to deliver us from all affliction!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ѿ дв҃ы твоѐ ржⷭ҇тво, пррⷱ҇къ предзря̀ проповѣ́даше вопїя̀: слꙋ́хъ тво́й оу҆слы́шахъ и҆ оу҆боя́хся, ꙗ҆́кѡ ѿ ю҆́га ѿ горы̀ ст҃ыя посѣне́нныя прише́лъ є҆сѝ х҃е.
items.english_text: *Ode 4: Heirmos:*[^219]

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆кра́дена ѿвсю́дꙋ, и҆ ѡ҆бнища́вша мя̀ сло́ве, зря̀ вра́гъ поги́бель мою̀ ра́дꙋется, и҆́же ле́сти мꙋдре́цъ, гдⷭ҇и сла́вѣ, и҆ ѡ҆богати́телю
items.english_text: Foreseeing Thy birth from the Virgin, the prophet proclaimed, crying: I heard report of Thee and was afraid, for from the south, from the holy and overshadowed mountain art Thou come, O Christ (Habakkuk 3:2–3)!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: ти́телю оу҆бо́гимъ: того́ мя злодѣ́йствїя и҆́зми.
items.english_text: Robbed on every side and impoverished, O Word, the enemy beholds my ruin and rejoices, he that is skilled in deceit; O Lord of glory and Enricher of the poor, deliver me from his malice!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Рꙋ́цѣ и҆ ѻ҆́чи ѡ҆скверни́хъ гдⷭ҇и, дѣ́я ꙗ҆́же недосто́итъ твори́ти, и҆ в я́рость подвиго́хъ щедро́ты твоя̑, и҆жды́въ долготерпѣ́нїе, но оу҆ще́дри сп҃си мя̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гъ.
items.english_text: My hands and eyes have I defiled, O Lord, doing what is unfitting to do, and I have provoked Thy mercies unto wrath, having exhausted Thy longsuffering; but have compassion and save me, as Thou art good!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Ко́ль ди́венъ бг҃ъ на́шъ во ст҃ы́хъ є҆́сть, вѣ́рꙋющимъ внего̀, и҆ разорѧ́ющимъ и҆стꙋ́канныя поги́бели, и҆ наслѣ́довавши ра́йское простра́нство, ѿне́гоже дре́вле и҆згна́нъ бы́сть а҆да́мъ. Мꙋ́чен[иченъ].
items.english_text: How marvelous is our God in His saints (Psalm 67:36), unto those who believe in Him and destroy the carved idols of ruin, and have inherited the spaciousness of Paradise, from whence Adam was driven out of old!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїемъ кро́вїй бл҃же́нні́и, оу҆ста́вите кро́вь приноси́мꙋю и҆ногда̀, бѣ́сомъ ги́белнꙋю, напоги́бель прельще́ннымъ принося́щи чл҃кѡмъ: сегѡ̀ ра́ди оу҆блажа́етеся при́снѡ. Бг҃о,
items.english_text: By the stream of your blood, O blessed ones, ye caused to cease the destructive blood once offered unto demons, which brought perdition unto deceived men; therefore are ye ever called blessed. *Theotokion:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: ли́къ, є҆́же па́че оу҆ма̀ твоѐ та́инꙋ бц҃е, разли́чнѡ ѡ҆́бразнѡ сі́и предначерта́ютъ сщ҃енными ѡ҆́бразы, и҆́мже коне́цъ зри́мъ и҆здале́ча. *И҆́нъ І҆рмо́съ, Прише́ствовавъ.
items.english_text: Taught by the Spirit, the glorious prophetic choir in diverse manners prefigured through sacred figures thy mystery that is beyond mind, O Theotokos, the fulfillment whereof we behold from afar. *Another Heirmos: Having come:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Прекло́ншемꙋ нб҃са и҆ чл҃кѡмъ примѣси́вшемся: главꙋ̀ преклони́лъ є҆сѝ, десни́цею свое́ю пребога́те: є҆́юже мя̀ сохранѝ во смире́нїи соблюда́я срⷣце моѐ.
items.english_text: Unto Him Who bowed down the heavens and mingled with men (Psalm 17:9), thou didst bow down His head with thy right hand, O most rich one; by which keep me, preserving my heart in humility!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Пꙋсты́ни тебѐ граждани́на непрохо́дна и҆ мꙋ́щи бл҃же́не прⷱ҇те́че: тѣ́мже вопїю́ ти, пꙋсты́ню вся́ческихъ бж҃тве́нныхъ дѣя́ні́й бы́вшꙋ, дш҃ꙋ мою̀ сотворѝ плодоно́снꙋ.
items.english_text: The impassable desert having thee as a citizen, O blessed Forerunner: therefore I cry unto thee: Make my soul fruitful, which has become a desert of all divine deeds!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Зако́нъ бж҃тве́нный оу҆правля́я, беззако́нно закала́ешися. тѣ́мже мо́лимся тѝ, беззако́ннꙋюща мя̀ всегда̀, и҆ потопля́ема бѣсо́вскими прельще́нїи и҆спра́ви.
items.english_text: Guiding the divine law, thou wast unlawfully slain (Matthew 14:1–12); therefore we pray thee: Set me right, who ever act lawlessly and am submerged by demonic deceits!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Созда́въ са́мъ себѣ̀ хра́мъ влⷣцѣ цр҃ю, к бж҃е-
items.english_text: Having prepared for thyself a temple unto the Master and King thou hast now entered into the divine dwellings, O Forerunner; pray that he who erected a most holy temple unto thee may obtain them! *Theotokion:*[^220]

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: бж҃твеннымъ жили́щемъ нн҃ѣ прише́лъ є҆сѝ прⷱ҇те́че, и҆́хже полꙋчи́ти молѝ и҆́же тебѣ̀ прест҃ы́й хра́мъ воздви́гшаго. Бг҃о.
items.english_text: Look upon me who am diseased, O all-immaculate one, and loose my grievous and hard-to-heal passions, that I may magnify thee who hast magnified all mankind!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: При́зри на́ мя боля́щаго всенепоро́чная, и҆ разрѣшѝ стра́сти моя̑ лю̑тая и҆ неꙋдо́бь и҆сцѣ̑лныя, ꙗ҆́кѡ да велича́ю тя̀, возвели́чившꙋю всѐ чл҃чество. *Пѣ́сь є҃, І҆рмо́съ.
items.english_text: Having driven away the darkness of my soul, O my Savior, illumine me with the light of Thy commandments, O only King of humility!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Мглꙋ̀ дш҃а моеѧ̀ сп҃се мо́й ѡ҆гна́въ, свѣ́томъ за́повѣде́й твои́хъ ѡ҆зари́ мя, є҆ди́не цр҃ю смире́нїа.
items.english_text: I mingled myself with sins and foolishly sinned, and there is no lifting up in my death; woe is me, how shall I appear before Christ?

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Грѣхѡ́мъ примѣша́хся безꙋ́мно согрѣши[хъ], и҆ восклоне́нїа нѣ́сть во сме́рти мое́й: оу҆вы́ мнѣ̀ ка́ко ꙗ҆влю́ся х҃ви.
items.english_text: Suffering shipwreck like a vessel, I lost the cargo which Thou gavest me, O Merciful One; and now being impoverished, I cry: Despise me not, O Christ! *Martyrikon:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: емꙋ́ю: нн҃ѣ страстоте́рпци сподо́битеся сла́вѣ, пребыва́юще со х҃томъ. М҃.
items.english_text: Having despised earthly and trampled-upon glory now, O passion-bearers, ye are vouchsafed glory, abiding with Christ! *Martyrikon:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Любвѐ ꙗ҆́же к пло́ти, оу҆́мъ ѿлꙋча́вше вѣ́рою, мꙋ́ки оу҆сво́исте любе́зно страстоте́рпцы, оу҆свое́ми х҃тꙋ. Бг҃о.
items.english_text: Severing the mind by faith from the love of the flesh, ye gladly embraced torments, O passion-bearers, being made Christ's own! *Theotokion:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Данїи́лъ тя̀ го́рꙋ ве́лїю дх҃омъ зря́ше бц҃е, ѿнея́же ка́мень ѿсѣче́ся, сокрꙋша́я бѣ́сѡмъ и҆стꙋ́канная. *И҆́нъ І҆рмо́съ. Просвѣще́нїе.
items.english_text: Daniel in the Spirit beheld thee as a great mountain, O Theotokos, from which was cut without hands the Stone (Daniel 2:34–35, 45) that crushed the idols of the demons. *Another Heirmos: Illumination:*[^221]

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: В тече́нїихъ І҆ѻрда́нскїя воды̀ нетлѣ́нїа, прⷱ҇те́че крести́въ х҃а, молѝ и҆сточе́нїа страсте́й мои́хъ и҆зсꙋши́ти, и҆ пото́ки пи́щныя наслѣ́довати, и҆ пра́ведныхъ кра́снаго радова́нїа.
items.english_text: Having baptized Christ in the streams of the Jordan, waters of incorruption, O Forerunner, pray Him to dry up the outpourings of my passions, and grant me to inherit the torrent of delight (Psalm 35:9) and the beautiful rejoicing of the righteous!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆жѐ рыда́ю, и҆ содержꙋ́ся стра́хомъ, и҆ недоꙋмѣ́нїемъ всегда̀ содержи́мъ є҆́смь, помышля́я моя̑ дѣя́нїа, и҆ бꙋ́дꙋщаго сꙋди́ща оу҆́жасъ, бл҃гоꙋтро́бне гдⷭ҇и поща-
items.english_text: Already I weep, and am seized with fear, and am ever held fast by perplexity, considering my deeds and the terror of the judgment to come; O tenderly compassionate Lord, spare me by the supplications of Thy Baptist!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: ди́ мя, твое́го крⷭ҇ти́теля мольба́ми.
items.english_text: Setting forth a saving law for the people who through repentance turned from transgressions, O Forerunner, thou didst stand between the Law and grace; therefore I pray thee: direct my ways unto repentance!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: За́конъ полага́я лю́демъ спасе́нный, во раскаѧ́нїи прⷱ҇те́че прегрѣше́нїй бы́вшимъ, посредѣ̀ зако́на и҆ блгⷭ҇ти ста̀: сегѡ̀ ра́ди молю́ тя, ѡ҆́бразы покаѧ́нїа напра́ви.
items.english_text: Grant me time for repentance, O Benefactor, unto me who have passed all my life in despondency and spent it wastefully, having the great Forerunner John to intercede with Thee for this, O Word, the most excellent preacher of repentance! *Theotokion:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Да́ждь мѝ вре́мя покаѧ́нїа, оу҆ны́нїемъ преше́дша всѐ, и҆ и҆жды́вшася бл҃года́телю, и҆мѣ́яй на сѐ моля́щаго тя̀ сло́ве, І҆ѡа́нна вели́каго прⷱ҇те́чꙋ, и҆ покаѧ́нїи всекра́снаго проповѣ́дника. Бг҃о.
items.english_text: By the assault and snare of the deceitful one have I been slain; O all-immaculate Lady, revive me, who didst bear, O Theotokos, the Hypostatic Life of all, that I may piously hymn thee, the all-praised one!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: є҆́смъ: но ꙗ҆́коже пррⷱ҇ка І҆ѡ́нꙋ, и҆з̾глꙋбины́ мя ѿ страсте́й возведѝ и҆ спаси́ мя.
items.english_text: I am held fast in the depth of sin, O Savior, and tossed by the tempest in the sea of life yet as the prophet Jonah, lead me up from the depth of passions and save me (Jonah 2:1–10)!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже дре́вле ханане́а зовꙋ́ ти х҃е: сн҃е дв҃двъ поми́ловавъ оу҆ще́дри мя̀. дш҃ꙋ бо стра́ждꙋщи и҆́мамъ во люты́хъ, и҆ сама̀ в чꙋ́вство прїитѝ нехо́щетъ.
items.english_text: As formerly the Canaanite woman, I cry unto Thee, O Christ: Son of David, have mercy on me and show compassion (Matthew 15:22); for I have a soul suffering grievously, and she herself will not come to her senses!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Смꙋща́ютъ мя̀ безмѣ́рныя во́лны страсте́й: ꙗ҆́коже мо́рю дре́вле запрети́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ спасѐ ст҃ыя оу҆ч҃нки своя̀, и҆ менѐ і҃се возведѝ и҆ спаси́ мя. Мꙋ́ченъ.
items.english_text: The boundless waves of passions trouble me; as Thou didst rebuke the sea of old, and saved Thy holy disciples (Matthew 8:26), lead me also up, O Jesus, and save me! *Martyrikon:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆диви́шася а҆́ггле́тїи безпло́тні́и ли́ци, терпѣ́нїю ва́шемꙋ и҆́же в телесѝ, и҆ похвали́ша пода́вшаго ва́мъ чтⷭ҇ні́и страда́лцы, и҆ си́лꙋ и҆ дѣ́ломъ воздаа́нїа.
items.english_text: The bodiless ranks of angels marveled at your bodily endurance, and praised Him Who granted you power and reward in deed, O honorable sufferers! *Martyrikon:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆блива́еми кро́вїй свои́хъ стрꙋя́ми, и҆ ѻ҆́чїи и҆збода́еми мч҃нци, и҆ померза́еми стꙋде́нїи лю́тѣ, ко теплотѣ̀ жи́зни
items.english_text: Drenched with streams of your blood, having your eyes put out, O martyrs, and freezing bitterly in icy cold, unto the warmth of life ye passed over, singing praises unto Christ! *Theotokion:*[^222]

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ тра́пеза хлѣ́бъ вмѣсти́вши та́йный, ѿне́гоже ꙗ҆́дше нектомꙋ̀ а҆́лчемъ всепѣ́тая, вѣ́дꙋще тя̀ х҃ꙋ всѣ́хъ бг҃ꙋ, роди́тельницꙋ, и҆ пита́тельницꙋ ꙗ҆́кѡ вои́стинꙋ.
items.english_text: As a table containing the mystical Bread (John 6:32–51), eating of Whom we hunger no more, O all-praised one, knowing thee to be the Mother and true Nourisher of Christ, the God of all!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ І҆рмо́съ. Во бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй ѡ҆держи́мъ.
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: Held fast in the abyss of sin:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ сло́ва проповѣ́дай, всѣ́хъ гла́сы прїима́ти просѝ, и҆ грѣхѡ́мъ проще́нїе дарова́ти, съ любо́вїю пою́щимъ тя̀.
items.english_text: Preaching the voice of the Word, ask that He receive the voices of all, and grant forgiveness of sins unto those who praise thee with love!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Сокрꙋше́нїе дш҃а моеѧ̀ и҆сцѣлѝ, грѣхѡ́въ бре́мя раздрѣшѝ, и҆ па́че наде́жда спаси́ мя, мл҃твами си бл҃же́нне прⷱ҇те́че.
items.english_text: Heal the contrition of my soul, loose the burden of sins, and beyond hope save me, by thy prayers, O blessed Forerunner!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: І҆са є҆го́же рꙋко́ю свое́ю крⷭ҇тѝ, прⷱ҇те́че молѝ, рꙋко́ю и҆зба́вити мя̀ грѣхѝ взе́млюща к вы́шнемꙋ рꙋцѣ̀ всегда̀ воздвиза́ющи. Бг҃о.
items.english_text: Pray Jesus, Whom thou didst baptize with thy hand, O Forerunner, that by His hand He Who takes away sins may deliver me, as thou ever liftest up thy hands unto the Most High! *Theotokion:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: твои́мъ прⷱ҇чтая бдѣ́ннымъ хода́тайствомъ, воздви́гни и҆ спаси́ мя. *Пѣ́нь з҃, І҆рмо́съ.
items.english_text: Slothful slumber holds me fast, sinful sleep weighs down my heart by thy vigilant mediation, O most pure one, arouse and save me! *Ode 7: Heirmos:*[^223]

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Херꙋві́момъ подо́бящеся дѣ́ти, в пе́щи ликовствова́хꙋ вопїю́ще: блгⷭ҇ве́нъ є҆сѝ бж҃е, ꙗ҆́кѡ и҆́стиною и҆ сꙋдо́мъ наве́де сїя̑ вся̑, грѣ́хъ ра́ди на́шихъ: препѣ́тый и҆ препросла́вленый во вѣ́ки вся̑.
items.english_text: Imitating the Cherubim, the Children danced in the furnace, crying: Blessed art Thou, O God, for in truth and judgment hast Thou brought all these things upon us for our sins (Daniel 3:27–28), O Thou Who art all-hymned and glorified unto all ages!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: За́коны твоя̑ ѡ҆ста́вихъ, покори́хъ же ся ско́тскимъ жела́нїемъ, дѣ́я неподо́бная х҃е, ꙗ҆́кѡ ѡ҆бꙋсти́хся во безꙋ́мїи мое́мъ, ꙗ҆́коже и҆́нъ никто́же ѿ чл҃къ на землѝ, не ѡ҆ста́ви оу҆́бѡ менѐ сп҃се поги́бнꙋти, чл҃колю́бїя ра́ди.
items.english_text: I abandoned Thy laws, and submitted myself to beast-like desires, doing what is unfitting, O Christ, for I was foolish in my mindless folly as no other among men upon earth; leave me not therefore, O Savior, to perish, for Thy love toward mankind!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Во беззако́нїихъ гдⷭ҇и сѐ зача́тъ є҆́смь, ꙗ҆́коже дв҃дъ зовꙋ̀, и҆ ро́ждься на землѝ: и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ прогнѣ́вахъ тебѐ, є҆ди́наго сꙋ́щаго бг҃а и҆́стинна, не ѡ҆ста́ви оу҆́бѡ менѐ сп҃се
items.english_text: “Behold, in transgressions was I conceived,” as David I cry (Psalm 50:5), “and born upon earth”; and since I have angered Thee, the only true God, leave me not therefore, O Savior to perish, for Thy love toward mankind! *Martyrikon:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: поги́бнꙋти, чл҃колю́бїя ра́ди. Мꙋ́чен[иченъ].
items.english_text: The assembly of sufferers struggled valiantly, and was wondrously crowned by the life-bearing right hand; for in truth they loved God Who made all things by His Word, and now rejoicing in the heavens, they partake of divine delight! *Martyrikon:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́жески подвиза́ся собо́ръ страда́лческій, и҆ чꙋ́дно вѣнча́ся живоно́сною десни́цею, ꙗ҆́кѡ вои́стиннꙋ бг҃а возлюбѝ, и҆́же вся̑ сотво́ршаго сло́вомъ свои́мъ, и҆ нн҃ѣ на нб҃се́хъ ра́дꙋяся наслажда́ется, бж҃твенаго наслажде́нїа. Мꙋ́чен[иченъ].
items.english_text: Having their eyes put out, and their hands and feet severed, the glorious ones sent forth a good course toward the heavenly journey, hindering the journeys of the sole adversary; by their prayers, O Word, save all who glorify Thee! *Theotokion:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: и҆́же любо́вїю чтꙋ́щїи тя̀. *И҆́нъ І҆рмо́съ, Бг҃опро̃.
items.english_text: Cherubim glorify, and Seraphim hymn, Thrones, Authorities, and Dominions ever praise thy childbearing which is beyond mind, O all-praised Mother; for thou alone bearest God in the flesh: pray Him, O pure one, to save us all! who with love honor thee.

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: И҆ско́рене секи́рою твое́ѧ мл҃твы, посѣка́ющи пострѣка́теля стра́стемъ срⷣца мое́го, всадѝ прⷱ҇те́че бж҃тве́ннаго безстра́стїа стра́хъ, неразꙋ́мїа и҆́же ко бг҃ꙋ, и҆ вся́кїа зло́бы ѿчꙋжда́я мя̀.
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: To Him Who was proclaimed by God:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Во стрꙋѧ́хъ І҆ѻрда́нскихъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ крⷭ҇ти́лъ є҆сѝ покрыва́ющаго вода́ми превы́спренѧѧ гдⷭ҇а, тогѡ̀ молѝ, во́дꙋ дарова́ти бж҃твенаго оу҆миле́нїа при́снѡ ѻ҆чи́ма мои́ма, сла́вный предте́че.
items.english_text: With the axe of thy prayer, felling from the root the tempter unto the passions of my heart, do thou plant, O Forerunner, the fear of divine dispassion, estranging me from folly toward God and from all malice.

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Взе́млющаго грѣхѝ мі́рꙋ, а҆́гнца бж҃їа прⷱ҇те́че проповѣ́давъ, тогѡ̀ молѝ ѿ ко́злищъ ча́сти ꙗ҆ви́ти мя̀ чꙋ́жда, и҆ де́сныѧ є҆го̀ ѻ҆вца́мъ, менѐ сочета́ти сла́вне. Бг҃о.
items.english_text: In the streams of the Jordan, as thou didst baptize the Lord Who covers His high chambers with waters (Psalm 103:3 LXX), beseech Him, O glorious Forerunner, ever to grant unto mine eyes the water of divine compunction.

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Непло́днаѧ оу҆тро́ба но́ситъ тя̀ дв҃о, во оу҆тро́бѣ носи́вшꙋю сло́во воплоще́нное, є҆го́
items.english_text: Having proclaimed the Lamb of God Who takes away the sins of the world (John 1:29), O Forerunner, beseech Him to show me a stranger to the portion of the goats, and to unite me, O glorious one, unto the sheep of His right hand (Matthew 25:32–33). *Theotokion:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: є҆го̀ бж҃тве́ннымъ взыгра́нїемъ вели́кїй прⷱ҇те́ча непло́дныѧ всест҃о́е прозябе́нїе позна́въ, ра́дꙋѧся поклони́ся.
items.english_text: A barren womb bears thee, O Virgin, who didst bear in thy womb the Incarnate Word recognizing Him by divine leaping, the great Forerunner, the all-holy offspring of a barren mother, bowed down in rejoicing (Luke 1:41–44).

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: В кꙋпи́нѣ мѡѷсе́и дв҃ческое чꙋ́до, на сїна́йстей горѣ̀ проѡбрази́вшаго дре́вле, по́йте вся̑ дѣ́ла гдⷭ҇а, и҆ превозноси́те є҆го̀ во вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:*[^224]

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Да̀ ѡ҆божи́ши на́съ вопло́щся мл҃тьно, неразꙋ́менъ ника́коже, порази́цаемъ сла́ми, твое́ю блг҃ты́нею ѡ҆брати́ мя х҃е, и҆́же всѣ́мъ ѡ҆браще́нїе.
items.english_text: To Him Who prefigured of old upon Mount Sinai the virginal wonder in the bush unto Moses: Hymn the Lord, all ye works, and exalt Him above all unto all ages!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ па́стырь до́брый сло́ве, заблꙋ́ждшꙋ на гора́хъ престꙋпле́нїа, ѡ҆каѧ́ннꙋю мѝ дш҃ꙋ ѡ҆врати́въ спасѝ, да̀ мя̀ до конца̀ вра́гъ лети́вый непожре́тъ. М҃.
items.english_text: That Thou mightest deify us, having become incarnate in mercy, though I am by no means understanding, being stricken by passions, convert me by Thy goodness, O Christ, Who art the conversion of all.

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ па́стырь до́брый сло́ве, заблꙋ́ждшꙋ на гора́хъ престꙋпле́нїа, ѡ҆каѧ́ннꙋю мѝ дш҃ꙋ ѡ҆врати́въ спасѝ, да̀ мя̀ до конца̀ вра́гъ лети́вый непожре́тъ. М҃.
items.english_text: Thou art the Good Shepherd, O Word; convert and save my wretched soul that has wandered astray upon the mountains of transgression, lest the cunning enemy devour me utterly. *Martyrikon:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: дрꙋ́гъ дрꙋ́гꙋ крѣ́пцїи страда́лци, оу҆ража́еми лю́тѣ, сѐ х҃съ простира́етъ на́мъ вѣнцы̀ во вѣ́ки. Мꙋ́ченъ.
items.english_text: “Let us stand manfully together!” cried the valiant sufferers one unto another, as they were fiercely smitten: “Behold, Christ stretches forth crowns unto us unto ages!” *Martyrikon:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкими жи́лами, тве́рдыми ва́шими вы́енми оу҆дави́сте ѕмі́а, мня́щагося ва́съ лести́вно прельсти́ти, и҆ ра́йстѣй пи́щи ꙗ҆ви́стеся наслѣ́дниц[и]. Бг҃о.
items.english_text: With strong sinews and your steadfast necks, ye strangled the serpent that thought deceitfully to beguile you, and ye were shown forth as inheritors of the delight of Paradise. *Theotokion:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Да̀ ѡ҆божи́тъ на́съ бг҃ъ, вопло́щся и҆́зъ чи́стыхъ кро́вій твои́хъ, и҆ бы́сть зе́менъ дв҃о бц҃е, є҆го́же молѝ при́снѡ ѡ҆ воспѣва́ющихъ тя̀. *И҆́нъ І҆рмо́съ, Пе́щь ѡ҆гне́нна.
items.english_text: That God might deify us, having become incarnate of thy pure blood, and become earthly, O Virgin Theotokos, pray Him ever on behalf of those who hymn thee.[^225] *Another Heirmos: The fiery furnace:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Да́ждь десни́цꙋ мнѣ̀ на землѝ лежа́щемꙋ прⷱ҇те́че и҆́же десни́цꙋ просте́ръ, и҆ ѡ҆мы́лъ є҆сѝ вода́ми нескве́рнаго: и҆ и҆зба́ви мя̀ скве́рнъ тѣле́сныхъ, всего́ мя ѡ҆чища́я покаѧ́ні́емъ, и҆ спаси́ мя.
items.english_text: Reach forth thy right hand unto me who lie upon the earth, O Forerunner, who didst stretch forth thy right hand and wash the Undefiled One with waters; and deliver me from bodily defilements, purifying me wholly through repentance, and save me!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: И҆мꙋ́щи дш҃е вре́мя покаѧ́тисѧ, и҆ лѣ́ности
items.english_text: Having time to repent, O my soul shake off the heavy sleep of sloth, and watch with haste, crying unto thy Master: “O Merciful One, have compassion on me through the prayers of Thy Baptist!”

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: сти тя́жкїй со́нъ ѿтрясѝ, и҆ спѣ́шно побдѝ, вопїю́щи влⷣцѣ свое́мꙋ, милосе́рде оу҆ще́дри мя̀, крⷭ҇теля твое́гѡ мл҃твами.
items.english_text: Torrents of passions and waters of wickedness have entered into my soul; make haste swiftly to deliver me, O blessed John, who by river streams didst reveal the quiet abyss of dispassion.

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Пото́ци стра́стей и҆ во́ды ѕло́бы до дш҃а моеѧ̀ внидо́ша: бл҃же́нне І҆ѡа́нне потщи́ся ско́ро и҆з̾ѧ́ти мя̀: и҆́же рѣчны́ми стрꙋѧ́ми немы̀, безстра́стїа ти́хꙋю пꙋчи́нꙋ.
items.english_text: Woe is me, who have committed many evils! Woe is me, who alone have angered the all-good God! O Baptist of Christ, help me, and grant remission unto my transgressions, and liberation from my debts by thine intercession!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: бродѣ́телми прⷱ҇чтая, ꙗ҆́кѡ да пою́ тя спаса́емъ.
items.english_text: Thou didst give birth in the flesh unto the Most High God: raise me up from the corruption of the passions that afflict me, and having become fiercely destitute of everything, enrich me with divine virtues, O all-pure one that being saved I may hymn thee!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Ѿ земнорѡ́дныхъ кто̀ слы́ша такова̑я; и҆лѝ кто̀ ви́дѣ когда̀; ꙗ҆́кѡ дв҃а ѡ҆брѣ́теся во чре́вѣ и҆мꙋ́щи, и҆ безболѣ́зни младе́нца породѝ: таково́ ти є҆́стъ чꙋ́до! и҆ тя̀ чтⷭ҇ая бг҃ороди́телнице мр҃їе велича́емъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:*[^226]

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ что̀ сꙋди́ще твоѐ стра́шное, нане́мже х҃е и҆́мамъ сꙋ́дъ прїя́ти, и҆ не чꙋ́вствꙋю ѿню́дъ сегѡ̀ стра́ха, в лѣ́ности всѧ̑ лѣ̑та и҆жды́вша ѡ҆брати́ мя є҆ди́не всѣ́хъ цр҃ю, и҆́же манасі́ю ѡ҆браще́й согрѣши́вшаго.
items.english_text: Who among earthborn men has heard such a thing, or who has ever seen that a virgin was found having conceived in her womb, and without travail gave birth to an Infant? Such is thy wonder! And thee, O pure Mary, Mother of God, do we magnify.

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Соста́ви х҃е пото́ки вопїю́ ти, стрꙋѧ̀ мнѣ̀ да́ж слеза́мъ въ оу҆мыва́нїе скве́рнамъ, безмѣ́рныхъ мои́хъ ѕѡ́лъ, ꙗ҆́же под̾я́хъ безꙋ́мїемъ: и҆ спаси́ мя мл҃тїю сѝ, спасы́й блꙋдни́цꙋ и҆́же ѿ дш҃а покаѧ́вшꙋюся. Мꙋ́чен[иченъ].
items.english_text: Oh, what a dread judgment-seat of Thine, whereon, O Christ, I am to receive judgment, yet I do not feel this dread at all! Having spent all my years in sloth, convert me, O only King of all, Who didst convert Manasseh who had sinned.

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Свѣтоза́рнаѧ бж҃тве́нныхъ страда́лецъ па́мять, ꙗ҆́ко сл҃нце на́мъ возсїя́вши, вся̑ конца̀ зе́мныхъ ѡ҆свѣща́етъ, и҆ прого́нитъ бж҃твеннымъ дх҃омъ, тмꙋ̀ и҆долобѣ́сїа, и҆ страсте́й дшетлѣ́нный мра́къ. М҃.
items.english_text: Form torrents, I cry unto Thee, O Christ, and grant me a stream of tears for the washing away of the defilements of my measureless evils, which I took upon myself through folly; and save me by Thy mercy, O Thou Who didst save the harlot who repented from her soul. *Martyrikon:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: По́лкъ че́стенъ вѡ́инъ побѣдоно́сныхъ, и҆збра́нный гра́дъ, собо́ръ ст҃ыхъ мч҃нкъ: ли́къ бл҃же́нный ликостоя́нїи сочета́ся безпло́тныхъ: тѣ́хъ мл҃твами х҃е, всѣ́хъ на́съ црⷭ҇твїа твое́гѡ прича́стники сотворѝ. Бг҃о,
items.english_text: The radiant memory of the divine sufferers, having shone forth upon us like the sun, enlightens all the ends of the earth, and by the divine Spirit drives away the darkness of idolatrous madness and the soul-destroying gloom of the passions. *Martyrikon:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Свѣ́тлыми заря́ми, и҆з̾ чре́ва твое́го возсїя́вшаго на́мъ, и҆ безбо́жїа но́щь потреби́вшаго: свѣтороди́телнице мр҃їе, просвѣтѝ вся̑ вѣ́рою тебѐ чтꙋ́щихъ, и҆ ѿ несвѣти́мыя тмы̀ и҆зба́ви въ ча́съ ѡ҆сꙋжде́нїа. *И҆́нъ, І҆рмо́съ. Безнача́лна роди́.
items.english_text: An honorable host of victorious warriors, a chosen city, an assembly of holy martyrs: the blessed choir was united unto the choral standing of the bodiless hosts; by their prayers, O Christ, make all of us partakers of Thy Kingdom! *Theotokion:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Ка́ла мя̀ и҆зба́ви грѣхо́внаго, гдⷭ҇и без̾
items.english_text: With radiant beams shining forth upon us from thy womb, and destroying the night of godlessness, O Mary, parent of the Light: enlighten all who honor thee with faith, and deliver them from the unilluminated darkness in the hour of condemnation! *Another Heirmos: He Who begot without beginning:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: грѣ́шне є҆ди́не многомл҃тиве: крⷭ҇ти́теля мольба́ми, и҆́же тебѐ проповѣ́да всемꙋ̀ мі́рꙋ а҆́гньца бж҃їа, взе́млющаго человѣ́кѡмъ грѣхѝ.
items.english_text: Deliver me from sinful mire, O Lord, Who alone art sinless and abundantly merciful through the supplications of the Baptist, who proclaimed Thee unto the whole world as the Lamb of God Who takes away the sins of mankind!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́ко шипо́къ бл҃гово́ненъ, ꙗ҆́ко бл҃гоꙋха́ненъ кѵпари́съ, ꙗ҆́ко неꙋвяда́емый крі́нъ: ꙗ҆́кѡ мѵ́ро чⷭ҇тно и҆мѣ́ютъ тя̀ гнⷭ҇ь прⷱ҇те́че: мои́хъ дѣ́лъ ѕлосвра́дїа да и҆зба́влюсѧ мл҃твами твои́ми, прибѣга́ѧ покро́въ тво́й.
items.english_text: As a sweet-smelling rose, as a fragrant cypress, as an unfading lily, as honorable myrrh the faithful possess thee, O Forerunner of the Lord; let me be delivered from the ill stench of my deeds by thy prayers, as I flee unto thy protection.[^227]

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Непло́дствꙋюща мя̀ безпло́дїемъ, всеблаже́нне сотворѝ дѣ́ла добродѣ́телей, бл҃гоча́дїе при́снѡ приноси́ти, ча́до мя̀ гнⷭ҇е твора̀, и҆ прича́стника бж҃тве́нномꙋ црⷭ҇твїю, и҆ ст҃ы́хъ събо́ръ є҆диножи́теля.
items.english_text: Barren as I am in fruitlessness, O all-blessed one, make me ever to bring forth the works of virtues as goodly offspring, making me a child of the Lord, a partaker of the divine Kingdom, and a fellow citizen with the assembly of the saints.

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: На́мъ лю́бящимъ тя̀ и҆ вѣ́рою блжа́щїимъ, и҆ въ сщ҃тве́ннѣмъ хра́мѣ твое́мъ ликꙋ́ющимъ, пода́жъ сънѣ́се разрѣше́нїе лю́тымъ
items.english_text: Unto us who love thee and faithfully bless thee, and who keep choir in thy sacred temple, grant from above deliverance from cruel afflictions, O Forerunner of the Lord, and amendment of life! *Theotokion:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: тымъ гнⷭ҇ь прⷱ҇те́че, и҆ житїѝ и҆справле́нїе. Бг҃о.
items.english_text: Unto Him Who is carried in the womb of the Mother of God, Who carries all things by His nod, thou didst bow down, O prophet; pray with Him that my humble soul may be saved, which falls daily into many transgressions.

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Носи́мꙋ во оу҆тро́бѣ бг҃ома́терни, и҆́же вся̑ нося́щаго ма́нїемъ, поклони́лся є҆сѝ прⷱ҇че: сне́мже млѝ, сп҃ти́ся смиреннѣ́й дш҃и мое́й, въ мно́гаа впада́ющи повседнѝ согрѣше́нїа. Т҃я, Свѣти́ленъ.
items.english_text: O glorious prophet and forerunner of grace, who didst preach the baptism of repentance unto salvation for all, and didst point out the Lamb Who takes away the sins of the world, O blessed one: pray Him even now to have mercy upon the world! *Theotokion:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Прⷱ҇че пресла́вный, и҆ прⷱ҇те́че блгⷭ҇ти, и҆́же покаѧ́нїе всѣ́мъ проповѣ́давый сп҃се́нїа, и҆ а҆́гнца взе́млющаго мі́рꙋ грѣхѝ показа́вый блаже́нне, тогѡ̀ и҆ нн҃ѣ молѝ, поми́ловати мі́ръ. Бг҃о.
items.english_text: All the prophets foretold thee, O Virgin: David called thee the Mountain, and the Ark, and the Lampstand, and the Ladder, and the Bridge, and the Jar bearing the Manna, and the Rod that budded; and we honor thee as the Mother of God according to thy worth.

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Тя̀ дв҃о пррⷱ҇ци всѝ превозвѣсти́ша: дв҃дъ тя̀ го́рꙋ наречѐ, и҆ ковче́гъ, и҆ свѣти́лникъ, и҆ лѣ́ствицꙋ и҆ мо́стъ, и҆ рꙋ́чкꙋ ма́ннꙋ нося́щꙋ, и҆ же́злъ прозя́бшїй: мы́ же ꙗ҆́кѡ бц҃ꙋ по достоѧ́ні́ю тя̀ чте́мъ.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of Repentance, Tone 2:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Содѣ́ѧнныхъ мои́хъ ѕѡ́лъ, помышля́ѧ безмѣ́стнаѧ, ко твои́мъ прибѣга́ю щедрота́мъ: мытарю̀ подо́бяся, и҆ блꙋдници слези́вшей, и҆ блꙋ́дномꙋ сы́нꙋ: тѣ́мже припада́ю тѝ мл҃тиве, пре́жде да́же не ѡ҆сꙋ́диши менѐ, пощадѝ мя̀ бж҃е и҆ поми́лꙋй мя̀.
items.english_text: Pondering the unseemliness of the evil deeds I have committed, I flee unto Thy compassions: resembling the publican, and the weeping harlot, and the prodigal son; therefore I fall down before Thee, O Merciful One: before Thou judgest me, spare me, O God, and have mercy on me!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Беззако́нїа моя̑ пре́зри гдⷭ҇и, и҆́же ѿ дв҃ы рожде́йся, и҆ срⷣце моѐ ѡ҆чи́сти: цр҃ковь сїѐ твора̀ ст҃о́мꙋ твое́мꙋ дх҃ꙋ: не ѡ҆тве́ржи менѐ ѿ твое́го лица̀, безмѣ́рнꙋю и҆мѣ́ѧ ве́лїю ми́лость. Мꙋ́чен[иченъ].
items.english_text: Overlook my lawless deeds, O Lord Who wast born of the Virgin, and cleanse my heart, making it a temple for Thy Holy Spirit; cast me not away from Thy face, as Thou hast measureless, great mercy! *Martyrikon:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тъ хв҃ъ взе́мше ст҃і́и мч҃нци, ѡ҆рꙋ́жїе непобѣди́мое, всю̀ дїа́волю си́лꙋ оу҆праздни́ша, и҆ прїя́ша вѣ́нца нбⷭ҇ныѧ, стѣна̀ на́мъ бы́вша ѡ҆ на́съ мл҃щїися. Сла́ва: и҆ Нн҃ѣ, Бг҃о.
items.english_text: Having taken up the Cross of Christ as an invincible weapon, the holy martyrs abolished all the power of the devil, and received heavenly crowns, becoming a wall for us as they pray on our behalf. *Glory, both now. Theotokion:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Спасѝ ѿ бѣ́дъ рабы̀ своѧ̑ бц҃е дв҃о, ꙗ҆́кѡ
items.english_text: Save Thy servants from perils, O Virgin Theotokos, for all after God flee unto thee, O Virgin, as unto an unbreakable wall and protectress.

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: всѝ по бз҃ѣ к тебѣ̀ прибѣга́емъ, ꙗ҆́ко к нерꙋши́мой стѣнѣ̀ и҆ предста́тельници.
items.english_text: *On Tuesday, the Beatitudes. Tone 2:*[^228]

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ тѝ прино́симъ разбо́йничъ, и҆ мо́лимся, помянѝ на́съ гдⷭ҇и во црⷭ҇твїи сѝ.
items.english_text: We bring unto Thee the voice of the thief, and we pray: Remember us, O Lord, in Thy Kingdom!

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Мно́гаа мѝ прегрѣше́нїа пре́зри чл҃колю́бче, и҆ прича́стника мя̀ ꙗ҆вѝ ще́дре вы́шней свѣ́тлости.
items.english_text: Overlook my many transgressions, O Lover of mankind, and show me forth, O Compassionate One, as a partaker of the brightness on high.

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Погрꙋзи́вый бе́зднꙋ млⷣїа во вода́хъ прⷱ҇те́че: ѕѡ́лъ мои́хъ бе́зднꙋ мл҃твами сѝ и҆зсꙋшѝ.
items.english_text: O Forerunner, who didst immerse into the waters the Abyss of mercy: dry up the abyss of my evils by thine intercessions.

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же преле́стнаѧ тече́нїа кро́вными стрꙋѧ́ми и҆зсꙋши́вше, хв҃ы страстоте́рпци, досто́йно сла́вими є҆стѐ. Сла́ва.
items.english_text: Ye who by streams of blood dried up the deceptive torrents, O passion-bearers of Christ, ye are worthily glorified. *Glory:*

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Безнача́льный трⷪ҇ци тебѣ̀ покланя́емся: ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ и҆ сн҃ꙋ и҆ дх҃ꙋ пра́вомꙋ, є҆сттво́мъ тя̀ зна́я, є҆дини́цꙋ про́стꙋ и҆ трїѵпоста́внꙋ.
items.english_text: Unto Thee, the unoriginate Trinity, we bow down: unto the Father, and the Son, and the upright Spirit, knowing Thee in essence as a simple and tri-hypostatic Monad.

items.office: TUESDAY MATINS: REPENTANCE AND ST. JOHN THE FORERUNNER
items.slavonic_text: Пло́дъ чре́ва твое́го чтⷭ҇ая, и҆́же плодо́мъ попо́лзъшася, па́ки ра́еви жи́теля содѣ́лалъ є҆́стъ.
items.english_text: The Fruit of thy womb, O pure one, has made him who slipped through the fruit to be once again an inhabitant of Paradise.

items.slavonic_text: [Орнаментальная наборная заставка-фриз]
items.english_text: *Tuesday Evening, at “Lord, I have cried,” Stichera to the Precious and Life-giving Cross, Tone 2.*

items.slavonic_text: Вто́рокъ ве́черъ, на Гдⷭ҇и возва́хъ: Стїхи̑ры чⷭ҇тно́мꙋ и҆ животворя́щемꙋ крⷭ҇тꙋ, Гла́съ, в҃. Ве́лїа мч҃нкъ.
items.english_text: Creation was sanctified, O only Long-suffering One, by the precious Blood that dripped from Thy side; and the rivers of polytheism were dried up, and Adam was delivered from condemnation by Thy crucifixion, O Word!

items.slavonic_text: Тва́рь ѡ҆ст҃и́ся є҆ди́не долготерпѣли́ве, чⷭ҇тно́ю кро́вїю, и҆скапа́вшею ѿ ре́бръ твои́хъ: рѣ́ки же и҆зсꙋши́ни бы́ша многобо́жїа, и҆ а҆да́мъ и҆зба́вися ѡ҆сꙋжде́нїа распя́тїемъ тѝ сло́ве.
items.english_text: The Creator and Lord of all, and God of all, becomes poor of His own will: He has endured suffering for the sake of mankind, being lifted up upon the Cross under the curse of the Law.

items.slavonic_text: Вся́ческихъ тво́рецъ и҆ гдⷭ҇ь, и҆ всѣ́хъ бг҃ъ, ѡ҆бнищава́етъ во́лею: стра́сть за чл҃ки претерпѣ́лъ є҆́сть, на крⷭ҇тъ воздви́жемъ, кля́твою зако́нною.
items.english_text: Thou art crucified voluntarily, O Benefactor and Lord, and with a spear He pierced His side, O Giver of life Thou didst pour forth two streams of immortality; therefore unceasingly with faith do we all glorify Thy sufferings, O Compassionate One.

items.slavonic_text: Расплна́ешися бл҃годе́телю гдⷭ҇и хотѣ́нїемъ, ко́пїемъ же ребра̀ своя̀ прободѐ живода́вче,
items.english_text: *Other Stichera to the Most Holy Theotokos, Tone 2:*[^229]

items.slavonic_text: че, два̀ и҆сто́чника безсме́ртїа и҆сточи́лъ є҆сѝ, тѣ́мже непреста́нно всѝ вѣ́рно сла́вимъ, твоя̑ стра́сти ще́дрый.
items.english_text: Beholding Him Who was born of thee hanging upon the Tree, O all-undefiled one, she cried out lamenting: “O my most beloved Child, whither has Thy light-bearing beauty set, which adorned human nature?”

items.slavonic_text: И҆́ны стїхи̑ры прⷱ҇стѣ́й Бц҃и, Гла́съ, в҃.
items.english_text: Wounded by the weapon of the serpent, the beginner of evil, and lying half-dead upon the bed of despair, heal me swiftly, O Maiden, by the medicine of thy prayer, and save me, my hope and protection!

items.slavonic_text: и҆́же а҆́гглⷭ҇кимъ гла́сомъ ꙗ҆́кѡ и҆з̾ ѡ҆́блака легка̀ ѿ дв҃ы возсїя́вшаго. Сла́ва: и҆ Нн҃ѣ, Бг҃о.
items.english_text: Lay aside, O my soul, the hard-to-bear burdens of thine ancient transgressions, and bow thy neck beneath the light yoke of thy Lord Who shone forth from the Virgin at the angelic voice as from a light cloud. *Glory, both now. Theotokion:*

items.slavonic_text: Свѣ́томъ твои́хъ мл҃твъ дв҃о, просвѣтѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ мт҃и вы́шнѧ смире́нꙋю мѝ дш҃ꙋ, и҆ да́ж мѝ пꙋ́ть спасе́нный: є҆го́же зрѣ́ти не могꙋ̀ ѡ҆каѧ́нный, ѿ ѡ҆бща́го во мнѣ̀ грѣ́х[а].
items.english_text: By the light of thy prayers, O Virgin, as the Mother of the Most High, enlighten my humble soul, and grant me the saving path, which I, wretched one, cannot behold because of the sin that dwells within me.

items.slavonic_text: На стїхо́внѣ Стїхи̑ры крⷭ҇ны Гла́съ, в҃.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Cross, Tone 2:*

items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тꙋ твое́мꙋ покланя́емсѧ х҃е чⷭ҇тно́мꙋ, сохра́нникꙋ мі́рови: сп҃се́нїи на́мъ грѣ́шникѡмъ. вели́комꙋ ѡ҆чище́нїи, царе́мъ побѣ́дѣ, и҆ похвале́нїю все́й вселе́ннѣй.
items.english_text: We bow down before Thy precious Cross, O Christ, the guardian of the world, the salvation for us sinners, the great cleansing, the victory of kings, and the boast of the whole inhabited earth!

items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тѡѡ́бразно мѡѷсе́й на горѣ̀, рꙋ́цѣ воздѣ́въ ко высотѣ̀, а҆мали́ка побѣжда́ше: ты́ же сп҃се дла́ни просте́ на крⷭ҇тѣ́ чтⷭ҇нѣ́мъ, ѡ҆б̾е́мъ мя̀ спа́слъ є҆сѝ ѿ рабо́ты вра́жїя, и҆ да́лъ мѝ є҆сѝ зна́менїе живо́тное, бѣжа́ти ѿ лꙋ́ка сопроти́вныхъ мнѝ: сегѡ̀ ра́ди сло́ве
items.english_text: Prefiguring the Cross, Moses on the mountain, having stretched forth his hands on high, conquered Amalek; and Thou, O Savior, having stretched forth Thy palms upon the precious Cross, embracing me, hast saved me from the bondage of the enemy, and hast given me the life-giving sign to flee from the bow of those who oppose me; therefore, O Word do I bow down before Thy precious Cross.

items.slavonic_text: сло́ве покланя́юся, крⷭ҇тꙋ твое́мꙋ чтⷭ҇но́мꙋ.
items.english_text: The prophets, and the apostles of Christ, and the martyrs have taught us to hymn the consubstantial Trinity, and have enlightened the beguiled nations, and made the sons of men partakers with the angels. *Glory, both now. Staurotheotokion: Beholding Him, look above.*

items.office: WEDNESDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Пррⷱ҇цы и҆ а҆пл҃и хв҃и и҆ мч҃нци: наꙋчи́ша ны̀ пѣ́ти трⷪ҇цꙋ є҆диноє҆сꙋ́щнꙋю, и҆ просвѣти́ша ꙗ҆зы́ки прельще́нныѧ, и҆ прича́стники а҆́гглѡмъ сотвори́ша, сыны̀ чл҃чкїа.
items.english_text: *On Wednesday at Matins, after the first Kathisma versification, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 2:*[^230]

items.office: WEDNESDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ Нн҃ѣ, крⷭ҇тобг҃о, Зря́щи и҆́же, зрѝ вы́шше,
items.english_text: The Cross was planted upon the earth and reached unto heaven: not that the wood attained such height, but unto Thee Who upon it fillest all things: Glory to Thee!

items.office: WEDNESDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: В средꙋ на Оу҆́трни пол. ст҃и. Сѣ крⷭ҇тны Гла́съ в҃.
items.english_text: Upon the cypress, the pine, and the cedar was the Lamb of God lifted up, that Thou mightest save those who with faith bow down before Thy voluntary crucifixion: O Christ God, glory to Thee! *Glory, both now. Staurotheotokion:*

items.office: WEDNESDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: нїа, и҆́же любо́вїю тебѐ непреста́нно велича́юще.
items.english_text: Having acquired the Cross of thy Son as a rod of strength, O Theotokos, thereby do we cast down the haughty insolence of the enemy as with love we unceasingly magnify thee.

items.office: WEDNESDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: По в҃, Стїхоло́гїи, Сѣда́ле Гла́съ, в҃.
items.english_text: *After the second Kathisma versification, Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:*

items.office: WEDNESDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тъ и҆ сме́рть пострада́ти восхотѣ́въ, посредѣ̀ тва́рей того̀ водрꙋзи́лъ є҆сѝ: є҆гда̀ бл҃гоизво́ли і҃се тѣ́ло своѐ пригвозди́ти, тогда̀ и҆ сл҃це лꙋча̑ скры̀, и҆ лука́вый разбо́йникъ зря̀ на крⷭ҇тѣ́ тя воспѣва́ше вопїѧ̀: помянѝ мя̀ гдⷭ҇и: и҆ воспрїя́тъ вѣ́ровавъ ра́й.
items.english_text: Desiring to suffer the Cross and death, in the midst of creation Thou didst plant it; when Thou wast well pleased, O Jesus, to nail Thy body, then also the sun hid its rays, and the cunning thief, beholding Thee upon the Cross, sang praise, crying out: “Remember me, O Lord!” and having believed, received Paradise.

items.office: WEDNESDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Неисче́тнѣй вла́сти твое́й, и҆ во́лномꙋ тѝ распя́тїю, а҆́гглекаѧ вѡ́инства дивля́хꙋся зря́ще: ка́ко и҆́же неви́димый пло́тїю оу҆раня́ющеся! хотя̀ и҆зба́вити ѿ и҆стлѣ́нїа чл҃чтво. тѣ́мже ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃годе́телю вопїе́м тѝ сла́ва х҃е бл҃гоꙋтро́бїю твое́мꙋ. Мꙋ́чен[иченъ].
items.english_text: At Thine ineffable power and Thy voluntary crucifixion, the angelic hosts were amazed as they beheld: how He Who is invisible is wounded in the flesh, wishing to deliver mankind from corruption! Therefore, as unto our Benefactor, we cry unto Thee: Glory to Thee, O Christ, for Thy compassion! *Martyrikon:*

items.office: WEDNESDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Воѡрꙋжи́вшееся впосо́бїе хв҃о, и҆ ѡ҆бо́лкшеся во ѡ҆рꙋ́жїе вѣ́ры, ѡ҆полче́нїа вра́жїа страда́
items.english_text: Having armed yourselves in the defense of Christ, and having clothed yourselves in the armor of faith, the hostile ranks ye did cast down in martyrdom, for with zeal through the hope of life ye endured all the torturer’s threats and wounds; therefore ye also received crowns, O long-suffering martyrs of Christ!

items.office: WEDNESDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: страда́лчески низложи́сте, оу҆се́рдно бо наде́ждею жи́зни претерпѣ́сте вся̑ мꙋчи́телскаѧ преще́нїа и҆ ра́ны, тѣ́мже и҆ вѣ́нца прїя́сте, мч҃нци хв҃ы терпѣливодꙋ́шні́и.
items.english_text: Reproach, O Compassionate One, and death for the sake of the crucifixion Thou didst endure of Thine own will; beholding this, she who bare Thee was wounded, through whose supplications, by the bowels of Thy mercies, O only all-good Lord and Lover of mankind, have compassion and save the world, O Thou Who takest away the sins of the world!

items.office: WEDNESDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Поноше́нїю ще́дре сме́рть ра́д распя́тїа во́лею претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ: є҆́же ро́ждшїа тя̀ зря́щи оу҆язвля́шеся, є҆́яже мольба́ми за оу҆тро́бꙋ мл҃тей твои́хъ, є҆ди́не пребл҃гі́й чл҃колю́бче гдⷭ҇и, оу҆ще́дри и҆ спасѝ ми́ръ, взе́мляй мі́рꙋ грѣхѝ.
items.english_text: *After the third Kathisma versification, Sessional Hymns chanted according to the acrostic, Tone 2:*[^231]

items.office: WEDNESDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Распя́тїе и҆ сме́рть прїя́тъ, живо́тъ безсме́ртный и҆сточи́лъ є҆сѝ на́мъ х҃е сп҃се, и҆ сме́ртныѧ ѿ тлѧ̀ мі́ръ свободѝ: тѣ́мже твоя̑ сла́вимъ живода́вче чл҃колю́бче стра́сти спасе́ныѧ, и҆́миже всѝ спасо́хомся, чтⷭ҇наго крⷭ҇та твое́го смире́нїе, и҆ непобѣди́мое ѡ҆рꙋ́жїе и҆мꙋ́ще.
items.english_text: Having received crucifixion and death, Thou hast poured forth immortal life unto us, O Christ Savior, and freed mortal men from corruption; therefore do we glorify Thy saving passions, O Giver of life and Lover of mankind, whereby we all were saved, having the humility of Thy precious Cross as an invincible weapon.

items.office: WEDNESDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Неискꙋсобра́чнаѧ чтⷭ҇аѧ, и҆ мт҃и твоѧ̀ х҃е, зря́щи тя̀ ме́ртва ви́сяща на дре́вѣ, ма́тереки рыда́ющи гла́ше: что́ ти воздадѐ є҆вре́йскїй беззако́ный со́нмъ и҆ небл҃годарный; и҆́же мно́гихъ и҆ вели́кихъ твои́хъ сн҃ꙋ мо́й да́ровъ наслади́вся, пою̀ твоѐ бж҃тве́нное соше́ствїе.
items.english_text: The unwedded pure one and Thy Mother, O Christ, beholding Thee hanging dead upon the Tree, weeping maternally, cried aloud: “What has the lawless and ungrateful council of the Jews rendered unto Thee, which enjoyed many and great gifts of Thine, O my Son? I hymn Thy divine condescension!”

items.office: WEDNESDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Кано́нъ чⷭ҇тно́мꙋ и҆ животворя́щемꙋ Крⷭ҇тꙋ. Гла́съ, в҃.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Precious and Life-giving Cross, Tone 2.*

items.office: WEDNESDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́нь, а҆, І҆рмо́съ. И҆́же во́ды дре́вле, писа́нъ внѣ̀.
items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos: He Who of old [gathered] the waters, written outside:*[^232]

items.office: WEDNESDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Многоболѣ́зненныѧ стра́сти оу҆ста́вилъ є҆сѝ сло́ве, стра́стми чтны́ѧ пло́ти твое́ѧ. и҆ чл҃ки сп҃слъ є҆сѝ, и҆́хже оу҆язвѝ сопротивобо́рецъ. бл҃гоче́стно покланя́ющихсѧ недомы́сленомꙋ смотре́нїю твое́мꙋ.
items.english_text: Thou hast stayed the sorrowful passions, O Word, by the sufferings of Thy precious flesh, and hast saved mankind whom the adversary had wounded, as they piously bow down before Thine inscrutable dispensation.

items.office: WEDNESDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же связа́вый вра́гъ ле́стїю чл҃ка, за́повѣди престꙋпле́нїемъ, оу҆́зами же связꙋ́ется нерѣши́мо гдⷭ҇и, и҆́миже воплоща́емъ хотѣ́нїемъ связа́лъ є҆сѝ, разорѣ́
items.english_text: The enemy who bound man by deceit through the transgression of the commandment, is bound with indissoluble bonds, O Lord, wherewith Thou, being incarnate of Thine own will, hast bound him, dissolving our transgressions, O Lover of mankind. *Martyrikon:*

items.office: WEDNESDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: шаѧ прегрѣше́нїа на́ша чл҃колю́бче. М҃.
items.english_text: Beholding creation in distress through demonic deceits, the passion-bearers were shown forth as untroubled havens for the faithful; by streams of blood they drowned all the power of the evil one, the richly renowned ones! *Martyrikon:*

items.office: WEDNESDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Бѣ́дствꙋющꙋ зря́ще страстоте́рпци тва́рь, бѣсо́вскими ле́стьми, вѣ́рнымъ ꙗ҆ви́шася приста́нища невбꙋ́рнаѧ, всю̀ лꙋка́ваго си́лꙋ, стрꙋѧ́ми кро́вными потопи́ша, великонмени́ті́и. Мꙋ́чен[иченъ].
items.english_text: The choir of martyrs was radiantly joined unto the celestial choral dance, ever illuminated by the splendors of the uncreated Godhead, and it enlightens those upon earth who glorify its wonders with faith. *Theotokion:*

items.office: WEDNESDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Ли́къ мч҃нческїй, ликостоя́нїю вы́шнемꙋ свѣ́тло сочета́ся, блиста́нми всегда̀ ѡ҆заря́ѧся несозда́ннаго бж҃тва̀, и҆ сꙋ́щїа на землѝ ѡ҆заря́етъ, того̀ чꙋдеса̀ вѣ́рою сла́вящихъ. Бг҃о.
items.english_text: Thou hast appeared higher than the heavenly ranks, having given birth upon earth unto God the Word, O all-pure one, Who has led us up unto the heavenly realms by His passions and precious Cross, for the sake of His goodness.

items.office: WEDNESDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Превы́шши вы́шнихъ ꙗ҆ви́лася є҆сѝ чинѡ́въ, ро́ждши на землѝ бг҃а сло́ва прⷱ҇чтая, и҆́же на́съ к нбⷭ҇нымъ: сегѡ̀ стра́стьми и҆ крⷭ҇то́мъ чтны̀ возве́дшаго, бл҃гости ра́д[и].
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos, the same Heirmos:*

items.office: WEDNESDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: браздо́мъ дш҃а моеѧ̀ дв҃о, и҆ пло́дъ приноси́ти стори́чествꙋющїй влⷣце сподо́би мя̀, и҆ срⷣце моѐ весе́лїа и҆спо́лни да сла́влю тя̀.
items.english_text: Grant that the furrows of my soul may be richly watered with tears, O Virgin, and make me worthy to bring forth a hundredfold fruit, O Sovereign Lady, and fill my heart with gladness, that I may glorify thee!

items.office: WEDNESDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Млⷭ҇рдїа ра́ди мт҃и влⷣце всѣ́хъ, поми́лꙋй стра́стнꙋю мою̀ дш҃ꙋ, и҆ ѻ҆гня̀ и҆зба́ви мя̀ вѣ́чнаго, и҆ бѣсо́вскаго наше́ствїа бц҃е, и҆́же покро́въ тво́й нн҃ѣ прибѣга́ющаго.
items.english_text: For the sake of thy mercy, O Mother and Sovereign Lady of all, have mercy on my passionate soul, and deliver me from eternal fire and demonic assault, O Theotokos, who now flee unto thy protection.

items.office: WEDNESDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ нескве́рный хра́мъ цр҃въ, стра́стми безмѣ́стными ѡ҆скверни́вшееся срⷣце моѐ, молю́ся прⷱ҇чтая ѡ҆чи́сти мл҃твами сѝ, и҆ чи́стаго житїя̀ дѣ́лы ѡ҆богатѝ бг҃орадо́ванная.
items.english_text: As an undefiled temple of the King, my heart has been defiled by unseemly passions; I pray thee, O all-pure one, cleanse it by thine intercessions, and enrich it with the works of a pure life, O full of God’s grace!

items.office: WEDNESDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Что̀ лѣ́ностїю житїѐ дш҃е стра́стнаѧ прехо́диши, и҆ не бои́шися днѐ стра́шнагѡ сꙋда̀: но въста́ни про́чее ѿ ѡ҆грѣше́ні́я оу҆ны́ній, оу҆се́рдно и҆ те́плѣ нн҃ѣ возопі́й,
items.english_text: Why, O passionate soul, dost thou pass through life in sloth, and fearest not the day of dread judgment? But arise now from the slumber of despondency, and cry out fervently and warmly “Save me, O pure Sovereign Lady!”

items.office: WEDNESDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́нь, г҃. І҆рмо́съ. И҆́же ѡ҆быше́дшихъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos: He Who [reproved] those who compassed:*[^233]

items.office: WEDNESDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Тебѐ и҆́же є҆сттво́мъ бж҃твеннымъ безстра́стна, стра́стна бы́вша пло́тїю ра́ди блгⷭ҇ти, дре́вомъ оу҆мертви́лъ є҆́стъ є҆вре́йскїй събо́ръ, и҆́же на ѡ҆безсме́ртствꙋюща[го].
items.english_text: Thee Who in divine essence art impassible, having become passible in the flesh for the sake of grace, the council of the Jews put to death upon the Tree, acting against Him Who grants immortality!

items.office: WEDNESDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: На вода́хъ повѣ́шей сло́ве зе́мли. възведѝ мя̀ къ нбⷭ҇нымъ, въ ѕло́бный ро́въ въпа́дшагося. Мꙋ́чен[иченъ].
items.english_text: O Word Who didst suspend the earth upon the waters: raise me up unto the heavens, who have fallen into the pit of malice! *Martyrikon:*

items.office: WEDNESDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Преиспещре́нни ра́нами сщ҃енно, всехва́льні́и мч҃нци гдⷭ҇ꙋ предстои́те, ѿне́гоже прїе́млюще бога́тною рꙋко́ю воздаа́нїа.
items.english_text: Sacredly adorned with wounds, O all-praised martyrs, ye stand before the Lord, receiving recompense from Him with a rich hand.

items.office: WEDNESDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Ра́достною дш҃ею к ра́намъ ѿлꙋча́хꙋся мч҃нци, послѣ́днюю ѕмі́еви печа́ль твора́ще, и҆ а҆́гглекаѧ ли́ки ра́дости и҆сполня́юще.
items.english_text: With a joyful soul the martyrs parted unto wounds, working the ultimate grief for the serpent, and filling the angelic ranks with joy.

items.office: WEDNESDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: скꙋсобра́чная пла́чꙋщи гла́ше: за́де сла́дкое сл҃нце ѿ ѻ҆́чїю мое́ю просвѣща́ѧ и҆́же во тмѣ̀.
items.english_text: Beholding Christ lifted up upon the Cross, the unwedded bride weeping cried aloud: "The sweet Sun has set from my eyes, Who enlightens those in darkness!"

items.office: WEDNESDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви гее́ны и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆ны́хъ болѣ́зней, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный раба̀ своего̀ всенепоро́чная, и҆ прича́стника сотворѝ сн҃а и҆ бг҃а твое́го, црⷭ҇твїя.
items.english_text: *Another Canon [to the Mother of God], Same Heirmos:*

items.office: WEDNESDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣлѝ моѧ̀ я҆́звы дш҃евныѧ, и҆ мно́гомате́жнꙋю помышле́нїй бꙋ́рю влⷣчце оу҆тишѝ, и҆ ми́рное оу҆стремле́нїе мѝ пода́ждь.
items.english_text: Deliver Thy servant from Gehenna and all other torments in the hour of judgment, O all-immaculate Lady, and make him a partaker of the kingdom of Thy Son and God.

items.office: WEDNESDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Страстьмѝ нн҃ѣ распа́лшася лю́тѣ, и҆́щꙋ и҆сцѣле́нїя дш҃и мое́й всенепоро́чная: но̀ не до конца̀ менѐ ѡ҆ста́ви раба̀ твое́го дв҃о.
