items.english_text: Thy Holy Spirit revealed unlettered disciples as teachers, O Christ God; and by their eloquent, divinely inspired tongues He abolished delusion, as Thou art almighty.

items.office: THURSDAY MATINS: THE HOLY APOSTLES AND ST. NICHOLAS
items.slavonic_text: Че́стна сме́рть ст҃ы́хъ твои́хъ гдⷭи, мече́мъ
items.english_text: Precious is the death of Thy saints, O Lord (Psalm 115:6 LXX); for by sword and fire, and with contrite soul they poured forth their blood, having hope in Thee to receive the reward of their labors; they endured and received from Thee, O Savior, great mercy.

items.office: THURSDAY MATINS: THE HOLY APOSTLES AND ST. NICHOLAS
items.slavonic_text: че́мъ бо и҆ ѻ҆гне́мъ, и҆ дꙋше́ю сокрꙋше́нною пролїѧ́ша кро́вь свою̀. ᲂу҆пова́нїе и҆мꙋ́ще на́ тѧ воспрїѧ́ти трꙋдѡ́мъ мздꙋ̀. претерпѣ́ша и҆ прїѧ́ша ѿ тебѐ сп҃се ве́лїю млⷭть.
items.english_text: Thee have we acquired as a rampart, O all-immaculate Mother of God, and a calm haven and confirmation; therefore pray, and pilot and save me who am storm-tossed in this life.

items.office: THURSDAY MATINS: THE HOLY APOSTLES AND ST. NICHOLAS
items.slavonic_text: Тѧ̀ стѣ́нꙋ стѧжа́хомъ бцⷣе прчⷭтаѧ. и҆ бл҃гоꙋти́шное приста́нище и҆ ᲂу҆тверже́нїе. тѣ́мже молѝ и҆́же въ житїѝ ѡ҆бурева́емъ ѡ҆кормѝ и҆ спасѝ мѧ̀.
items.english_text: *On Thursday, the Beatitudes, Tone 4:* [^255]

items.office: THURSDAY MATINS: THE HOLY APOSTLES AND ST. NICHOLAS
items.slavonic_text: въ Четверто́къ, Блаже́нны. гла́съ, д҃.
items.english_text: On account of the tree was Adam exiled from paradise, but on account of the tree of the Cross the thief was settled in paradise; for the one by tasting transgressed the commandment of Him Who made him, while the other, crucified together with Thee, confessed Thee to be the hidden God, crying aloud: Remember me in Thy kingdom!

items.office: THURSDAY MATINS: THE HOLY APOSTLES AND ST. NICHOLAS
items.slavonic_text: посрѐди во́лкѡвъ ѿ него̀ ꙗ҆́ко а҆́гнци мрї́и посла́ни бы́сте, бж҃твеннымъ проповѣда́нїемъ, тѣ́хъ претворя́юще свирѣ́пство на кро́тость, вѣ́рою зовꙋ́ще некло́ннымъ по́мысломъ: помѧни́ на́съ во црⷭтвїи сѝ.
items.english_text: Being the rational sheep of the Shepherd and Lamb in the midst of wolves were ye sent forth by Him like gentle lambs, by divine preaching transforming their savagery into meekness, crying in faith with unwavering mind: Remember us in Thy kingdom!

items.office: THURSDAY MATINS: THE HOLY APOSTLES AND ST. NICHOLAS
items.slavonic_text: Проше́дше зе́мныѧ ко́нца а҆пⷭли гнⷭи, ꙗ҆́ко ѕвѣ́зды свѣ̑тлыѧ, помраче́нїѧ пре́лести разорѧ́ете, и҆ свѣ́тъ сп҃сенны́й прельще́ннымъ ѡ҆блиста́ете: тѣ́мже бл҃жи́мъ ва́съ хв҃и проповѣ́дници, прося́ще моли́теся ѡ҆ на́съ ко гдⷭꙋ.
items.english_text: Having traversed the ends of the earth, O apostles of the Lord, like radiant stars ye dispel the darkness of delusion, and flash forth saving light upon those who were deceived; therefore do we call you blessed, O preachers of Christ, entreating: pray unto the Lord for us.

items.office: THURSDAY MATINS: THE HOLY APOSTLES AND ST. NICHOLAS
items.slavonic_text: Сокрꙋша́еми томле́ми, и҆ ѻ҆гне́мъ веще́ственнымъ ѡ҆паля́еми, попаля́ете многобо́жїѧ го́ркꙋю ве́щь бг҃облж҃е́ннїи, и҆ нн҃ѣ и҆сточа́ете и҆сцѣле́нїемъ стрꙋѧ̑, приходя́щимъ к ва́мъ со вѣ́рою те́плою, хв҃и проповѣ́дници, и҆ вопїю́щимъ хв҃и помѧни́ на́съ во црⷭтвїи сѝ. * Сла́ва,
items.english_text: Crushed by torments and scorched by material fire, ye consumed the bitter material of polytheism, O divinely blessed ones; and now ye pour forth streams of healings unto those who come unto you with fervent faith, O preachers of Christ, and who cry: O Christ, remember us in Thy kingdom!

items.office: THURSDAY MATINS: THE HOLY APOSTLES AND ST. NICHOLAS
items.slavonic_text: Непреткнове́ннымъ по́мысломъ, мы́слїю трезва́щеся ᲂу҆че́мъ сїѐ, и҆́же во вы́шнихъ соѹще́мъ сѣдѧ́щему въ кꙋ́пѣ и҆ дх҃омъ: трⷪце нераздѣ́льнаѧ, и҆́же вся̑ сло́вомъ свои́мъ соста́вльшая, всѣ́хъ просвѣща́ющи, вѣ́рою зовꙋ́щихъ и҆ вопїю́щихъ при́снѡ, помѧни́ на́съ во црⷭтвїи сѝ. * Нн҃ѣ,
items.english_text: With unswerving mindset and sober mind let us teach this unto Him Who abides in the highest, seated together with the consubstantial Spirit: O indivisible Trinity, Who hast composed all things by Thy Word, enlightening all who in faith call upon Thee and ever cry aloud: Remember us in Thy kingdom!

items.office: THURSDAY MATINS: THE HOLY APOSTLES AND ST. NICHOLAS
items.slavonic_text: А҆пⷭлѡмъ ра́дованїе и҆ стрⷭтоте́рпцемъ вѣне́цъ невѧда́емый, вои́стиннꙋ е҆сѝ бг҃ороди́тельнице дв҃о всенепоро́чная: сни́ми же испросѝ на́мъ влⷣчце прегрѣше́нїемъ и҆збавле́нїе, и҆ житїю̀ и҆справле́нїе, вѣ́рою пою́щимъ тя̀, и҆ вопїю́щимъ: спаса́й мт҃и бж҃їя покланя́ющихся тебѣ̀.
items.english_text: In truth Thou art the joy of the apostles and the unfading crown of the passion-bearers, O all-immaculate Virgin Mother of God; with them entreat for us, O Sovereign Lady, deliverance from transgressions and amendment of life, who in faith hymn Thee and cry aloud: Save those who bow down before Thee, O Mother of God!

items.slavonic_text: Въ четверто́къ ве́черъ, На гдⷭи воззва́хъ. Стї̑ры крⷭтны.
items.english_text: *On Thursday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Stichera of the Cross, Tone 5.*

items.slavonic_text: дре́во ви́дѧщи всечестно́е, стра́стїю влчⷣнею ѡ҆брадо́ваннѡ: бл҃гть ѡ҆блистава́ющи ꙗ҆́ко пла́мень ѻ҆гнѧ̀, точа́ ꙗ҆́коже вѡ́ды дарова́нїѧ всѧ̑, дꙋ́ша просвѣща́ѧ и҆ помышле́нїѧ: недꙋ́ги ѡ҆чища́ѧ, и҆ сѣ̑ти ѿгонѧ̀, бѣ́сы дале́че прогонѧ̀ неви́димыѧ, ꙗ҆зы́ки и҆ноплеме́нныѧ побѣжда́ющи ꙗ҆́вѣ, цр҃емъ на̀ ва́рвары побѣ́ды подаю́щи всегда̀, вѣ́рнымъ сп҃сенїе и҆ ве́лїю млⷭть.
items.english_text: Let all the trees of the forest rejoice (Psalm 95:12 LXX) beholding the all-honorable Wood gladdened by the Passion of the Master, flashing forth grace like a flame of fire, pouring out all gifts like waters, enlightening souls and thoughts, cleansing diseases, driving away snares, putting to flight invisible demons afar, manifestly conquering foreign nations, ever granting victories unto rulers over barbarians, and unto the faithful salvation and great mercy.

items.slavonic_text: Мѣ́стꙋ и҆́деже стоя́стѣ но́зѣ госпо́дни, вѣ́рою покланя́ющеся, ꙗ҆́коже пррⷦкъ речѐ: хрⷭта̀ славосло́вимъ распе́ншагося, и҆́же ра́спяша согрѣше́нїя на́ша: и҆́же ѿ дре́ва разори́вшаго кля́твꙋ, и҆ примири́вша ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ̀ ѿстоѧ́щаѧ ѿни́хъ помышле́нїи: рꙋчны́ѧ же є҆гѡ̀ и҆ но́жныѧ гвѡ́здїа, ко́пїе и҆ тро́сть, рꙋ́бꙋ и҆ вѣне́цъ ѡ҆блобыза́юще, дрꙋже́нїѧ
items.english_text: Bowing down in faith before the place where the feet of the Lord stood (Psalm 131:7 LXX), even as the prophet said: we glorify the crucified Christ Who nailed our sins unto the Cross, Who abolished the curse proceeding from the tree, and reconciled unto the Father those who were estranged from Him in thoughts; kissing His hand and foot nails, the spear and reed, the robe and crown, the bonds and insults, and all other things that He endured, we piously honor them and are saved.

items.slavonic_text: и҆ нарꙋга́нїа, и҆ и҆́на є҆ли́ка подъѧ́тъ, чⷭтнѣ̀ почита́емъ и҆ сп҃о́хѡмсѧ.
items.english_text: Let us crucify all the members of our flesh, and die unto the world, and having longed to walk in the footsteps of Christ the Master of the world, let us carry His divine Cross upon our shoulders, by rejecting carnal wantonness and evil lusts that draw the soul unto sin, thinking to stand before Him and to behold Him nailed upon the Cross, Who with sighing yielded His soul into the hands of the Father, that we may ever be inseparable from Him.

items.slavonic_text: Всѧ̑ ᲂу҆́ды гдⷭни распне́мъ, и҆ мі́рови ᲂу҆мертви́мсѧ, и҆ мїроде́ржцꙋ хрⷭтꙋ̀ по стопа́мъ ходи́ти вожделѣ́вше, того̀ же на ра́мѣхъ бж҃твенный крⷭтъ носи́мъ. ѿверже́нїемъ пло́тскагѡ взыгра́нїа, и҆ по́хотей ѕлы́хъ ꙗ҆́же дꙋ́шꙋ влекꙋ́т ко грѣхꙋ̀. томꙋ̀ мнѧ́ще предста́ти, и҆ зрѣ́ти того̀ на крⷭтѣ пригвожде́нна, и҆ дꙋ́шꙋ свою̀ врꙋцѣ̀ роди́тели со воздыха́нїемъ преложи́вша, ꙗ҆́ко все́гда сни́мъ бꙋ́демъ неразлꙋ́чни.
items.english_text: *Other Stichera to the Most Holy Theotokos.*

items.slavonic_text: и҆́же недꙋ́ги всѧ̑ и҆ стрⷭти и҆сцѣля́ѧ, стрⷭть терпи́ши безъстра́стенъ сы́й по є҆стествꙋ̀ бж҃тве́нномꙋ; что́ ти безбл҃года́тнїи лю́дїе, бл҃года́телю сїѧ̑ возда́ша възмѣ́сто бл҃годѣѧ́нїй; вопїѧ́ше прчⷭтаѧ. но того̀ стрⷭтми, страсте́й мѧ̀ свободи́ти молѝ непреста́ннѡ, ꙗ҆́кода сла́влю тѧ̀.
items.english_text: When Thou, like a vine, didst behold the unplanted Cluster Whom Thou didst bud forth hanging upon the Tree, pierced with a spear in His divine ribs, what is this, cried she, O my Son and my God? How is it that Thou, Who healest all diseases and passions, sufferest Passion, being passionless according to Thy divine nature? Why have the ungrateful people rendered these things unto Thee, the Benefactor, in return for benefits? cried the all-immaculate one. But unceasingly pray Him by His Passion to deliver me from passions, that I may glorify Thee.

items.slavonic_text: Пла́чемъ всѝ и҆ рꙋ́цѣ распростре́мъ, и҆ бїе́мъ въ пе́рси те́плѣ слезѧ́щи, и҆ прекло́ньше колѣ́нѣ лице́мъ бїю́ще взѐмлю прилѣ́жнѡ, и҆ воздыха́нїа воспу́стїемъ ко высотѣ̀, и҆́же безмѣ́стными дѣ́лы прогнѣ́вавшїи бг҃а, за́повѣдей є҆го̀ ѿверже́нїемъ, и҆зба́вити зовꙋ́ще въ бꙋ́дꙋщемъ сꙋ́дѣ всѧ́каго мꙋче́нїа, и҆́же тебѐ ѡ҆печа́лившая, и҆ ѡ҆браща́ющихся молба́ми мт҃ре твое́ѧ: за́ нихже крⷭтъ претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ вопло́щься, и҆
items.english_text: Let us all weep and stretch out our hands, and strike our breasts weeping warmly, and bowing our knees, striking the earth earnestly with our face, and sending up sighing to the height, who by unfitting deeds have provoked God unto anger through rejection of His commandments, crying aloud: deliver us from all torment at the judgment to come, who have grieved Thee and are now turning back, by the supplications of Thy Mother, for whose sake Thou didst endure the Cross, being incarnate, and make us partakers of Thy kingdom!

items.slavonic_text: твое́го црⷭтвїа прича́стники сотворѝ.
items.english_text: Unto whom hast thou become likened, O my soul, ever advancing in worse things, and foolishly adding more sores unto thy wounds, so that plainly the whole body is diseased; not considering that the Judge draws near, before Whom thou shalt stand to receive the punishment and torment due unto thy deeds: but turn back and fall down before the Virgin, crying: O Sovereign Lady, Sovereign Lady, despise me not who have provoked the bountiful God, Who was born of Thee for the salvation of mankind, and was crucified in the flesh!

items.slavonic_text: рыда́юще вла́сы терза́ющи сѧ гла́голющи, ча́до: а҆́гнче всенепоро́чный: мі́ра хотѧ̀ и҆зба́вит[и] чⷭтно́ю сѝ кро́вїю, ѿ ѻ҆́чїю мое́ю ка́кѡ за́йде сп҃се; незаходи́мое сл҃нце, и҆́же всѣ̑мъ подаѧ́й просвѣще́нїе и҆ мі́ръ и҆ ве́лїю млⷭть.
items.english_text: For our redemption and as a great ransom didst Thou deign to give Thy most pure blood, O my sinless Christ, desiring that all should obtain salvation; therefore Thy Mother, beholding Thee sobbing and tearing her hair, cried aloud: O Child, all-immaculate Lamb, Who desirest to redeem the world by Thy precious blood: how hast Thou set from mine eyes, O Savior, O unsetting Sun, Who grantest enlightenment, and peace, and great mercy unto all!

items.slavonic_text: Гдⷭи, при мѡѷсе́и и҆ногда̀ пррⷦцѣ, то́чїю воѡбраже́нїе крⷭта твое́го ꙗ҆влѧ́ѧся, побѣжда́ше врагѝ твоѧ̑: нн҃ѣ́ же са́мый крⷭтъ держа́ще, по́мощи про́симъ: ᲂу҆твердѝ цр҃ковь свою̀, и҆ да́рꙋй цр҃ю на́шемꙋ побѣ́дꙋ, ꙗ҆́кѡ цр҃ю константи́нꙋ, мно́гїя ра́ди млⷭти чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: *On the Aposticha, Stichera, Tone 5:* [^259]

items.slavonic_text: Крⷭтъ тво́й хрⷭтѐ, а҆́ще и҆ дре́во ви́димо є҆́стъ сꙋ́ществомъ, но бж҃твенною ѡ҆дѣ́ѧнно є҆́стъ си́лою, и҆ чꙋ́вственнѡ мі́рови ꙗ҆вля́ѧся, мы́сленнѡ на́ше чꙋдотво́ритъ сп҃се́нїе
items.english_text: O Lord, when of old under Moses the prophet only the prefiguration of Thy Cross was manifested, it conquered Thine enemies; but now holding the Cross itself, we ask for help: establish Thy Church, and grant victory unto our ruler as unto King Constantine, for the sake of Thy great mercy, O Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: є҆мꙋ́же покланѧ́ющеся сла́вимъ тѧ̀ сп҃се, поми́лꙋй на́съ.
items.english_text: Though Thy Cross is visible as wood in its essence, O Christ, yet is it clothed with divine power; and being sensibly manifested unto the world, it noetically works our salvation bowing down before which, we glorify Thee, O Savior: have mercy on us!

items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ зе́мныхъ всѣ́хъ нерадивше, и҆ намꙋ́ки мꙋ́жески дерзнꙋ́вше, блаже́нныхъ наде́ждъ непогрѣши́сте, но нбⷭно́мꙋ црⷭтвїю наслѣ́дници бы́сте, всехва́льнїи мч҃нци, и҆́мꙋще дерзнове́нїе ко чл҃колю́бцꙋ бг҃ꙋ, мі́рꙋ ᲂу҆мире́нїе и҆спроси́те, и҆ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ ве́лїю ми́лость. * Сла́ва и҆ Нн҃ѣ, Бг҃о.
items.english_text: Having had no regard for all earthly things, and manfully braving torments, ye failed not of your blessed hopes, but became heirs of the heavenly kingdom, O all-praised martyrs; possessing boldness before God the Lover of mankind, entreat peace for the world and great mercy for our souls.

items.slavonic_text: Зрѧ́щи дре́вле а҆́гнца своего̀ дв҃ая мт҃и и҆ всеблж҃еннаѧ ѿрокови́ца, на крⷭтъ возвы́шенна, вопїѧ́ше слезѧ́щи: ᲂу҆вы̀ мнѣ̀ сн҃е мо́й, ка́ко ᲂу҆мира́еши; бг҃ъ є҆́стствомъ сы́й безсме́ртенъ.
items.english_text: Beholding of old her Lamb lifted up upon the Cross, the Virgin Mother and all-blessed Maiden cried aloud with tears: Woe is me, O my Son, how diest Thou, Who by nature art immortal God?

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: въ Пѧ́токъ на Оу҆́трени по а҃ стїхѡ҃, Сѣⷣ крⷭтны Гла́съ е҃.
items.english_text: *On Friday at Matins, after the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 5:*

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: живо́тный, тебѣ̀ сп҃се въ на́ше весе́лїе сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_text: The Place of the Skull became paradise; for no sooner was the wood of the Cross planted, than straightway budded forth the Cluster of life; glory to Thee, O Savior, unto our gladness, glory to Thee!

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Распе́ншагося сп҃са и҆ и҆зба́вителя на́шего во́лею ꙗ҆́коже бг҃ъ, и҆ ꙗ҆́коже бл҃го и҆зво́ли, воспои́мъ вѣ́рнїи и҆ просла́вимъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ пригвоздѝ на крⷭтѣ̀ грѣхѝ чл҃кѡмъ, и҆збавля́я ѿ пре́лести ро́дъ чл҃чкїй, и҆ црⷭтвїи сподо́билъ є҆́стъ. * Сла́ва, и҆ Нн҃ѣ, крⷭтобг҃о.
items.english_text: Let us, the faithful, hymn and glorify our Savior and Deliverer, Who was crucified willingly as God, and as He was well pleased; for He nailed the sins of mankind unto the Cross, delivering the human race from deception, and vouchsafed us the kingdom.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ крⷭта̀ гнⷭя предстоя́щи и҆ногда̀, рыда́ше вопїю́щи бцⷣа чⷭтаѧ, ᲂу҆вы̀ мнѣ̀ ѽ ча́до моѐ, ᲂу҆вы̀ мнѣ̀ свѣ́те ѻ҆чи́ма мои́ма, ка́ко простре́ся на крⷭтѣ̀; простры́й бж҃твеннѣ нб҃о ꙗ҆́кѡ ко́жꙋ, и҆ ѿ мо́ря возводѧ̀ и҆сто́чники во́дъ твои́мъ повелѣ́нїемъ.
items.english_text: Standing of old by the Cross of the Lord, the pure Mother of God sobbed, crying aloud: Woe is me, O my Child! Woe is me, the light of mine eyes! How art Thou stretched out upon the Cross, Who by divine power didst stretch out heaven like a curtain (Psalm 103:2 LXX), and by Thy command bringest forth fountains of waters from the sea!

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: По в҃, стїхоло́гїи. Сѣда́лна Гла́съ, е҃.
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Stichology, Sessional Hymns, Tone 5:*

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Распа́тїе претерпѣ́въ во́льнымъ совѣ́томъ, и҆ тлѣ́нїя чл҃ки свободи́лъ є҆сѝ сп҃се, воспѣва́емъ вѣ́рнїи и҆ покланя́емъ ти сѧ, ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: Having endured crucifixion by Thy voluntary counsel, Thou hast delivered mankind from corruption, O Savior; we, the faithful, hymn Thee and bow down before Thee, for Thou hast enlightened us by the power of the Cross, and all of us glorify Thee, O bountiful Lover of mankind, as Giver of life and Lord.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: просвѣти́лъ є҆сѝ на́съ си́лою крⷭтною, и҆ всѝ славосло́вимъ тя̀ чл҃колю́бче ще́дрый, ꙗ҆́кѡ жизнода́вца и҆ гдⷭа.
items.english_text: Willingly hast Thou, O bountiful One, endured the Cross, and as almighty God Thou hast blotted out the ancient curse incurred on account of the eating [of the fruit]; therefore, O Master Christ, we hymn and venerate Thy divine and precious Sufferings, unceasingly glorifying Thy dispensation which is beyond word.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Во́лею ще́дрый крⷭтъ претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ дре́внюю кля́твꙋ ꙗ҆́же ра́ди снѣ́ди, ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́льный бг҃ъ потреби́лъ є҆сѝ: тѣ́мже бж҃е́ственныя и҆ чⷭтны́я стрⷭти твоя̑ влⷣко хрⷭтѐ, пое́мъ и҆ покланя́емся, славосло́вя́ще непреста́нно, и҆́же па́че сло́ва смотрє́нїе твоѐ. * Мч҃ниченъ.
items.english_text: Today the memory of the passion-bearers shines forth, for they have illumination from the heavens; the choir of angels makes festival, and the human race celebrates with them; therefore they pray, O Lord, that our souls may find mercy.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Сїя́етъ дне́сь па́мять стрⷭтоте́рпецъ, и҆́мꙋтъ бо со нб҃съ ѡ҆заре́нїе. ли́къ а҆́гглъскїй торжествꙋ́етъ, и҆ чл҃чкїй ро́дъ спра́зднꙋетъ: тѣ́мже мо́лятся гдⷭи, поми́ловатися дꙋша́мъ на́шимъ. * Сла́ва, и҆ Нн҃ѣ, крⷭтобг҃о.
items.english_text: *Glory; Both now: Stavrotheotokion:* [^260]

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: ская си́ла попра́на бы́сть, сего̀ ра́ди тя̀ вѣ́рнїи подо́лгꙋ при́снѡ воспѣва́емъ и҆ бл҃гослови́мъ, бцⷣꙋ вои́стиннꙋ и҆сповѣ́да́юще тя̀ велича́емъ. * По г҃, стїх, Сѣд гла́съ, е҃. подо́бенъ, Собе́.
items.english_text: By the Cross of Thy Son, O Lady full of divine joy, all idol deception hath been trampled down; therefore do we, the faithful, ever duly hymn and bless Thee, and confessing Thee truly to be the Mother of God, we magnify Thee.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: На крⷭтѣ́ тя пригвожде́нна ᲂу҆вѣ́дѣвша, а҆́гглⷭтїи чи́нове ви́дѣвше ᲂу҆страши́шася [в]себѣ́хъ цр҃ю, побѣжде́ни быва́хꙋ а҆́бїе бѣсо́встїи по́лци, и҆ сокрꙋши́шася верея̀ а҆́довы, и҆ сме́ртное мꙋчи́телство низложи́ся, и҆ сꙋ́щїи во гро́бѣ ме́ртвїи воскресо́ша. * Сла́ва и҆ Нн҃ѣ, крⷭтобг҃оро́диченъ.
items.english_text: *After the 3rd Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5.*

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: На крⷭтѣ́ тя хрⷭтѐ зря́щи мт҃и твоя̀ во́лею посредѣ̀ разбо́йникꙋ ви́сима, бїю́щи ма́терски пе́рси гла́ше. безгрѣ́шне сн҃ꙋ, ка́ко непра́ведно на крⷭтѣ̀ ꙗ҆́коже злодѣ́й пригвозди́ся, и҆ чл҃чкїй ро́дъ хотя̀ ѡ҆живи́ти, ꙗ҆́кѡ преблагі́й.
items.english_text: When the angelic ranks beheld Thee nailed upon the Cross, they were struck with dread within themselves, O King of all; straightway the demonic hosts were vanquished, the bars of Hades were shattered, the tyranny of death was cast down, and the dead who were in the tombs were raised up.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Кано́ честно́мꙋ и҆ животворя́щемꙋ крⷭтꙋ̀. Гла́съ, е҃. Пѣ́ а҆, І҆рмо́. Сп҃телю бг҃ꙋ,
items.english_text: Beholding Thee, O Christ, hanging willingly upon the Cross between the two thieves, Thy Mother, beating her maternal breast, cried aloud: O sinless Son, how art Thou unjustly nailed upon the Cross like an evildoer, desiring to make the human race alive, as Thou art exceedingly good!

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Страстоꙋбі́йственнꙋю хрⷭтѐ, хоте́нїемъ свои́мъ претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ стрⷭть, и҆ ᲂу҆би́лъ є҆сѝ и҆́же въ раѝ дре́вле на́съ ᲂу҆би́вшаго. тѣ́мже твоя̑ сла́вимъ бл҃госты̑ни.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Precious and Life-giving Cross, Tone 5. Ode 1. Heirmos: Unto the Savior God...* [^261]

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Воздви́жеся на крⷭтъ, и҆ низпаде́ся вра́гъ, и҆ па́дшїи вознесо́хо́мся, и҆ ра́йстїи жи́телїе хрⷭтѐ бы́хомъ, держа́вꙋ сла́вя́ще црⷭтвїя твое́го. * Мꙋ́чениченъ.
items.english_text: By Thine own will, O Christ, hast Thou endured the passion-slaying Passion, and hast slain him who of old slew us in paradise; therefore do we glorify Thy bounties.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Щи́томъ крⷭтнымъ воѡрꙋжи́вшеся до́брѣ покоре́нїи вся́комꙋ мꙋчи́теля ѡ҆полчи́стеся, премꙋ́дрїи великомч҃нци, и҆ того̀ побѣди́вше, сла́вꙋ полꙋчи́сте.
items.english_text: Thou wast lifted up upon the Cross, and the enemy fell down, and we who were fallen were exalted and became citizens of paradise, O Christ, glorifying the dominion of Thy kingdom.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́гнци честні́и и҆́же на́съ ра́ди стра́далцꙋ, а҆́гнцꙋ пожре́нномꙋ принесо́стеся, ме́рзкїя же́ртвы ꙗ҆́вѣ ᲂу҆ста́вльше, тѣ́мъ же ва́съ ᲂу҆блажа́емъ прехва́льнїи. * Бг҃о.
items.english_text: Well armed with the shield of the Cross, ye set yourselves in array against every submission unto the tormentor, O most wise great-martyrs; and having conquered him, ye received glory.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Но́во ѿроча̀ на́мъ, ветха́го де́нми чⷭтая
items.english_text: As honorable lambs were ye offered up unto the sacrificed Lamb Who suffered for our sake, having plainly put an end to abominable sacrifices; therefore do we call you blessed, O all-praised ones.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: дв҃о породи́ла є҆сѝ, ѡ҆ветша́вшее є҆стество̀ чл҃чкое ѡ҆бновля́юща всенепоро́чная, бж҃твенною стра́стїю свое́ю.
items.english_text: A new Child unto us, O pure Virgin, Him Who is Ancient of Days hast Thou brought forth, Who renews aged human nature by His divine Passion, O all-immaculate one.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ Кано́нъ прест҃ѣ́й бцⷣи, І҆рмо́съ то́йже.
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos, same Heirmos:*

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Бл҃гоꙋтро́бїа и҆сто́чникъ и҆ предста́телницꙋ те́плꙋ вѣ́мъ тя̀ всенепоро́чная, дв҃о мт҃и мрї́е, и҆ воззыва́ю тѝ, поми́лꙋй и҆ ᲂу҆ще́дри смире́ннꙋю мѝ дꙋ́шꙋ.
items.english_text: A fountain of tender compassion and a fervent protectress do I know Thee to be, O all-immaculate Virgin Mother Mary; and I cry aloud unto Thee: have mercy and show compassion unto my humble soul!

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Внѣ́дрехъ твои́хъ сн҃ъ бж҃їй чⷭтая всели́ся, и҆ воспрїѧ́тъ чл҃чкое сꙋ́щество ꙗ҆́кѡ пребл҃гъ, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆зба́ви ѿ тлѝ ѕмі́евъ.
items.english_text: Within Thy womb the Son of God took up His abode, O pure one, and assumed human nature as He is exceedingly good, and delivered all from the corruption of the serpent.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣще́нїе мѝ бꙋ́ди и҆ спасе́нїю наде́жда, бг҃ороди́телнице всенепоро́чная, прегрѣше́нїй раздрѣша́ющи плени́цꙋ, и҆ и҆збавля́ющи мя̀ бꙋ́дꙋщїя мꙋ́ки и҆ ѡ҆сꙋжде́нїя.
items.english_text: Be Thou my illumination and hope of salvation, O all-immaculate Mother of God, loosing the bonds of my transgressions, and delivering me from future torment and condemnation.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Помышле́нїй лꙋка́выхъ смире́ннꙋю мѝ дꙋ́шꙋ свободѝ бг҃ороди́телнице, и҆ жили́ще
items.english_text: Deliver my humble soul from evil thoughts, O Mother of God, and make it a dwelling place that I may ever duly glorify Thee.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: бж҃їе тꙋ̀ содѣ́лай, да подо́лгꙋ тя̀ сла́влю всегда̀. * Пѣ́снь г҃, І҆рмо́съ: Си́лою крⷭта̀ твое́го.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos: By the power of Thy Cross...* [^262]

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆вѧда́еши пло́дъ тлѣ́нїя, на́ дре́во сп҃се воздвиза́емъ, нетлѣ́нїя и҆сто́чникъ на́мъ ѿ ре́бра и҆сточа́еши влⷣко.
items.english_text: Lifted up upon the Tree, O Savior, Thou causest the fruit of corruption to wither; and from Thy side Thou pourest forth unto us the fountain of incorruption, O Master.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Закла́лся є҆сѝ ꙗ҆́коже а҆́гнецъ на крⷭтѣ̀, пра́ги назна́менꙋя дꙋ́шъ на́шихъ, бж҃твенною тѝ кро́вїю влⷣко, тѣ́мже тя̀ состра́хомъ сла́вимъ. * Мꙋ́нче.
items.english_text: Thou wast slaughtered like a lamb upon the Cross, marking the doorposts of our souls with Thy divine blood, O Master; therefore with fear do we glorify Thee.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Вя́жеми хв҃и страда́лцы, и҆ многоѡ́бразнѣ ᲂу҆раня́еми, и҆ ѕвѣре́мъ помета́еми, непоколеби́ми пребы́сте. * мꙋ́нченъ.
items.english_text: Bound, O sufferers of Christ, and wounded in manifold ways, and cast unto beasts, ye remained unshaken.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже гро́здїе живо́тнаго виногра́да, мꙋче́нїя вино̀ и҆сточи́ша, вѣ́рныхъ хв҃а срⷣца веселя́щее, бг҃а на́шегѡ мч҃нци. * Бг҃о:
items.english_text: Like clusters of the living Vine, the martyrs of Christ our God poured forth the wine of suffering, gladdening the hearts of the faithful.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: пои́щыѧ тѧ̀. * И҆́нъ, І҆рмо́съ то́йже.
items.english_text: Revealing Thee as mediatress of life unto us, O pure one, Thy Son and Lord appeared dead upon the Tree, glorifying those who hymn Thee.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Ро́въ поги́белный лю́тыхъ согрѣше́нїй впа́дша мѧ̀, бг҃оро́ди́тельнице и҆зведѝ бл҃гоꙋтро́бною сѝ бл҃гостїю.
items.english_text: Deliver me, who have fallen into the ruinous pit of grievous sins, O Mother of God, by Thy tender bounty!

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Кве́черꙋ житїѧ̀ прише́дъ, и҆ недоꙋмѣ́нїемъ ѡ҆держи́мъ є҆́смъ, вопїю́ти всепѣ́тая, ты̀ помо́щница мѝ ꙗ҆ви́ся.
items.english_text: Having arrived at the evening of my life, and being held fast by perplexity, I cry aloud unto Thee, O all-hymned one: show Thyself to be my helper!

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Ст҃аѧ бцⷣе чⷭтаѧ, пода́ждь раздрѣше́нїе прегрѣше́нїемъ мои̑мъ, сп҃се́нїе мѝ и҆спросѝ и҆ ра́дованїе вѣ́чное.
items.english_text: O holy, pure Mother of God, grant remission of my transgressions; entreat salvation and eternal joy for me!

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Ка́пли мѝ слеза́мъ чⷭтая пода́ждь, ꙗ҆́кѡ да ѿ срⷣца мое́го ѿженꙋ̀ недоꙋмѣ́нїе, и҆ нескве́рно воспою́ тя. * Пѣ́ д҃ І҆рмо́, Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ.
items.english_text: Grant me drops of tears, O pure one, that from my heart I may drive away perplexity and unstainedly hymn Thee.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Е҆гда̀ за́йде на крⷭтѣ̀ сл҃нце пра́ведное хрⷭтѐ, свѣ́тъ невече́рнїй возсїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ на́мъ, пою́щимъ твоѐ сло́ве мно́гое схожде́нїе.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos: I heard the report of Thee...* [^263]

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Стоя́щꙋ тѝ предсꙋди́тельнымъ сꙋди́щемъ
items.english_text: When the Sun of righteousness set upon the Cross, O Christ, Thou, the unwaning Light, didst shine forth upon us who hymn Thine exceeding condescension, O Word!

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: хрⷭтѐ, ѡ҆сꙋди́лъ є҆сѝ непра́ведно вра́га, и҆ ра́спялся є҆сѝ посредѣ̀ непра́ведной, на́съ ѡ҆правда́ѧ. * Мꙋ́нченъ.
items.english_text: When Thou stoodest before the tribunal of judgment O Christ, Thou didst unjustly condemn the enemy, and wast crucified between the unjust, justifying us.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Вѣнча́еми побѣди́телно гдⷭи страда́лцы, неви́димаго посрами́ша вра́га, и҆ воззыва́хꙋ: сла́ва си́лѣ твое́й гдⷭи. * мꙋ́нченъ.
items.english_text: Victoriously crowned, O Lord, the sufferers put the invisible enemy to shame, and cried aloud: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Невѧда́емыѧ цвѣ́ты мы́сленаго рая̀, многоцѣ́нныя сосꙋ́ды хв҃ы, стрⷭтоно́сцы соше́дшеся вѣ́рою да почти́мъ. * Бг҃о.
items.english_text: Coming together in faith, let us honor the passion-bearers as unfading flowers of the spiritual paradise and precious vessels of Christ!

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ ви́дѣ на крⷭтѣ̀ хрⷭта̀, є҆го́же роди́ла є҆сѝ чⷭтая, дивля́шеся неска́занномꙋ є҆го̀ снисхожде́нїю, тѣ́мже тя̀ сни́мъ прославля́емъ. * И҆́нъ І҆рмо́съ, то́йже.
items.english_text: When the pure one beheld Christ upon the Cross, Whom she had brought forth, she marveled at His ineffable condescension; therefore do we glorify Thee together with Him.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Содѣѧ́нїемъ мои́мъ лꙋка́вымъ и҆ прегрѣше́нїй мно́гихъ, кто̀ возмо́жетъ ᲂу҆моли́ти сꙋдїю̀, а҆́ще не ты́ чⷭтая, є҆ди́на согрѣша́ющымъ застꙋ́пнице:
items.english_text: Because of my evil deeds and many transgressions, who shall be able to appease the Judge, if not Thou, O pure one, the only protectress of sinners?

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Мно́гими мя̀ па́дша прегрѣше́нїи, и҆ грѣхы̀ порабо́тивша си дш҃ꙋ, воздви́гни си́льною твое́ю мл҃твою, и҆ раздрѣши́ мя ѿ работы̀ пречⷭтая.
items.english_text: Having fallen into many transgressions, and having enslaved my soul unto sins, raise me up by Thy mighty prayer, and loose me from bondage, O all-immaculate one.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ ро́ждшїя тво́рца и҆ цр҃я вся́ческихъ, бцⷣе всенепоро́чная чⷭтая, ты́ мя и҆зба́ви вся́каго скве́рнаго согрѣше́нїя.
items.english_text: As Thou hast brought forth the Creator and King of all, O all-immaculate, pure Mother of God, do Thou deliver me from every foul transgression.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Себѐ сама́го пла́чꙋ, є҆гда̀ вопомышле́нїе прїидꙋ̀ мно́гихъ мѝ прегрѣше́нїй, и҆ ѻ҆гня̀ негаси́маго. и҆ молю́ся, да́ждь мѝ вре́мя покаѧ́нїа пречⷭтая.
items.english_text: I weep for myself when I come to the recollection of my many transgressions and of the unquenchable fire; and I pray: Grant me time for repentance, O all-immaculate one!

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь є҃, І҆рмо́съ. Оу҆́треннююще вопїе́мъ ти гдⷭи,
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos: Early in the morning we cry unto Thee, O Lord...* [^264]

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Ка́менїе тя̀ на ка́мени ѡ҆щꙋти́вше воздви́женна хрⷭтѐ, распаде́ся, и҆ землѝ потрясо́шася ѡ҆снова́нїа.
items.english_text: Perceiving Thee lifted up upon the Stone, O Christ, the stones were split, and the foundations of the earth were shaken.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Ѿложѝ свѣ́тлость сл҃нце, воздвиже́ннꙋ тѝ на дре́во, сл҃нце пра́ведное долготерпѣли́ве.
items.english_text: The sun laid aside its brightness when Thou wast lifted up upon the Tree, O Sun of righteousness, Long-suffering One!

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: чꙋде́съ блиста́ете ст҃і́и сїѧ́нїа, тмꙋ̀ ѿгонѧ́юще болѣ́зней дх҃омъ. * Мꙋ́нченъ.
items.english_text: Ye flash forth the radiant light of miracles, O holy ones, driving away the darkness of infirmities by the Spirit.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Разсѣка́хꙋтелеса ва́ша ме́чы, дх҃ъ же́ бж҃твенныя любвѐ, несѣка́емъ и҆мѣ́сте мч҃еници. * Бг҃о:
items.english_text: Swords cut your bodies in pieces, but the spirit of divine love ye held uncut, O martyrs.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Ви́дѣвше на крⷭтѣ̀ воздви́жена влⷣкꙋ, рыда́ющи восклица́ше, дв҃о мт҃и всенепоро́чна.
items.english_text: Beholding the Master lifted up upon the Cross, weeping, she cried aloud, the Virgin Mother all-immaculate.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Всетеле́снꙋю мѝ ꙗ҆́звꙋ прїе́мшꙋ грѣхмѝ, бы́лїемъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́й млⷭрдїя твое́го блⷣчце.
items.english_text: Having received wounds over all my body through sins, heal me, O Sovereign Lady, by the herb of Thy tender mercy!

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе тлѣ́нїи дре́вле ᲂу҆ста́вила є҆сѝ бж҃веннымъ ржⷭтво́мъ, нн҃ѣ́ прегрѣше́нїй мои́хъ ᲂу҆ста́ви тече́нїе пренепоро́чная.
items.english_text: Of old Thou didst halt the flow of corruption by Thy divine childbirth; now halt the flow of my transgressions, O all-immaculate one.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Поми́лꙋй и҆ ᲂу҆ще́дри блⷣчце дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀, и҆ и҆зба́ви ѡ҆сꙋжде́нїя, и҆ вѣ́чныѧ мꙋ́ки,
items.english_text: Have mercy and show compassion, O Sovereign Lady, upon my soul, and deliver me from condemnation and eternal torment.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: при́зри и҆ ᲂу҆слы́ши блⷣчце гла́съ мо́й, и҆ моленїа и҆зба́ви мя̀ вѣ́чнагѡ мꙋче́нїа.
items.english_text: Look upon me and give ear, O Sovereign Lady, unto my voice, and by my supplication deliver me from eternal torment.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos: The abyss hath surrounded me...*

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭтъ на землѝ водрꙋжа́шеся, и҆ паде́нїе бѣсо́мъ быва́ше, и҆ вѣ́рѣ ᲂу҆твержде́нїя нача́ло прїима́ше, и҆ зло́ба ѿсре́ды ѿгони́ма быва́ше.
items.english_text: The Cross was set up upon the earth, and the fall of demons came to pass, and the confirmation of the faith received a beginning, and malice was driven away from our midst.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Сл҃нце ᲂу҆гле́ пло́ть ꙗ҆́ко свѣщꙋ̀ возже́гшꙋ тѝ на дре́вѣ гдⷭи: дра́хма же ѡ҆брѣта́шеся погребе́нная мра́чными страстьми. * Мꙋ́.
items.english_text: The sun beheld Thy Flesh ignited like a lamp upon the Tree, O Lord; and the drachma was found, which had been buried by murky passions.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Воздви́жемъ чл҃колю́бче надре́во, ли́къ послѣ́дꙋющихъ стопа́мъ твои̑мъ и҆мѣ́лъ є҆сѝ мч҃нки, стра́сти твое́й подо́бящеся, безстра́стїю хода́тайственныѧ. * Мꙋ́.
items.english_text: When Thou wast lifted up upon the Tree, O Lover of mankind, Thou hadst a choir of martyrs following Thy steps, imitating Thy Passion, which mediate passionlessness.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Пото́ки и҆зсꙋши́сте пре́лести, кро́вными тече́нми, и҆ ѻ҆́гнь погаси́сте тꙋ́ждїй бѣсо́вскїй, бж҃тве́нною росо́ю, вѣ́чено́сци мч҃нци. * Бг҃оро́диченъ.
items.english_text: Ye dried up the torrents of delusion with streams of blood, and quenched the alien demonic fire with divine dew, O crown-bearing martyrs.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆рꙋ́жїе срⷣце твоѐ про́йде всенепоро́чная, є҆гда̀ распина́ема зижди́теля ви́дѣвши,
items.english_text: A sword pierced Thy heart, O all-immaculate one (Luke 2:35), when Thou didst behold the Creator being crucified and His divine side being pierced with a spear.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: и҆ ко́пїемъ бж҃тве́нная ре́бра и҆скопова́ема.
items.english_text: An abyss of transgressions hath surrounded me, casting me down, O pure one, into the depth of despair; therefore lead me up from the nethermost hades, who glorify Thee.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна согрѣше́нїй, во глꙋбинꙋ̀ низлага́ющи чⷭтая ѿча́нїя, тѣ́мже мя̀ возведѝ ѿ а҆́да преиспѡ́днаго, тебѐ сла́вящаго.
items.english_text: Raise me up, who lie upon the bed of transgressions, O all-immaculate Sovereign Lady, and grant me saving enlightenment through repentance.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Воздви́гни мя̀ лежа́ща на ѻ҆дрѣ̀ согрѣше́нїй пречⷭтая бл҃чце, и҆ да́ждь мѝ ѡ҆сїя́нїе спасе́нное покаѧ́нїемъ.
items.english_text: Purify, O Lover of mankind, by the prayers of her who purely gave Thee birth, and deliver Thy world from every affliction, and vouchsafe unto eternal glory.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆чисти чл҃колю́бче, мл҃твами чⷭто ро́жшїа тя̀, и҆ и҆зба́ви мі́ръ тво́й ѿ вся́кїа ско́рби, и҆ вѣ́чнѣй сла́вѣ сподо́би.
items.english_text: Departing from communion in evil deeds, yet ever grieving my Master with falsehood, O all-immaculate Sovereign Lady, do Thou grant me amendment!

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Приѡбщли́ва́нїа дѣ́лъ ѕлы́хъ ѿстꙋпи́ти, при́нѡ лжо́ꙋ ѡ҆скорбля́я влⷣкꙋ моего̀, пречⷭтая бл҃чце, ты́ ми пода́ждь и҆справле́нїе.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos: In the furnace of fire...* [^265]

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: вкꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ хрⷭтѐ, сла́дости жи́зненная.
items.english_text: That we might be delivered from voluptuous sin Thou didst taste gall, O Christ, Thou vital Sweetness!

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆язвле́ннꙋ тѝ сѐ на крⷭтѣ̀, ꙗ҆́звы и҆сцѣли́шася а҆да́мовы многолѣ́тныя. * Мꙋ́,
items.english_text: When Thou wast wounded upon the Cross, Adam's ancient wounds of many years were healed.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Поче́тше бг҃а болѣ́знымъ бл҃гоче́стїемъ, вы́шнїи полꙋчи́сте по́честь страда́лци. * Мꙋ́.
items.english_text: Having honored God with painful piety, ye obtained the supreme honor, O sufferers.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Во́лными ᲂу҆стремле́нми, дерзнꙋ́вше ко страда́нїю страстоте́рпци, и҆ побѣди́телїе ꙗ҆ви́шася. * Бг҃о:
items.english_text: With voluntary impulse daring unto suffering, the passion-bearers showed themselves victors.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: По ржⷭтвѣ̀ чⷭтая ꙗ҆́коже пре́жде ржⷭтва̀ пребыва́еши, бг҃ъ бо бѣ̀ рожде́нїа, да ѡ҆божи́тъ чл҃ки.
items.english_text: After childbirth, O pure one, even as before childbirth, Thou remainest; for God was Thy Child, that He might deify mankind.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ороди́телнице чи́стая непре́зри менѐ, и҆́же вѣ́рою подъ кро́въ тво́й при́снѡ прибѣга́ющаго.
items.english_text: O pure Mother of God, despise me not who ever flee with faith beneath Thy protection.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Страсте́й мои́хъ па́жить и҆зсꙋша́ющи, пода́ждь точи́ти слеза́мъ ка́пля бг҃ороди́телнице.
items.english_text: Drying up the pasture of my passions, grant me to pour forth drops of tears, O Mother of God bound with the chains of sin, loose me by Thy prayers, O all-immaculate, all-hymned one who didst give birth unto God.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Связа́ема вери́гами грѣхо́вными, твоими мл҃твами разрѣшѝ пренепоро́чная, всепѣ́тая бг҃а поро́ждшая.
items.english_text: Unto Thee do I flee in faith, and Thee do I invoke, O pure one; deliver me, O Virgin, from eternal fire.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Ктебѣ̀ прибѣга́ю вѣ́рно, и҆ тебѐ чⷭтая призыва́ю, и҆зба́ви мя̀ дв҃о ѻ҆гня̀ вѣ́чнаго.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos: Him Who from the Father before the ages...* [^266]

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь и҃. І҆рмо́. И҆з̾ ѻ҆ц҃а̀ пре́жде вѣ̑къ.
items.english_text: O exceedingly good One Who healest the curse of the tree by the Tree, and pourest forth deliverance unto mankind: Thee do we hymn, O Savior, and Thee do we glorify unto ages of ages!

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же кля́твꙋ дре́ва, дре́вомъ и҆сцѣля́я, и҆збавле́нїе и҆сточи́вый чл҃кѡмъ преблагі́й, тебѐ сп҃се пое́мъ и҆ тебѐ сла́вимъ во вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: By Thy Cross Thou didst humble the exalted serpent, and didst raise up him who had fallen grievously and humbled himself: Thee do we hymn, O Savior, and Thee do we glorify unto ages of ages!

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Превозноша́емаго ѕмі́я, крⷭто́мъ свои́мъ смири́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ лю́тѣ па́дшагося смири́вшася возне́слъ є҆сѝ: тебѐ сп҃се пое́мъ, и҆ тебѐ славосло́вя́ща во вѣ́ки. * Мꙋ́.
items.english_text: The destroyers of delusion, and ramparts of the divine faith, pillars of the Church, true solid adamants, the warriors of Christ, let us honor in faith with hymns, the passion-bearers!

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Сла́вні́и страстоте́рпци ꙗ҆́коже сл҃нце ѡ҆блиста́вше, ра́намъ ѡ҆́блаки разгна́вше бл҃гтїю, и҆ нече́стїа мра́къ разори́ша вѣ́рою тро́ическою. * Бг҃о.
items.english_text: The glorious passion-bearers, flashing forth like the sun, dispelled the clouds of wounds by grace, and destroyed the darkness of impiety through faith in the Trinity.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Невѣ́стоводи́тель тебѣ̀ дв҃о гаврїи́лъ посла́нъ бы́сть, ра́дꙋйся вопїя́ше тѝ гла́голя: свѣтлѣ́йшая пола́то всѣ́хъ цр҃я хрⷭта̀, въ ню́же всели́ся ѡ҆божѝ чл҃ки.
items.english_text: As a bridal conductor unto Thee, O Virgin, Gabriel was sent, crying aloud unto Thee: Rejoice, O most radiant palace of Christ the King of all, dwelling wherein He deified mankind!

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Внедоꙋмѣ́нїи сꙋ́ща и҆ се́рдцемъ и҆ мы́слїю, поꙋще́нїа гее́нскаго небоя́ся согрѣша́ю при́нѡ: но ты́ дв҃о недоꙋмѣ́нїе моѐ разрѣшѝ, и҆ ѻ҆гня̀ и҆зба́ви мя̀.
items.english_text: Being in perplexity of both heart and mind, not fearing the chastisement of Gehenna, I sin unceasingly; but do Thou, O Virgin, resolve my perplexity, and deliver me from fire!

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Сластьмѝ пло́ти мое́я ча́сто привланчи́мъ є҆́смъ, и҆ ꙗ҆́ко плѣ́ненъ продае́мъ є҆́смь, бг҃а прогнѣ́ва́я при́нѡ: бцⷣе є҆ди́на наде́жда ненаде́жнымъ сама̀ поми́лꙋй мя̀.
items.english_text: By the pleasures of my flesh I am often dragged down, and like a captive I am sold, ever provoking God to anger; O Mother of God, sole hope of the hopeless, do Thou Thyself have mercy on me!

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́ко непосты́дна є҆́стъ мл҃тва твоя̀ всенепоро́чная:
items.english_text: Since Thy prayer is never put to shame, O all-immaculate whatsoever Thou desirest Thou grantest, entreating Thy Son and God; therefore do I pray Thee: have mercy and save my humble soul!

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: поро́чная: є҆ли́како хо́щеши подае́ши, моля́щи своего̀ сн҃а и҆ бг҃а: тѣ́мжети ся̀ молю̀, поми́лꙋй и҆ сп҃си смире́ннꙋю дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀.
items.english_text: By bodily sicknesses, and passionate tumults, and cruel wounds of soul I am grievously consumed; O Thou who alone didst give birth to the Benefactor, make me whole by Thy supplications!

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Теле́сными болѣ́зньми, и҆ стра́стными водвиже́ньми, и҆ дꙋшевными ра́нами лю́тѣ и҆стаѧва́емъ є҆́смъ, ро́ждшая є҆ди́на бл҃года́теля, твои́ми молба́ми здра́ва сотвори́ мя.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos: Thee Who beyond mind...* [^267]

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃, І҆рмо́, Тя̀ па́че ᲂу҆ма̀,
items.english_text: The strength and dominion of the enemy was taken away, O only mighty Lord, when Thou wast lifted up upon the Cross, and didst bathe Thy fingers in blood thereon.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пость вра́жїя и҆ держа́ва ѿя́та бы́сть, держа́вный є҆ди́не гдⷭи: на крⷭтъ вознесе́нꙋ тѝ, и҆ пе́рсты на не́мъ ѡ҆крова́вившꙋ.
items.english_text: They pierced Thy hands and Thy feet, O my Christ, and numbered Thy bones (Psalm 21:17–19 LXX), when lawless men crucified Thee and gave Thee gall with vinegar to drink.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: И҆скопа́ша хрⷭтѐ мо́й, рꙋ́цѣ и҆ но́зѣ твоѝ, и҆ ко́сти твоя̑ и҆счето́ша, распе́ншен беззако́нницы, и҆ же́лчї со ѻ҆цто́мъ тебѐ напои́ша. * Мꙋ́.
items.english_text: With radiant mouths ye proclaimed God Who became man before the tormentors, O passion-bearers, and ye inherited glory.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆язви́вшася вра́зи ра́нами, бїю́ще вы̀ всечⷭтні́и разли́чными мꙋ́ками враче́ве ра́намъ, бж҃тве́ні́и мч҃нци. * Бг҃о.
items.english_text: The enemies were wounded with wounds when they smote you with manifold torments, O all-honored ones, physicians of wounds, divine martyrs.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Свѣ́тъ на́мъ чⷭтая и҆стебѐ возсїѧ̀ хрⷭто́съ, и҆ просвѣтѝ тва́рь всю̀ распина́емъ: и҆ невѣ́жескꙋю тмꙋ̀ прогна́лъ є҆́стъ.
items.english_text: Light hath shone forth unto us from Thee, O pure one, even Christ; and being crucified, He enlightened all creation and drove away ignorant darkness.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Сле́зы мѝ пода́ждь покаѧ́нїа пречⷭтая, да пла́чꙋ дѣла̀ моѧ̑ лю́таѧ и҆ непрїе́мнаѧ, пре́жде прише́ствїа конца̀ житїа̀ мое́го:
items.english_text: Grant me tears of repentance, O all-immaculate one, that I may weep for my cruel and unacceptable deeds before the arrival of the end of my life.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Воскꙋ́ю дш҃е ѡ҆скорбля́еши влⷣкꙋ своего̀, непра́ведная дѣ́ющи, и҆ невозни́чеши: пре́жде конца̀ ᲂу҆́бѡ потщи́ся пока́йся.
items.english_text: Why, O my soul, dost thou grieve thy Master, doing unrighteous deeds, and dost not look up? Before the end, make haste and repent!

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви мя̀ ѿ ѕлы́хъ прегрѣше́нїй и҆ ско́рбїй, пода́ждь мѝ мл҃ть дв҃о всечⷭтая, и҆ живота̀ нетлѣ́ннаго, бж҃тве́нное прича́стїе.
items.english_text: Deliver me from evil transgressions and afflictions, grant me mercy, O all-honored Virgin, and divine communion of incorruptible life.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Тебѐ и҆́же бг҃а неизрече́нно ро́ждшꙋ, преста́телницꙋ стѧжа́хомъ, и҆ стѣ́нꙋ неѡбори́мꙋю,
items.english_text: Thee who didst ineffably give birth to God have we acquired as protectress, and an invincible rampart and salvation for our souls, and a fountain of miracles.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: ри́мꙋю, и҆ дꙋша́мъ сп҃се́нїе, и҆ чꙋдесе́мъ и҆сто́чникъ.
items.english_text: *Then the Exapostilarion of the Cross:* [^268]

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Ра́дꙋйся крⷭте прест҃ы́й, мі́рꙋ стѣ́но неѡбори́мая, прибѣ́жище скорбя́щымъ, и҆ храни́телю сꙋ́щымъ въ нꙋ́ждахъ: цр҃емъ побѣ́да и҆ во́инѡмъ соблюде́нїе, и҆ ва́рвары побѣжда́юща: а҆́плѡмъ вѣ́нче, и҆ вѣ́рнымъ спасенїе.
items.english_text: Rejoice, O most holy Cross, unconquerable rampart of the world, refuge of the afflicted, and guardian of those in necessities, victory for kings, preserver of soldiers, vanquisher of barbarians, crown of the apostles, and salvation of the faithful!

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: На крⷭтѣ̀ пригвожде́нна тя̀, ви́дѣвши пречⷭтая, пла́чꙋщи и҆ рыда́ющи вопїя́ше: ка́ко за́йде сл҃нце сла́вѣ; свѣ́те нача́льнѣйшій, ка́ко на крⷭтѣ̀ пригвозди́ся; и҆ ко́пїемже прободе́ся въ ре́бра сн҃е и҆ бж҃е мо́й, ра́ди человѣ́ческаго спасе́нїа.
items.english_text: Beholding Thee nailed to the Cross, the all-immaculate one, weeping and lamenting, cried aloud: How hast Thou set, O Sun of glory, O primordial Light? How art Thou nailed to the Cross, and Thy ribs pierced with a spear, O my Son and God, for the sake of man's salvation?

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: На стїхо́внѣ Стїхи̑ры крⷭтны. Гла́съ є҃.
items.english_text: *On the Aposticha, Stichera of the Cross, Tone 5:*

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: тельство, но побѣ́да ꙗ҆ви́ся на́мъ сп҃се́нїе: крⷭтъ бо на́мъ є҆́стъ похвала̀, крⷭтъ на́мъ ᲂу҆тверже́нїе, крⷭтъ на́мъ ра́дованїе.
items.english_text: No sooner was the wood of Thy Cross set up, O Christ, than delusion was driven away and grace blossomed forth; for no longer is there condemnation of torment but victory hath appeared as our salvation; for the Cross is our praise, the Cross is our confirmation, the Cross is our rejoicing!

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Веде́нъ бы́сть на́съ ра́ди на же́ртвꙋ хрⷭтѐ ꙗ҆́ко ѻ҆вча̀, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́гнецъ неѕло́бивъ є҆мманꙋ́илъ: на заколе́нїе во́лное собе́ззако́нники вмѣне́нъ бы́сть. прїидѣ́те воспо́йте ѻ҆те́чествїа ꙗ҆зы́къ, и҆ поклони́теся на крⷭтѣ̀ повѣ́шеномꙋ, животꙋ̀ безконе́чномꙋ. * Мꙋ́.
items.english_text: He was led for our sake unto the slaughter like a sheep, and as a gentle lamb, Emmanuel (Isaiah 53:7); unto voluntary slaughter He was numbered with the lawless. Come, praise Him, ye families of the nations (Psalm 21:28 LXX), and bow down before Him Who was hung upon the Cross, Life without end!

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Бл҃гослове́нно во́инство нбⷭнаго цр҃я, а҆́ще бо и҆ земноро́дні́и бѣ́ша страстоте́рпци: но а҆́гглⷭкое досто́янїе потща́шася дости́гнꙋти, ѡ҆ телесѣ́хъ небре́гше: и҆ стра́сти ра́ди, безпло́тныхъ сподо́бишася чти́: мл҃твами и҆́хъ гдⷭи сп҃си дꙋ́ша на́ша.
items.english_text: Blessed is the army of the heavenly King! For though the passion-bearers were earthborn, yet they hastened to attain angelic dignity, having no care for their bodies; and through suffering they were accounted worthy of the honor of the bodiless hosts. By their prayers, O Lord, save our souls!

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Ста́вши ᲂу҆ крⷭта̀ і҆и҃се тебѐ ро́ждшая, пла́чꙋщися
items.english_text: Standing by the Cross, O Jesus, she who gave Thee birth, weeping lamented, crying aloud: I cannot endure this, seeing Thee nailed upon the Wood, Whom I brought forth, escaping pangs as having known no man; and how am I now seized with pangs, and wounded to the heart? For now is fulfilled the word which Symeon spake: A sword shall pierce Thine own heart, O undefiled one (Luke 2:35). But now, O my Son, arise and save those who hymn Thee!

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: чꙋщися рыда́ше, вопїю́щи нетерплю̀ сїя̀ пригвоже́нна зря́щи тя̀ на дре́вѣ, є҆го́же породи́хъ а҆́зъ, и҆ и҆з̾бего́хъ болѣ́зни ꙗ҆́кѡ безмꙋ́жна: и҆ ка́ко нн҃ѣ болѣ́знїи ѡ҆держжи́ма є҆́смь; и҆ ᲂу҆язвля́юся се́рдцемъ. нн҃ѣ́ бо и҆спо́лнися гл҃съ и҆́же речѐ сѷмеѡ́нъ: срⷣце твоѐ непоро́чная ѡ҆рꙋ́жїе про́йдетъ. но нн҃ѣ́ сн҃е мо́й воскреснѝ и҆ сп҃си пою́щи тя̀.
items.english_text: *On Friday, The Beatitudes, Tone 5:* [^269]

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Разбо́йникъ позна́въ на крⷭтѣ̀, бг҃а бы́ти тебѐ, вѣ́ровавъ тя̀, и҆ и҆сповѣ́да тя̀ чи́сто ѿ се́рдца помяни́ мя гдⷭи вопїя́ше во ца́рствїи си.
items.english_text: Recognizing Thee to be God upon the Cross, having believed in Thee, the thief confessed Thee purely from the heart, crying aloud: Remember me, O Lord, in Thy kingdom (Luke 23:42)!

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́вся на крⷭтѣ̀, и҆́же снѣ́ди ра́ди ᲂу҆ме́ршаго а҆да́ма, є҆го́же ѡ҆живи́лъ є҆сѝ живода́вче ще́дрый, и҆ жи́теля па́ки бл҃же ра́еви показа́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: Having been put to death upon the Cross, Thou didst make alive Adam who had died because of the eating, O compassionate Giver of life, and didst show him once more, O blessed One, to be an inhabitant of paradise.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Пригвозди́ся на крⷭтѣ̀ хрⷭтѐ, лоза̀ и҆́стинная: и҆сточи́лъ є҆сѝ пиво̀ сп҃се́нїа, напаѧ́ѧ всѣ́хъ вѣ́рныхъ срⷣца бл҃гтїю. * Мꙋ́,
items.english_text: Thou wast nailed to the Cross, O Christ, the true Vine (John 15:1); Thou didst pour forth the drink of salvation, watering the hearts of all the faithful with grace.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Бїеми мꙋ́дрїи и҆ надвоѐ разсѣка́еми, воѡбрази́сте заколе́нїе влⷣчне: сего̀ ра́ди мꙋченници хв҃и при́нѡ ᲂу҆блажа́еми є҆стѐ. * Сла́.
items.english_text: Beaten, O wise ones, and severed in twain, ye prefigured the Master's slaughter; therefore, O martyrs of Christ, ye are ever called blessed.

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Покланя́емся тѝ вѣ́рно, трѝ лица̀ во є҆ди́нствѣ бг҃ꙋ, нераздѣ́льнꙋ пребж҃тве́ннꙋ є҆стествꙋ̀ зовꙋ́ще тѝ: сла́ва тебѣ̀ тро́ице є҆ди́нице бж҃е на́шъ. * И҆ Нн҃ѣ.
items.english_text: We faithfully bow down before Thee, God in three Persons in one essence, unseparated, transcendent essence, crying aloud unto Thee: Glory to Thee, O Trinity, unity, our God!

items.office: FRIDAY MATINS: THE PRECIOUS CROSS AND THE THEOTOKOS
items.slavonic_text: Пла́чемъ содрꙋча́ше себѐ, влⷣчце зря́щи на дре́вѣ крⷭтнѣмъ, живота̀ на́шего волею ᲂу҆ме́рша: тѣ́мже всѝ бж҃тве́нными гла́сы тя̀ при́снѡ ᲂу҆блажа́емъ.
items.english_text: Worn down with weeping, the Sovereign Lady, seeing Him Who is our Life dead voluntarily upon the wood of the Cross: therefore with divine voices do we all ever call Thee blessed.

items.slavonic_text: Впаток, вечер • на Гдⷭи возва Стї̑ры, ст҃ы̑м Мꙋ́чнкѡмъ, и҆ с҃тлем, и҆ Прпⷡным, Гла́: ѕ. поⷣ Все ᲂу҆пова́нїе.
items.english_text: *On Friday evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Stichera of the Holy Martyrs, Hierarchs, and Venerable Monks, Tone 6.*

items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ стрⷭте́й постопа́мъ ходѧ̀, все́ мꙋ́нническое сосло́вїе: крѣ́пко за́йде
items.english_text: Walking in the footsteps of all His sufferings, the whole martyr band set out steadfastly unto many struggles; and before impious tormentors and lawless kings they proclaimed Him to be God, and endured many torments, hoping to receive heavenly honors. Whereof now beholding they rejoice, and together with the ranks of the bodiless powers, O Lord, they stand before Thee.

items.slavonic_text: кпо́двигомъ мно́гимъ: и҆ того̀ пред нечести́выми мꙋ́чители, и҆ беззако́нными царѝ бг҃а проповѣ́даша, и҆ мно́ги мꙋ́ки претерпѣ́ша: по́чести ча́юще нбⷭныя вопрїя́ти. и҆́хже нн҃ѣ́ ви́дяще ра́дꙋю́тся, и҆ собѣ́ми ли́ки безпло́тныхъ си́лъ гдⷭи предстоя́тъ.
items.english_text: The divinely chosen flock ye preserved unharmed unto the end; imitators of Christ, the Chief Shepherd (1 Peter 5:4), did ye become, O all-sacred shepherds, divine treasures of piety, having driven away the wild wolves; and well did ye lead that same flock into the heavenly fold, where, now dwelling, make remembrance of those who praise you with love, and with boldness pray Christ for our souls.

items.slavonic_text: побѣ́дисте, и҆ совѣ́тнаѧ мꙋче́нїа стра́стемъ ᲂу҆гаси́вше жже́нїа, до́блественнѣ претерпѣ́сте бл҃же́нні́и: и҆ ра́дꙋетеся нн҃ѣ́ съ нбⷭными си́лами: ꙗ҆́ко ᲂу҆подо́бишася житїѝ во пло́ти тѣ̑мъ безпло́тнымъ: си́миже моли́те хрⷭта пребл҃га́го бг҃а, и҆збавле́нїе ѡ҆брѣстѝ паде́нїемъ, ва́съ почита́ющымъ.
items.english_text: Having lived venerably, all ye venerable fathers, the demons ye conquered; and having extinguished the burning assaults of passions by your sufferings, ye manfully endured, O blessed ones; and ye now rejoice with the heavenly hosts, having in the flesh lived a life assimilated to those bodiless ones; with them pray Christ, the exceedingly good God, that those who honor you may find deliverance from falls.

items.slavonic_text: И҆́ны стї̑ры, Гла́съ и҆ подо́бенъ то́йже.
items.english_text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, denied Thee not, neither did they depart from Thy commandments; by their prayers have mercy on us.

items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́чнци твоѝ гдⷭи не ѡ҆тверго́шася тебѐ, нѝ ѿстꙋпи́ша ѿ за́повѣде́й твои́хъ, тѣ́хъ мл҃твами поми́лꙋй на́съ.
items.english_text: Passion-bearers, martyrs, heavenly citizens, who suffered upon earth and endured many torments: by their prayers and intercession, O Lord, preserve us all.

items.slavonic_text: Страстоте́рпци мꙋ́нци нбⷭні́и гражда́не, на землѝ пострада́вше, мно́гїа мꙋ́ки претерпѣ́ша: мл҃твами гнⷭи и҆ моле́нїемъ и҆́хъ, всѣ́хъ на́съ сохранѝ.
items.english_text: *Glory; Both now: Theotokion: Who shall not call Thee blessed... (seek in Tone 2 at Vespers)* [^271]

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, И҆ нн҃ѣ. Бг҃о. Кто̀ тебѐ не бл҃жи́тъ. пн̀ въ в҃ ко вѐ
items.english_text: *On the Aposticha, Stichera of the Martyrs, Tone 6:*

items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ ѕ҃. На стїхо́внѣ стїхи̑ры, мꙋ́чнчны, Гла́съ ѕ҃.
items.english_text: Having suffered for Thy sake, O Christ, they endured many torments and received perfect crowns in the heavens, that they might pray for our souls.

items.slavonic_text: Страда́вше тебѐ ра́ди хрⷭтѐ, мно́гїа мꙋ́ки
items.english_text: Thy Cross, O Lord, became an unconquerable weapon for the martyrs; for they foresaw the death lying before them, yet looked beyond unto the life to come, strengthened by their hope in Thee; by their prayers have mercy on us.

items.slavonic_text: претерпѣ́ша, и҆ соверше́нныѧ вѣнцы̀ прїя́ша на нб҃сехъ: да мл҃ся ѡ҆ дꙋша́хъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: My beginning and foundation was Thy creative command; for wishing to fashion me as a living creature out of invisible and visible nature, Thou didst fashion my body from the earth, and gavest me a soul by Thy divine and life-creating inbreathing; therefore, O Savior, give rest unto Thy servants in the land of the living and in the tents of the righteous!

items.slavonic_text: пра́ведныхъ, и҆ всѣ́хъ ст҃ы́хъ: ᲂу҆со́пшая рабы̀ своя̀ поко́й.
items.english_text: By the prayers of her who gave Thee birth, O Christ, of Thy martyrs, and apostles, and prophets, and hierarchs, venerable ones righteous ones, and of all Thy saints: give rest unto Thy departed servants!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Въ Сꙋбѡ́тꙋ на Оу҆́трни • по а҃ • стїх, Сѣд мч҃ны Гла́съ ѕ҃.
items.english_text: *On Saturday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Martyrs, Tone 6:* [^272]

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Свѣ́тъ пра́веднымъ всегда̀, ст҃і́и бо ѿ тебѐ просвѣти́вшеся, сїя́ютъ при́снѡ ꙗ҆́кѡ свѣти́ла, свѣ́щникъ нечести́выхъ ᲂу҆гаси́вше, и҆́хже мл҃твами сп҃се на́шъ, ты̀ просвѣ́щлеши свѣти́лникъ мо́й гдⷭи: и҆ спаси́ мя.
items.english_text: Light is ever unto the righteous (Psalm 96:11 LXX), for the holy ones, enlightened by Thee, shine ever like stars, having extinguished the lamp of the impious; by their prayers, O our Savior, do Thou enlighten my lamp, O Lord (Psalm 17:29 LXX), and save me!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Страда́лческїй по́двигъ претерпѣ́вше ст҃і́и, и҆ по́чести побѣ́дныя ѿ тебѐ прїя́ша, ᲂу҆праздни́ша ᲂу҆мышле́нїа безако́нныхъ, и҆ прїя́ша вѣ́нца нетлѣ́нныя, тѣ́ми бж҃е ᲂу҆моле́нъ быва́я, да́рꙋй на́мъ ве́лїю мл҃ть.
items.english_text: Having endured the struggle of suffering, the holy ones received crowns of victory from Thee; they abolished the plots of the lawless, and received incorruptible crowns; being entreated by them, O God, grant us great mercy.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же бл҃гослове́ннꙋю нарекі́й мт҃рь себѐ, прише́лъ є҆сѝ на стра́сть во́лнымъ совѣ́томъ, просиѧ́въ на крⷭтѣ̀, взыска́ти хотя̀ а҆да́ма: гла́голя
items.english_text: O Thou Who didst call Thine own Mother blessed, Thou camest unto the Passion by voluntary counsel, shining forth upon the Cross, seeking to recover Adam, saying unto the angels Rejoice with Me, for the lost drachma is found (Luke 15:9)! O Thou Who hast wisely ordered all things, O God, glory to Thee!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: а҆́гглѡмъ сра́дꙋйте ми ся, ꙗ҆́кѡ ѡ҆брѣ́теся поги́бшая дра́хма, и҆́же вся̑ мꙋ́дрѣ ᲂу҆стро́ивый, бж҃е сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Martyrs, Tone 6:*

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: По в҃ стїхоло́гїи Сѣда́лна мч҃чны, Гла́съ ѕ҃.
items.english_text: The sufferings of resistance at the tribunal, the tormentors' wounds inflicted upon the martyrs, while the ranks of the bodiless hosts stood by holding crowns of victory! The wise ones astonished the tormentor and the king, and cast down the apostate by the confession of Christ; O Lord Who didst strengthen them, glory to Thee!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Страда́лческая проти́влѣнїа на сꙋ́дищи во пода́нъцѣ мꙋ́чителескїа ра́ны на мꙋ́ченицехъ, и҆ стоя́хꙋ ли́ци безпло́тныхъ, по́чести держа́ще побѣ́дныя: ᲂу҆диви́ша мꙋ́дрїи мꙋчи́тела и҆ цр҃я, и҆ низложи́ша ѿстꙋ́пника и҆сповѣ́да́нїемъ хв҃ымъ, ᲂу҆крѣпи́вый и҆́хъ, гдⷭи сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_text: O Lord, the memory of Thy saints this day is shown to be like the paradise in Eden; for therein all creation rejoices; and by their supplications grant us purification and great mercy.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: земноро́дный, ꙗ҆́коже речѐ писа́нїе: є҆гда̀ мі́ръ приѡбрѧ́щемъ, тогда̀ вогро́бъ всели́мся, и҆́деже вкꙋ́пѣ цр҃їе и҆ ᲂу҆бо́зїи: тѣ̑мже хрⷭтѐ бж҃е преста́вленыѧ поко́й, ꙗ҆́кѡ чл҃колю́бецъ.
items.english_text: Truly all things are vanity, and life is but a shadow and a dream (Ecclesiastes 1:2); for in vain doth every earthborn man disquiet himself (Psalm 38:7 LXX), as the Scripture saith: When we have gained the world, then into the grave do we take up our abode, where kings and beggars are together; therefore, O Christ God, give rest unto those who have departed, as Thou art the Lover of mankind!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Ѿ се́рдца воздыха́нїя и҆ ѿ ᲂу҆тро́бы при́снѡ шлю́ ти, твоѐ всенепоро́чная молю̀, бл҃гопремѣ́нителное застꙋпле́нїе, поми́лꙋй всестра́стнꙋю мѝ дꙋ́шꙋ, ᲂу҆молѝ ми́лостиваго бг҃а, и҆зба́вити мя̀ сꙋда̀ и҆ є҆́зера ѻ҆́гне́ннаго, є҆ди́на бл҃гве́ннаѧ.
items.english_text: From the heart and from the depths of my being do I ever send sighs unto Thee; I pray for Thy favorable intercession, O all-immaculate one: have mercy on my passionate soul, entreat the merciful God to deliver me from judgment and the lake of fire, O only blessed one!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Ка́нѡ ст҃ы̑м Мꙋ́чнкѡмъ, и҆ с҃тлем и҆ прпⷡнымъ. Гла́ ѕ, Пѣ́ а҆, І҆рмо́. Чꙋдотво́рный фараѡ́ потоплѐ,
items.english_text: *Canon to the Holy Martyrs, Hierarchs, and Venerable Monks, Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos: He Who marvelously drowned Pharaoh...* [^273]

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣще́ннымъ ᲂу҆мо́мъ те́мныя ѡ҆свѣти́сте, злочести́выя же мꙋчи́телѧ мꙋ́чници посрами́вше, побѣдоно́сца бы́вше ꙗ҆́вѣ, и҆ квече́рнемꙋ свѣ́тꙋ прїидо́ша.
items.english_text: With enlightened mind ye enlightened those in darkness, and putting to shame the impious tormentors, O martyrs, ye clearly became victors and arrived unto the unwaning light.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Ст҃и́телїе хв҃и и҆ прпⷡныхъ ли́къ, и҆ прр҃къ
items.english_text: The hierarchs of Christ and the choir of venerable ones, and the prophets and the united assembly of all the righteous, radiant with the beauties of virtues, entered into the heavenly mansions.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: и҆ пра́ведныхъ всѣ́хъ є҆ди́нственное торжество̀, добродѣ́телными красота́ми ѡ҆блиста́вшеся, внидо́ша ко нбⷭнымъ селе́нїямъ.
items.english_text: The multitude of women, having clothed themselves in Christ, who trampled underfoot him who brought death unto Eve by cruel deception, are called blessed with divine songs for their manly labors.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Же́нское всемно́жество, приѡбле́кшеся хв҃и, и҆́же є҆́ѵꙋ лю́тымъ прелще́нїемъ ᲂу҆мори́вшаго попра́ша, трꙋды̀ мꙋ́жескими, ᲂу҆блажа́ются бж҃твенными пѣ́сньми.
items.english_text: O Christ, Who in the beginning didst fashion man from the earth: we pray Thee, give rest unto the souls of Thy servants in the mansions of the righteous, in places of refreshment, as Thou art good.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ѿ земля̀ вънача́тцѣхъ созда́вый чл҃ка хрⷭтѐ, дꙋ́ша твои́хъ ра́бъ поко́й моли́мся, во ѡ҆би́телехъ пра́ведныхъ, въ мѣ́стехъ ѡ҆слабле́нїа ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гъ.
items.english_text: More holy than the Cherubim and Seraphim wast Thou shown to be, O pure one, having given birth to the Creator of creation; unceasingly pray Him to show compassion unto Thy servants who glorify Thee.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́ннѣйши чⷭтая херꙋвї́мъ и҆ серафі́мъ ꙗ҆ви́лася є҆сѝ, ро́жши тво́рца тва́ри, є҆го́же непреста́нно молѝ, ᲂу҆ще́дрити рабы̀ твоя̑ тебѐ сла́вящихъ.
items.english_text: *Another Canon for the Departed, Tone 8 [Tone 6], Ode 1. Heirmos: Having traversed the water...* [^274]

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: дража́юще чⷭтно́ю мч҃нци, вен бж҃тве́нныя и҆ бл҃же́нныя жи́зни полꙋчи́ша. Пок
items.english_text: Honorably imitating the death of Christ by their death and His passion by their passions, the martyrs received crowns of divine and blessed life.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Ю́ности согрѣше́нїа пре́зря, и҆ грѣхѝ преходя̀ х҃е сп҃се: пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшихъ ра̑бъ твои́хъ, со и҆збра́нными твои́ми причтѝ.
items.english_text: Overlooking the sins of youth and passing over transgressions, O Christ Savior: number Thy previously departed servants with Thine elect.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Е҆́яже полꙋчи́ша сла́вы же и҆ ра́дости, и҆̀же бл҃же́ное стяжа́вшїи пребыва́нїе, пода́ждь бога́тно твои́мъ рабѡ́мъ, и҆́хже прїя́лъ многоми́лостиве. Бг҃о.
items.english_text: Of the glory and joy that they who attained the blessed abode have received, grant richly, O Most-Merciful One, unto Thy servants whom Thou hast taken to Thyself.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Зачала̀ є҆сѝ сло́во ѿч҃ее, пло́тїю соедини́вша ся ѿрокови́це, и҆́же а҆́да бж҃твенною си́лою ᲂу҆праздни́вшаго.
items.english_text: Thou didst conceive the Word of the Father, Who united with flesh, O Maiden, and abolished Hades by His divine power.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́ г҃, І҆рмо́. На тве́рдемъ вѣ́ры твое́я ка́мени.
items.english_text: Upon the firm rock of Thy faith...

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Теле́снымъ примѣси́вшеся болѣ́знемъ страда́лцы, неболѣ́зненное взира́хꙋ воздая́нїе ра́дꙋющеся, и҆ нн҃ѣ ᲂу҆ставля́ютъ на́ша болѣ́зни безчи́сленныя бл҃гтїю.
items.english_text: Muffled in bodily afflictions, the passion-bearers looked rejoicing toward the painless recompense; and now by grace they stay our countless afflictions.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: лꙋка́выѧ, бж҃твеннїи страстоно́сци, и҆зба́виша невреди́мыхъ тѣ́хъ ѡ҆ѕлобле́нїа, хв҃ы ѡ҆́вца бж҃твенныя.
items.english_text: By steadfast character driving away the cunning beast, the divine passion-bearers delivered unharmed the divine sheep of Christ from their malice.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Во́лею и҆́го гдⷭне под̾е́мше ли́къ прпⷡныхъ, ᲂу҆мертви́вый мꙋдрова́нїе плотско́е, и҆ живо́тъ вѣ́чный воспрїя́тъ. Пок.
items.english_text: Having willingly taken up the yoke of the Lord, the choir of the venerable put to death the carnal mind and received life everlasting.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви х҃е ѻ҆гня̀ вѣ́чнаго, бл҃гоче́стно ѿ житїя̀ преста́вльшыяся, и҆ ѡ҆ставле́нїе да́ждь долго́въ и҆̀хъ бл҃же, и҆ црⷭтвїа наслажде́нїе.
items.english_text: Deliver, O Christ, from eternal fire those who have departed from this life in piety, and grant them remission of their debts, O Good One, and the enjoyment of the Kingdom.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же х҃а возлюби́вшїя же́ны, та́иже того̀ неизрече́нно ро́ждшꙋ прⷭтая влⷣчце, ра́достною мы́слїю предстоя́ще ликовствꙋ́ютъ. И҆́нъ І҆рмо́. Нбⷭномꙋ крꙋгꙋ.
items.english_text: The women who loved Christ stand before Thee with joyful mind, O all-holy Sovereign Lady, and dance in choir before her who ineffably gave birth to Him.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆чи́щшеся дре́вняго прароди́телнаго паде́нїа, кр҃ще́нїемъ и҆ порожде́нїемъ, стрꙋя́ми же кро́вїй свои́хъ ѡ҆кропи́вшеся, со хрⷭто́мъ бл҃же́ннїи црⷭтвꙋютъ. Поко́й.
items.english_text: O Lord, Builder of the vault of heaven...

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Purified from the ancient primal fall through baptism and regeneration, and sprinkled with the streams of their own blood, the blessed martyrs reign with Christ.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: *Hymn for the Departed (Поко́инъ):* [^275]

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ме́ртвъ во́лею поло́жся вогро́бѣ, и҆ живꙋщыя вогро́бѣхъ возводя̀, сп҃се бл҃говолѝ, и҆́хже ѿ на́съ прїя́тъ въ се́лехъ ст҃ы́хъ твои́хъ си̑мъ водворя́тися.
items.english_text: O Savior Who didst willingly lie dead in the grave and didst raise up those dwelling in the tombs: be well pleased that those whom Thou hast taken from us should settle in the tents of Thy saints.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Щедрѡ́тамъ бж҃твеннымъ влⷣко, и҆ соєсте́ственнѣ разꙋмѣва́емыя тѝ бл҃гости, ᲂу҆моле́нъ быва́я, согрѣше́нїемъ раздрѣше́нїе пода́въ рабѡ́мъ свои̑мъ, и҆ ᲂу҆себе́ и҆́хъ поко́й. Бг҃о.
items.english_text: Being entreated, O Master, by Thy divine compassions and the goodness known to be connate unto Thee: grant remission of transgressions unto Thy servants, and give them rest with Thyself.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Вопло́щся и҆з̾чре́ва твое́го, и҆ бы́въ чл҃къ, и҆́же и҆зрѧ́днѣ сы́й є҆ди́нъ чл҃колю́бецъ, спаса́етъ чл҃ка ѿ вра́тъ сме́ртныхъ, бг҃омт҃и прⷭтая, є҆ди́на всепѣ́тая.
items.english_text: Incarnate from thy womb and having become man, He Who is preeminently the only Lover of mankind saves man from the gates of death, O all-holy Mother of God, only all-praised one.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃. І҆рмо́. Оу҆слы́шахъ гдⷭи слꙋ́хъ тво́й,
items.english_text: I heard, O Lord, Thy report...

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Стоя́ще зря́хꙋ го́рдаго страстоте́рпци, препода́ми свои́ми разсѣка́ющася, и҆ вся́чески зижи́теля бл҃годарствено сла́вяхꙋ.
items.english_text: Standing firm, the passion-bearers watched the proud adversary being cut down beneath their loins, and in every way they thankfully glorified the Creator.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ свѣ́тлостїи ст҃і́е наста́влѧюще чл҃ки, ксвѣ́тꙋ ра́зꙋма, тмꙋ̀ є҆ресе́й разрꙋша́юще.
items.english_text: The holy ones, guiding men by the voice of radiance unto the light of understanding, dispelled the darkness of heresies.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́ко ᲂу҆́глїе ꙗ҆ви́стеся є҆́же къ бг҃ꙋ те́плымъ совѡкꙋпле́нїемъ, и҆ стра̑сти попаля́ете веще́ственныя, преподо́бнїи велмѝ просла́вистеся. Поко́инъ.
items.english_text: Ye appeared like burning coals through fervent union with God, and ye burn up material passions, O venerable ones, and are greatly glorified.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Живы́ми ты̀ гдⷭи, и҆ ме́ртвыми ѡ҆блада́я, и҆́хже преста́вилъ є҆сѝ поко́й, со всѣ́ми ᲂу҆го́дньшими тебѣ̀ влⷣко. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: Ruling over the living and the dead, O Lord: give rest unto those whom Thou hast translated, with all who have been well-pleasing unto Thee, O Master.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Гдⷭꙋ прⷭтая и҆стебѐ неизрече́ннѡ вопло́ть ѡ҆болкъшꙋся, же́нскїе во мꙋ́жествѣ подви́гшеся приведо́шася.
items.english_text: When the Lord was ineffably clothed in flesh from thee, O all-pure one: women, having struggled with manly courage, were brought unto Him.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Да твое́я влⷣко сла́вы ᲂу҆́зрятъ, и҆ лꙋча̀ твоѧ̀ свѣтода́телныя на нб҃сехъ полꙋ́чатъ свѣ́тлѡ, бѣ́жъ кѝ мꙋ́къ нося́ще претерпѣ́ша, мч҃нци бж҃твеннїи тебѣ̀ х҃е
items.english_text: Thou art my Lord, O Christ...

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: пою́ще: си́лѣ твое́й сла́ва чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: That they might behold Thy glory, O Master, and brightly obtain Thy light-bestowing rays in the heavens: bearing the wounds of tortures, the divine martyrs endured [^276] singing: "Glory to Thy power, O Lover of mankind!"

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Мно́ги ѡ҆би́тели ᲂу҆тебѐ сп҃се сꙋ́ть, по достоѧ́нїю всѣ́мъ раздѣля́еми, помѣ́рѣ добродѣ́теле[й]: тѣ́хъ ᲂу҆́бѡ ще́дре и҆спо́лнити си́хъ сподо́би вѣ́рно преста́вльшыяся, бл҃гочⷭтно тѝ вопїю́щихъ, си́лѣ твое́й сла́ва человѣколю́бче. Сла́ва.
items.english_text: Many are the mansions with Thee, O Savior, apportioned worthily unto all according to the measure of their virtues: make those who have faithfully departed worthy to be filled with them, O Compassionate One, as they piously cry unto Thee: "Glory to Thy power, O Lover of mankind!"

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Ра́венъ на́мъ чл҃къ ꙗ҆ви́лся є҆сѝ всеми́рне, всѣ́мъ равно сме́рть претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ жи́зни показа́лъ є҆сѝ пꙋ́ть: є҆́яже преста́вльшыяся сподо́би ꙗ҆́ко чл҃колю́бецъ, проще́нїе согрѣше́нїемъ ꙗ҆́кѡ влⷣка подава́я, и҆ свѣ́та прича́стїе да́рꙋя. И҆ нн҃ѣ. Бг҃о.
items.english_text: Thou didst appear as a man like unto us, O Savior of the whole world; Thou didst endure death equally for all and didst show forth the way of life: vouchsafe the departed to partake thereof as Lover of mankind, granting remission of sins as Master, and bestowing communion in light.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ вѣ́рнымъ похвала̀ є҆сѝ безневѣ́стная, ты̀ предста́тельница, ты̀ прибѣ́жище христїа́нѡмъ стѣна̀ и҆ приста́нище: ксн҃ꙋ своему̀ мо́лбы но́сиши всенепоро́чная, и҆
items.english_text: Thou art the praise of the faithful, O unwedded Bride; thou art the protectress, the refuge of Christians, a rampart and a haven: thou bearest supplications unto Thy Son, O all-immaculate one, and deliverest from tribulations those who know thee in faith and love to be the pure Mother of God.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: спаса́еши ѿ бѣ́дъ, вѣ́рою и҆ любо́вїю бцⷣꙋ чи́стꙋю тя̀ вѣ́дꙋщыя.
items.english_text: Thou Who didst shine forth light upon the whole world...

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь є҆. І҆рмо́. Возсїя́вый свѣ́тъ всемꙋ̀ мі́рꙋ.
items.english_text: Clothed in the vesture of grace woven from on high, O passion-bearers, ye stripped the enemy bare.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Нетка́нною ѿ вы́шнихъ бл҃гтїю, ѡ҆бо́лкшеся во ѡ҆де́ждꙋ страда́лци, врага̀ ѡ҆бнажи́сте.
items.english_text: With the holy prophets, let us honor the divinely wise high priests and the venerable who were well-pleasing unto God.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Со ст҃ы́ми прⷪрки почте́мъ первосвяще́нники бг҃омꙋ́дрыя, и҆ преподо́бныя бг҃ови ᲂу҆годи́вшихъ.
items.english_text: In psalms and hymns, let us praise the choir of women, as having been well-pleasing unto God.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Въ ѱалмѣ́хъ, и҆ пѣ́снехъ, восхва́лимъ же́нъ сосло́вїе, ꙗ҆́ко бг҃ови до́брѣ ᲂу҆годи́вшаѧ. Поко́инъ.
items.english_text: Appoint Thy servants, O Lord, in the tents of Thy righteous ones, overlooking the sins they committed in this life.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Въ се́лѣхъ пра́ведныхъ твои́хъ гдⷭи, твоя̑ рабы̀ ᲂу҆чинѝ, презира́я я҆́же въ житїѝ тѣ́хъ согрѣше́нїа. Бг҃о.
items.english_text: Show thyself delivering us from every harm of the enemy, O Sovereign Lady, praying unto Christ, the only Compassionate One.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
