items.slavonic_text: Несказа́нныя тѝ сла́вы, и҆ па́че сло́ва твое́го бл҃же́нства, въ селе́нїихъ пра́ведныхъ, и҆дѣ́же гла́съ кра́сенъ пра́зднꙋющихъ: преста́вленныя къ безсме́ртнѣй жи́зни ᲂу҆ще́дривъ, сподо́би є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Why hast Thou cast me off [^277] In Thine ineffable glory and Thy beatitude surpassing all speech, in the dwellings of the righteous where the voice of those who feast is sweet: have compassion, O only Lover of mankind, and vouchsafe the departed unto immortal life.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: И҆дѣ́же чи́ны а҆́гглстїи, и҆дѣ́же пра́вныхъ собо́ры ра́дꙋются: а҆враа́мꙋ вънѣ́дрѣхъ вселѝ сп҃се рабы̀ своя̀, и҆ со дерзнове́нїемъ стра́шномꙋ и҆ бж҃твенномꙋ прⷭтлꙋ, преста́ти бл҃говолѝ мл҃рде.
items.english_text: Where angelic orders and assemblies of the righteous rejoice: settle Thy servants in the bosom of Abraham, O Savior, and be well-pleased, O Compassionate One, that they may stand with boldness before Thy fearful and divine throne.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆чище́нїе на́мъ ꙗ҆ви́лся є҆сѝ, пра́вда же и҆ и҆збавле́нїе: я҆́звою твое́ю на́ша не́мощи ᲂу҆врачева́лъ є҆сѝ: са́мъ ᲂу҆́бѡ ще́дре ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гъ, преста́вльшыяся въ пи́щи ра́йстѣй ᲂу҆чинѝ. Бг҃оро́.
items.english_text: Thou didst appear unto us as purification, righteousness, and redemption; by Thy wound Thou hast healed our infirmities: do Thou Thyself, O Compassionate One, as Good, establish the departed in the delight of paradise.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Ми́лостивно мл҃рде, чл҃чтва мѣ́рꙋ воспрїя́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же бж҃твенныя сла́вы превы́сшая
items.english_text: Mercifully, O Compassionate One, Thou didst assume the measure of humanity, adorning it with elevations surpassing divine glory:

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: ᲂу҆краша́я возвыше́нми: ѿ дв҃ческихъ ложе́снъ пло́ть прїе́мъ ѡ҆дꙋшевлѐннꙋ и҆ слове́снꙋ, є҆́юже сме́рть разрꙋши́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: taking from virginal loins flesh ensouled and endowed with reason, whereby Thou hast destroyed death.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ки́томъ поже́ртъ.
items.english_text: Swallowed by the whale...

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Кро́вїй бж҃твенныхъ тече́нїемъ, мы́сленныя врагѝ погрузи́сте: вѣ́рныхъ же сердца̀ страстоте́рпци напои́сте.
items.english_text: By the stream of your divine blood, ye drowned spiritual foes, O passion-bearers, and watered the hearts of the faithful.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Распе́нше себѐ мі́рꙋ и҆ стра́стемъ, прпⷡнїи, мꙋ́дрїи ст҃и́телїе: бж҃тве́ннѣй сла́вѣ сподо́бистеся.
items.english_text: Having crucified yourselves unto the world and passions, O venerable ones and wise hierarchs: ye were accounted worthy of divine glory.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Прⷪрческі́й ли́къ, и҆ чⷭтны́й же собо́ръ, до́брѣ подвиза́вшихся подо́лгꙋ ᲂу҆блажа́емъ. Поко́.
items.english_text: Duly we bless the prophetic choir and the honorable assembly of those who fought the good fight.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Поко́й бж҃е пре́ждеᲂу҆со́пшихъ дꙋ́ши, со и҆збра́нными твои́ми презира́я тѣ́хъ прегрѣше́нїа. Бг҃оро́дичнѣ.
items.english_text: Give rest, O God, unto the souls of those previously fallen asleep, together with Thine elect, overlooking their transgressions.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: дота́йствомъ сѝ. И҆́нъ І҆рмо́, Ѡ҆чи́сти мя̀,
items.english_text: O thou who didst bear Christ in the flesh: put to death the passions of my flesh, and quicken my soul, O Virgin [^278] through thy maternal intercession.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́чнци твоѝ сп҃се, мно́гїя мꙋ́ки претерпѣ́вша, любо́вїю твое́ю дꙋ́ша ᲂу҆язви́вше ст҃і́и, твое́я жела́юще присносꙋ́щныя сла́вы, и҆ сла́дкаго тѝ прича́стїа.
items.english_text: Cleanse me, O Savior...

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Чре́во вражде́бныя сме́рти растерза́лъ є҆сѝ спа́се, и҆ всѝ и҆́же въ то́й ᲂу҆́зники воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ живо́тъ дарова́въ: є҆гѡ́же преста́вленныя бл҃года́телю сподо́би. Сла́ва,
items.english_text: Having endured many tortures, O Savior, Thy holy martyrs, their souls wounded with Thy love, yearned for Thine everlasting glory and sweet communion with Thee.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Сле́зъ и҆ воздыха́нїя и҆́же во а҆́дѣ, рабы̀ своя̀ свободѝ сп҃се, ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ мл҃рдъ: ѿя́тъ вся́кꙋ сле́зꙋ ѿ вся́каго лица̀, вѣ́рнѡ бг҃осло́вящихъ тя̀. Нн҃ѣ, Бг҃о,
items.english_text: Thou didst tear apart the belly of hostile death, O Savior, and didst raise up all the prisoners held therein, bestowing life: vouchsafe the departed to partake thereof, O Benefactor.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же є҆стество́мъ содѣ́тель, содѣ́телствꙋеся въ ложесна́хъ твои́хъ, по́лный ꙗ҆́кѡ бг҃ъ и҆стощева́ется всенепоро́чная, є҆ди́нъ безсме́ртный, и҆́же ѡ҆бсѣ́хъ спаси́тельною
items.english_text: Deliver Thy servants from the tears and sighing in Hades, O Savior, as the only Merciful One: Thou Who hast taken away every tear from every face of those who faithfully confess Thee as God.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: ᲂу҆мира́етъ сме́ртїю. Пѣ́ з҃, І҆рм҃, Ст҃і́и ѿро́цы.
items.english_text: He Who is Creator by nature is created in thy womb; He Who is full as God empties Himself, O all-immaculate one, the only Immortal One, Who for the sake of all dies a saving death.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Хв҃ы страстоте́рпца, ᲂу҆гаси́вшаѧ пла́ме лю́таго безбо́жїа тꙋ́чами крове́й, пѣ́нми почте́мъ.
items.english_text: The holy children in the furnace...

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Сла́внїи і҆ера́рси, зимꙋ̀ є҆ресе́мъ разрꙋши́вше, квеснѣ̀ бж҃е́ственнѣй ра́дꙋющеся прїидо́ша.
items.english_text: Let us honor with songs the passion-bearers of Christ, who quenched the flame of grievous godlessness with showers of blood.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Терпѣ́нїемъ бога́тꙋ дх҃а бл҃года́ть наслѣ́довасте пꙋ́стннци, и҆ мно́жество бѣ́совъ погꙋби́сте. Поко́инъ.
items.english_text: The glorious hierarchs, having destroyed the winter of heresies, came rejoicing unto the divine springtime.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Ра́йскїя пи́ща наслѣ́довати сподо́би ще́дре: вѣ́рою преста́вленныя ѿ житїя̀ многоми́лостиве. Бг҃о,
items.english_text: By endurance ye inherited the rich grace of the Spirit, O desert-dwellers, and destroyed the multitude of demons.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же тебѐ дв҃ꙋ показа́вый чⷭтая и҆ порожествѣ̀: ст҃ы́хъ же ли́ки, тебѐ послѣ́довавшая сп҃лъ є҆́стъ. И҆́нъ І҆рмо́, Дѣ́ти є҆ѵре́йскїя.
items.english_text: Vouchsafe the departed in faith from this life to inherit the food of paradise, O Compassionate and Most-Merciful One.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Всѐ жела́нїе мꙋ́чнкѡмъ простре́ся к̾єди́но-
items.english_text: He Who preserved thee a Virgin even after childbirth, O pure one, has saved the choirs of holy women who followed thee.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Всѐ жела́нїе мꙋ́чнкѡмъ простре́ся к̾єди́но-
items.english_text: The Hebrew children in the furnace...

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: мꙋ бл҃цѣ, любо́вїю томꙋ̀ соединя́еми, и҆ поя̀: бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ гдⷭи бж҃е вовѣ́ки.
items.english_text: All the longing of the martyrs was extended toward the one Master [^279] united unto that Master by love, and singing: "Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto ages!"

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Пода́еши вѣ́рою преста́вльшимся, свѣ́тло бж҃тве́ннаго цр҃твїа, нетлѣ́нїа ѡ҆де́ждꙋ да́рꙋя пою́щи: бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ г҃и б҃е вовѣ́ки.
items.english_text: Thou dost grant unto those who have departed in faith the radiance of the divine Kingdom, bestowing a garment of incorruption as they sing: "Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto ages!"

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: И҆спо́лни ра́дости и҆ весе́лїа, є҆́же преста́ви є҆сѝ рабы̀ твоя̑ ще́дре, и҆ сподо́бихъ и҆́хъ взыва́ти тебѣ̀ и҆ пѣ́ти, бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ гдⷭи бж҃е вовѣ́ки. Сла́ва, и҆ Нн҃ѣ.
items.english_text: Fill with joy and gladness Thy servants whom Thou hast translated, O Compassionate One, and make them worthy to cry out and sing unto Thee: "Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto ages!"

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Разрѣши́ла є҆ѵа́нинꙋ кля́твꙋ, во пренепоро́чнꙋю всели́лся є҆сѝ дв҃ꙋ, бл҃же́нїа и҆сто́чникъ и҆сточа́я вопїю́щимъ: бл҃гослове́нъ пречⷭтая пло́дъ твое́го чре́ва.
items.english_text: Having dissolved the curse of Eve, Thou didst dwell within the all-immaculate Virgin, welling forth a spring of blessing unto those who cry: "Blessed, O all-pure one, is the fruit of thy womb!"

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь и҆́, І҆рмо́съ. Ст҃і́и ѿро́цы въвавѵло́нѣ.
items.english_text: The holy children in Babylon...

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Добле́ственнѣ мꙋче́нїй треволне́нїемъ ᲂу҆раня́еми, бж҃тве́ннїи мч҃нци: бл҃гтїю преше́дше вътишинꙋ̀ глубо́кꙋю, вы́шняго цр҃твїа доспѣ́ша.
items.english_text: Valiantly wounded by the tempest of tortures, the divine martyrs passed through by grace into profound stillness, and reached the Kingdom on high.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Прпⷡнїи всемꙋ́дрїи ст҃і́е, ꙗ҆ви́вшееся ꙗ҆́кѡ сл҃нце просвѣща́ютъ вселе́ннꙋю ᲂу҆че́нїй лꙋча́ми, и҆ и҆сцѣле́нїй свѣ́тлостьми.
items.english_text: The all-wise venerable holy ones, appearing like the sun, illumine the universe with the rays of their teachings and the brilliancy of their healings.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Сла́вні́и прⷪрцы, и҆ первосщ҃е́нници, преподо́бнїи всѝ и҆ пра́внїи, мч҃нкъ мно́жество, и҆ же́нъ: ста́до ва́ше всѐ сохрани́те, ѿ бѣ́со́въ непрекло́нно. Поко́инъ.
items.english_text: O glorious prophets and high priests, all ye venerable and righteous ones, and multitude of martyrs and women: preserve your whole flock unshaken from demons.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Воспое́мъ пра́вныя ѿ вѣ́ка, бг҃оглаго́ливыя же прⷪрки: и҆ возопїе́мъ со ᲂу҆миле́нїемъ, тѣ́хъ сло́ве мл҃тва́ми, вѣ́рою ᲂу҆со́пшихъ поко́й. Бг҃о.
items.english_text: Let us hymn the righteous from the ages and the divinely-speaking prophets, and let us cry out with compunction: By their prayers, O Word, give rest unto those who have fallen asleep in faith.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Вѣ́дꙋ тя̀ бли́жнюю добро́тꙋ бж҃їю дв҃о, ли́къ же́нскїй возлюбѝ, и҆ вослѣ́дъ тебѐ приведо́шася влⷣцѣ, согла́сно бл҃жа́ще тя̀ пречⷭтая. И҆́нъ І҆рмо́: Мꙋ́чнки́нскимъ.
items.english_text: Knowing thee, O Virgin, to be the closest beauty of God, the choir of women loved thee, and following after thee were brought unto the Master, harmoniously blessing thee, O all-pure one.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Землѣ́нныя стра̑сти проше́дше, нбⷭныя прїя́ша вѣ́нца мч҃нци и҆́стинныи, вопїю́-
items.english_text: In the martyrs' fire...

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: ще сп҃сꙋ, г҃а по́йте и҆ превозносите є҆го̀ вовѣ́ки.
items.english_text: Having passed through earthly passions, the true martyrs received heavenly crowns [^280] crying unto the Savior: "Praise the Lord and exalt Him above all forever!"

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Соше́дъ вро́въ пренепо́днїй, и҆́же вогро́бѣхъ живꙋ́щыя воскр҃силъ є҆сѝ живонача́лною дла́нїю, и҆ пода́еми рабѡ́мъ свои́мъ, вѣ́рою пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшымъ поко́й ще́дре.
items.english_text: Having descended into the nethermost pit, Thou didst raise up those dwelling in the tombs by Thy life-originating hand: grant rest, O Compassionate One, unto Thy servants who have previously fallen asleep in faith.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ и҆сто́чникъ жи́зни присносꙋ́щныя, ꙗ҆́кѡ пи́ща сы́й пото́къ: рабы̑ своя̀ бл҃гочⷭтно ктебѣ̀ преста́вленыя напая́еши, воспѣва́ющыя и҆ превознося́щыя тя̀ х҃е вовѣ́ки. Бг҃о.
items.english_text: As a fountain of everlasting life, as a torrent of delight: water Thy servants who have piously departed unto Thee, as they sing and exalt Thee, O Christ, unto the ages.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Мр҃і́е бцⷣе дв҃о, ꙗ҆́же бг҃а сп҃са чл҃кѡмъ ро́жши пло́тїю, сп҃са́й вѣ́рою пою́щихъ твоѐ ржⷭтво̀, и҆ превознося́щихъ тя̀ чⷭтꙋю вовѣ́ки.
items.english_text: O Mary, Mother of God and Virgin, who didst bear in the flesh God the Savior unto men: save those who in faith hymn thy childbearing and exalt thee, the pure one, unto all ages.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь ѳ҃, І҆рмо́съ: Прїе́мшая ра́дость а҆́гглѡмъ.
items.english_text: She that received the joy through the angel...

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Поже́ртїя чи́стая прине́сшеся ко влⷣцѣ, страстоте́рпци мч҃нци, того̀ моли́те спастѝ дꙋша на́ша.
items.english_text: Offered as pure sacrifices unto the Master, O passion-bearing martyrs: pray unto Him that He may save our souls.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже пасты́рїе назла́цѣ бл҃гоче́стїа ст҃и́телїе вѣ́рныя ᲂу҆паслѝ є҆стѐ, и҆ нн҃ѣ во ѡ҆гра́дꙋ бж҃тве́ннꙋю всели́стеся.
items.english_text: As shepherds on the pasture of piety, O hierarchs, ye shepherded the faithful, and now ye have settled in the divine sheepfold.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Со ст҃ы́ми ст҃ли и҆ прⷪрки, и҆ со жена́ми крѣ́пко пострада́вшими, прпⷡныхъ ли́ки ᲂу҆блажи́мъ. Поко́инъ.
items.english_text: With the holy hierarchs and prophets, and with the women who suffered valiantly, let us bless the choirs of the venerable.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Е҆мꙋ́же причаща́ются весе́лїи присносꙋ́щномꙋ ст҃ы́хъ собо́ры, сподо́би преста́вленныхъ ᲂу҆лꙋчи́ти многомл҃тиве. Бг҃о,
items.english_text: Vouchsafe the departed to attain the everlasting gladness whereof the assemblies of the saints partake, O Most-Merciful One.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Свѣ́тъ поро́ждшїя, просвѣтѝ дв҃о дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀, тмꙋ̀ прогоня́ющи грѣха̀, и҆ лѣ́ности моея̀. И҆́нъ І҆рмо́съ, Оу҆страши́ся вся́къ.
items.english_text: O thou who didst bring forth the Light: illumine my soul, O Virgin, driving away the darkness of sin and of my slothfulness.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: И҆мꙋ́ще мч҃нци хв҃и, непобори́мꙋю крѣ́пость и҆ непобѣди́мꙋю, ᲂу҆ничижи́сте мꙋчи́телемъ безбо́жное повелѣ́нїе, и҆ црⷭтвїа нбⷭнаго сла́вѣ сподо́бистеся, просвѣща́еми трⷪчными заря́ми достобл҃же́ннїи.
items.english_text: Every ear shuddered...

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: И҆мꙋ́ще мч҃нци хв҃и, непобори́мꙋю крѣ́пость и҆ непобѣди́мꙋю, ᲂу҆ничижи́сте мꙋчи́телемъ безбо́жное повелѣ́нїе, и҆ црⷭтвїа нбⷭнаго сла́вѣ сподо́бистеся, просвѣща́еми трⷪчными заря́ми достобл҃же́ннїи.
items.english_text: Possessing unconquerable and invincible strength, O martyrs of Christ: ye brought to naught the godless decree of the tormentors, and were accounted worthy of the glory of the heavenly Kingdom, illumined by the rays of the Trinity, O ever-blessed ones. [^281]

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Разрꙋши́ся а҆́дъ го́ркїй, разо́ршꙋ тѝ є҆го̀ чл҃колю́бче, и҆ воскреси́вшꙋ ѿ вѣ́ка та́мо спя́щыя. Но и҆ нн҃ѣ ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гъ, преше́дшыя ктебѣ̀ мл҃рдомꙋ, невече́рняго свѣ́та твое́го сподо́би. Поко́инъ,
items.english_text: Bitter Hades was destroyed when Thou didst pull it down, O Lover of mankind, and didst resurrect those sleeping there from the ages. Now also, as Good, vouchsafe Thy never-setting light unto those who have departed unto Thee, the Compassionate One.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Ве́сь є҆сѝ сп҃се мо́й сла́дость ве́сь є҆сѝ жела́нїе и҆ любо́въ вои́стиннꙋ несы́тная, ве́съ є҆сѝ доброта̀ несказа́нная, преста́вльшаяся ᲂу҆́бѡ ктебѣ̀ твоея̀ красоты̀ наслажда́тися бл҃говолѝ, и҆ бж҃твеннѣй добро́тѣ твое́й сподо́би. Бг҃о,
items.english_text: Thou art all sweetness, O my Savior, Thou art all longing and truly insatiable love, Thou art all ineffable beauty: be well-pleased that those who have departed unto Thee may enjoy Thy beauty, and vouchsafe them Thy divine loveliness.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Спаси́ мя мт҃и бж҃їя, ро́ждшїя х҃а сп҃са мое́го, бг҃а же и҆ чл҃ка, сꙋгꙋ́ба є҆стество́мъ, но̀ несоста́вомъ, є҆диноро́дна ᲂу҆́бѡ ѿ ѻ҆ц҃а̀, и҆стебе́ же перворо́дна все́й тва́ри, си́ми же всѝ тя̀ чⷭтая велича́емъ.
items.english_text: Save me, O Mother of God, who didst bear Christ my Savior, both God and man, twofold in nature but not in person, only-begotten of the Father, and from thee first-born of all creation; therefore we all magnify thee, O pure one.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Прⷪрцы пресла́вні́и, а҆́пли бл҃же́ннїи, патрї-
items.english_text: O glorious prophets, blessed apostles, righteous patriarchs, sole solemn assembly of hierarchs, venerable, righteous, and choir of women, holy martyrs: with the Mother of God, pray unto the Lord to have mercy on your servants.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: а́рси пра́веднїи, є҆ди́нственное торжество̀ и҆ є҆ра́рхѡвъ, прпⷡныхъ же и҆ пра́ведныхъ, и҆ же́нъ сосло́вїе, мч҃нци ст҃і́и, собг҃ома́терїею, моли́теся гдⷭи, поми́ловати ва́ша рабы̀.
items.english_text: *Another Exapostilarion for the Departed:*

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ме́ртвыми и҆ живы́ми ѡ҆блада́я ꙗ҆́ко бг҃ъ, поко́й своя̑ рабы̀ въ се́лехъ и҆збра́нныти, а҆́щебо и҆ согрѣши́ша всѝ, но не ѿстꙋпи́ша ѿтебѐ. Бг҃о.
items.english_text: O Thou Who rulest over the dead and the living as God: give rest unto Thy servants in the dwellings of Thine elect; for even though all have sinned, yet they fell not away from Thee.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же сла́дости а҆́гглѡмъ, и҆ скорбя́щымъ ра́дости, хрⷭтїа́нѡмъ предста́тельнице, де́вице мт҃и гдⷭня, застꙋпи́вши на́съ и҆зба́ви вѣ́чныхъ мꙋче́нїй. На хва́лите Ст҃ры м҃, гла́, ѕ҃.
items.english_text: O sweetness of the angels, and joy of the sorrowful, protectress of Christians, Virgin Mother of the Lord: intercede for us and deliver us from eternal torments.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Гдⷭи въпа́мять ст҃ы́хъ твои́хъ, вся̀ тва́рь пра́зднꙋетъ, нб҃са ра́дꙋются со а҆́гглы, и҆ земля̀ весели́тся со чл҃ки, тѣ́хъ мл҃твами поми́лꙋй на́съ.
items.english_text: *At the Praises, Stichera of the Martyrs, Tone 6:*

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ь҃ Ь҃ в҃] [Кустод: Гдⷭи]
items.english_text: O Lord, in the memory of Thy saints all creation keeps feast; the heavens rejoice with the angels, and the earth makes merry with men: by their prayers have mercy on us. [^282]

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Гдⷭи а҆́ще небы́хомъ ст҃ыя твоя̑ и҆мѣ́ли моли́твеники, и҆ бл҃гть ти тво́ю ми́лꙋющꙋ на́съ, ка́кѡ смѣ́ли бы́хѡмъ сп҃се пѣ́ти тя̀; є҆го́же славосло́вятъ безпреста́ни а҆́ггли, срцевЂ́дче пощадѝ дꙋ́ша на́ша. м҃.
items.english_text: O Lord, if we had not Thy saints as intercessors, and Thy grace showing mercy upon us, how should we dare, O Savior, to hymn Thee, Whom the angels unceasingly glorify? O Knower of hearts, spare our souls! (Martyrikon)

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Па́мять мч҃нкъ, ра́дость боя́щымся гдⷭа, пострада́вше бо х҃а ра́ди, вѣнцы̑ ѿ него̀ прїя́ша, и҆ нн҃ѣ со дерзнове́нїемъ мо́лятся ѡ҆ дꙋша́хъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: The memory of the martyrs is joy unto those who fear the Lord; for having suffered for the sake of Christ, they received crowns from Him, and now with boldness they pray for our souls.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: И҆збра́нныя ᲂу҆дивѝ и҆ ст҃ыя бг҃ъ на́шъ, ра́дꙋйтеся и҆ весели́теся всѝ рабѝ є҆го̀, ва́мъ бо ᲂу҆гото́валъ є҆́стъ вѣне́цъ и҆ цр҃твїе своѐ. но мо́лимся и҆ на́съ незабꙋ́дите.
items.english_text: Our God made marvelous His chosen and holy ones: rejoice and be glad, all ye His servants, for He has prepared for you a crown and His Kingdom; but we pray you, forget not us also.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Болѣ́знь а҆да́мꙋ бы́сть дре́ва вкꙋше́нїемъ дре́вле во є҆де́мѣ, є҆гда̀ ѕмїа̀ я҆́дъ ѿры́гнꙋ, того̀ бо ра́ди вни́де сме́рть всеро́дна снѣда́ющи чл҃ка, но прише́дъ влⷣка низло-
items.english_text: Grief came upon Adam through the tasting of the tree of old in Eden, when the serpent vomited forth venom; for on account of that, universal death entered, devouring man. But the Master came and cast down the serpent, and granted us the Resurrection: unto Him therefore let us cry aloud: Spare, O Savior, and give rest with the saints unto those whom Thou hast taken to Thyself, as Lover of mankind.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: жѝ ѕмїа̀, и҆ воскресе́нїе на́мъ дарова̀, кнемꙋ́ же ᲂу҆́бѡ возопїе́мъ, пощадѝ сп҃се, и҆́хже прїя́тъ со ст҃ы́ми поко́й, ꙗ҆́кѡ человѣколю́бецъ. Сла́ва, и҆ Нн҃ѣ: Бг҃о.
items.english_text: Thou art our God, Who in wisdom hast made all things and dost bring them to completion: Thou didst send prophets to foretell Thy coming, and apostles to proclaim Thy marvelous works; and while the former prophesied Thy coming, the latter illumined the nations through baptism; and the martyrs obtained what they desired; and the assembly of both, together with her who gave birth to Thee, O Christ, prays unto Thee: Give rest, O God, unto the souls of those whom Thou hast taken to Thyself, and make us worthy of Thy Kingdom, O Thou Who didst endure crucifixion for my sake, the condemned one, my Deliverer and God!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ є҆сѝ бг҃ъ на́шъ и҆́же мꙋ́дростїю вся̑ содѣ́яла и҆ соверша́я: прⷪрки посла́лъ є҆сѝ прорещѝ твоѐ прише́ствїе, а҆́плы проповѣ́дати твоя̑ вели́чїа: и҆ ѡ҆́вы ᲂу҆́бѡ прⷪрчествова́хꙋ твоѐ прише́ствїе, ѡ҆ви́н же кр҃ще́нїемъ просвѣти́ша я҆зы́ки, мч҃нци же полꙋчи́ша я҆́же жела́хꙋ, и҆ мо́лятъ тя̀ ли́къ ѻ҆бои́хъ, со ро́ждшею тя̀ х҃е: поко́й бж҃е дꙋ́ша я҆́же прїя́тъ, и҆ на́съ сподо́би црⷭтвїю твое́мꙋ: и҆́же распя́тїе претерпѣ́вый менѐ ра́ди ѡ҆сꙋжде́наго, и҆зба́вителю мо́й бж҃е.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Penitential Stichera, Tone 6.*

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: ныя бл҃гости, многомл҃тиве, и҆́же ктебѣ̀ влⷣко преше́дшая, на землѝ живы́хъ вселѝ, вселе́нїа возлю́бленнаѧ и҆ жела́емая, ѡ҆держа́нїе да́рꙋя при́снѡ пребыва́ющее, ты̀ бо за всѣ́хъ пролїя́лъ є҆сѝ кро́вь свою̀ сп҃се, и҆ живоно́сною цѣно́ю, мі́ра и҆скꙋпи́лъ є҆сѝ. Ст҃и: Дꙋша и҆́хъ вобл҃ги́хъ водворятся.
items.english_text: Possessing incomprehensible compassion toward us, and an inexhaustible fountain of divine [^283] goodness, O Most-Merciful One: settle those who have passed over unto Thee, O Master, in the land of the living, the beloved and desired habitations, granting an inheritance that abides forever; for Thou didst shed Thy blood for all, O Savior, and by that life-bearing price hast redeemed the world.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́нїе претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ, животворя́щею во́лею, и҆ живо́тъ и҆сточи́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ пи́щꙋ присносꙋ́щнꙋ вѣ́рнымъ да́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́же и҆ нн҃ѣ да́рꙋй ᲂу҆со́пшимъ ѡ҆ ᲂу҆пова́нїи воскресе́нїа, тѣ́хъ согрѣше́нїа вся̑ проща́я бл҃гостїю, ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ безгрѣ́шенъ, є҆ди́нъ бл҃гъ и҆ чл҃колю́бецъ, да завсѐ пое́тся и҆́мя твоѐ х҃е, и҆ спасе́ннїи сла́вимъ чл҃колю́бїе твоѐ. Ст҃и: Бл҃же́ни я҆́же и҆збра́лъ и приял еси Господи.
items.english_text: Thou didst endure death by Thy life-creating will, and didst pour forth life, and gavest everlasting food unto the faithful: grant it now also unto those who have fallen asleep in the hope of the Resurrection, forgiving all their sins in Thy goodness, as the only Sinless One, the only Good One and Lover of mankind; that for all things Thy name may be hymned, O Christ, and that we, being saved, may glorify Thy love for mankind.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Живы́ми гдⷭьствꙋя, бг҃онача́лною вла́-
items.english_text: Exercising lordship over the living by Thy divine originating authority, and ruling as Master over the dead: knowing Thee, O Christ, we pray Thee:

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: стїю: и҆ ме́ртвыми влⷣчествꙋя, тебѐ х҃е зна́юще мо́лимся, вѣ́рныя рабы̀ своя̑, и҆́же тебѣ̀ є҆ди́номꙋ бл҃гтелю ѿше́дшая, тѣ́хъ поко́й со и҆збра́нными тѝ чл҃колї́че, на мѣ́стѣ ᲂу҆тѣше́нїа, во ст҃ы́хъ свѣ́тлостехъ, воли́тель мл҃ти є҆сѝ, и҆ спаса́еши ꙗ҆́кѡ бг҃ъ и҆́хже по ѡ҆́бразꙋ свое́мꙋ созда́лъ є҆сѝ, є҆ди́не многомл҃тиве. Сла́ва и҆ Нн҃ѣ, Бг҃о.
items.english_text: give rest unto Thy faithful servants who have departed unto Thee, the only Benefactor, together with Thine elect, O Lover of mankind, in the place of comfort, in the brightness of the saints; for Thou art the willer of mercy, and as God Thou savest those whom Thou hast created in Thine own image, O only Most-Merciful One.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆ви́лася є҆сѝ жили́ще бг҃олѣ́пное прⷭтая, и҆ бг҃а вомѣсти́ла є҆сѝ, и҆ х҃а ро́ждши мт҃и дв҃о, во дво́ю є҆щество̀, во є҆ди́номъ же соста́вѣ, того̀ ᲂу҆молѝ чⷭтая є҆диноро́днаго пе́рвенца, и҆́же тя̀ дв҃ꙋ непоро́чнꙋ и҆ порожде́ствѣ сохра́ншаго: дꙋ́ша поко́ити и҆́же вѣ́рою ᲂу҆со́пшихъ, восвѣ́тѣ и҆ въ нетлѣ́ннемъ бл҃же́нствѣ.
items.english_text: Thou appearedst as a divinely fitting habitation, O all-pure one, and didst contain God, having given birth to Christ, O Virgin Mother, in two natures, yet in one person: entreat Him, O pure one, the only-begotten Firstborn, Who preserved thee a blameless Virgin even after childbirth: to give rest unto the souls of those who have fallen asleep in faith, in the light and incorruptible beatitude.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Въ Сꙋбѡ́тꙋ Блаже́нна, Гла́съ Ше́стый.
items.english_text: *On Saturday, the Beatitudes, Tone 6:* [^284]

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: [П]омяни́ мѧ̀ бж҃е сп҃се мо́й, є҆гда̀ прїи́деши во црⷭтвїи свое́мъ, и҆ сп҃си мя̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ чл҃колю́бецъ.
items.english_text: Remember me, O God my Savior, when Thou comest into Thy Kingdom, and save me, as the only Lover of mankind.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆гня̀ и҆ меча̀, и҆ ѕвѣре́й ди́вїихъ ᲂу҆стремле́нїа, страстоте́рпци сла́вні́и не ᲂу҆боя́стеся, присносꙋ́щнаго живота̀ сподо́бистеся.
items.english_text: Of the fire, the sword, and the rushing of wild beasts, O glorious passion-bearers, ye were not afraid; and ye were accounted worthy of life everlasting.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же прⷪрки, и҆ ᲂу҆ч҃тля и҆ прпⷣбныя, и҆ ст҃и́теля и҆ пра́ведныя просла́вивъ чл҃колю́бче, тѣ́хъ мл҃твами сп҃си дꙋ́ша на́ша.
items.english_text: Thou Who didst glorify prophets, and teachers, and the venerable, and hierarchs, and the righteous, O Lover of mankind: by their prayers save our souls.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Со ст҃ы́ми и҆ пра́ведными ᲂу҆чинѝ сло́ве, и҆́хже вѣ́рою преста́вилъ є҆сѝ ѿ вре́менныхъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ да сла́вимъ тя̀. Сла́ва.
items.english_text: Rank with the saints and the righteous, O Word, those whom in faith Thou hast translated from temporal things, that we may glorify Thee.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ и҆ сн҃а славосло́вимъ, и҆ дх҃а ст҃а́го гл҃юще, трⷪце ст҃а́я сп҃си дꙋша нашѧ. И҆ нн҃ѣ.
items.english_text: We glorify the Father and the Son, and the Holy Spirit, saying: O Holy Trinity, save our souls.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Блаже́нна вовсѣ́хъ ро́дѣхъ ꙗ҆ви́лася є҆сѝ, бг҃а бо воисти́ннꙋ бл҃же́ннаго несказа́нно породи́ла є҆сѝ прⷭтая.
items.english_text: Blessed hast thou appeared in all generations, for truly ineffably didst thou bear God the Blessed One, O all-holy Lady.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: [Орнаментальная заставка и ксилографическая рамка]
items.english_text: *The Resurrectional Exapostilaria and Evangelical Stichera. The work of Emperor Leo.* [^285]

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: и҆ стїхи̑ры є҆ѵаггⷭльскїа. творе́нїе Ле́ѵа деспо́та.
items.english_text: With the disciples let us ascend the mountain of Galilee in faith, to behold Christ saying that He received authority over the things above and below: let us learn how to teach and to baptize all the nations in the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit, and to abide with the disciples, as He promised, unto the end of the age.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: ве́: ты́ же є҆го̀ прїе́мши сп҃се́нїи ходота́йца, ѿ чⷭты́хъ крове́й твои́хъ, и҆зба́вителю па́че сло́ва пло́ть вза́имъ да́вши: є҆го́же молѝ, и҆збавле́нїе рабо́мъ твои̑мъ пода́ти прегрѣше́нїемъ:
items.english_text: He Who is divinely glorified in the highest by the angels, not departing ineffably from the bosom of the Father, O all-holy Virgin, and lived: and thou, having received Him as the Mediator of salvation, from thy pure blood didst lend flesh beyond understanding unto the Redeemer: pray Him to grant deliverance from transgressions unto thy servants.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Стїхи́ра, а҃, є҆ѵⷢлскаѧ. Гла́съ, а҃.
items.english_text: When the disciples were going up to the mountain for the earthly ascension, the Lord stood before them; and they worshipped Him, and they are sent forth throughout the universe under heaven to preach the resurrection from the dead and the ascension into the heavens; with whom Christ God, the Savior of our souls, promised without falsehood to abide.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: [Н]а го́рꙋ ᲂу҆че́нникѡмъ и҆дꙋ́щимъ* за̀ земно́е вознесе́нїе* предста̀ гдⷭь, и҆ поклони́шася є҆мꙋ̀* и҆ въ поднебе́снꙋю посыла́ются проповѣ́дати* є҆́же и҆зме́ртвыхъ воскрⷭнїе, и҆ є҆́же на нб҃са вознесе́нїе, и҆̀мже и҆ пребыва́ти нело́жно ѡ҆бѣща́ся х҃с б҃ъ, и҆ сп҃съ дꙋша́мъ на́шимъ.
items.english_text: Seeing the stone rolled away, the myrrh-bearing women rejoiced; for they beheld a young man sitting in the tomb, and he said unto them: "Behold, Christ is risen! Say therefore unto Peter and to the disciples:

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: [К]а́мень ѿвале́нъ ви́дѣвши мѵроно́сица, ра́довахꙋся: ви́дѣша бо ю҆́ношꙋ сѣдѧ́ща вогро́бѣ, и҆ то́й тѣ́м речѐ: сѐ х҃с воскр҃се, рцѣ́те ᲂу҆́бо Петро́ви и҆ ᲂу҆́чнкѡмъ
items.english_text: Hasten to the mountain of Galilee; there shall He appear unto you, as He foretold unto His friends."

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: на̀ го́рꙋ притекѣ́те галиле́йскꙋю, та́мѡ ва́мъ ꙗ҆ви́тся, ꙗ҆́коже пре́же речѐ дрꙋгѡ́мъ: Бг҃о.
items.english_text: The Sun shone forth from the tomb today as a bridegroom from his chamber, and led Hades captive, and abolished death: by the prayers of her who bare Thee, O Christ, send forth light upon us, light enlightening hearts and souls, light leading all of us inward and guiding us unto the paths of Thy commandments and unto the way of humility.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: є҆го̀ воє́кша и҆зме́ртвыхъ* ꙗ҆́кѡ жи́знода́вца и҆ гдⷭа.
items.english_text: Unto the women who came with myrrh together with Mary, and were in perplexity how they might attain their desire, the stone appeared rolled away; and a divine young man assuaged the turmoil of their souls, for he said: "The Lord is risen; therefore hasten to Galilee unto His preachers, the disciples, and behold Him [^286] raised from the dead, as Giver of life and Lord."

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: [Ꙗ҆́]кѡ х҃с воскр҃се, никто́же неневѣ́рꙋй: показа́ся ᲂу҆́бѡ мр҃і́и, пото́же ꙗ҆ви́ся на село̀ и҆дꙋ́щема двѣ́ма: ᲂу҆ч҃нкѡ[мъ] же па́ки ꙗ҆ви́ся, возлежѧ́щимъ є҆диномꙋна́десяте, и҆́хже крести́ти посла́въ на нб҃са̀ вознесе́ся ѿню́дꙋже и҆ сни́де, ᲂу҆твержда́я пропода́нїе, мно́гими зна́меньми. Бг҃о.
items.english_text: Let no one disbelieve that Christ is risen! For He appeared unto Mary, and then was seen by two walking into the country; and He appeared again unto the eleven as they sat at meat, whom He sent forth to baptize, and ascended into heaven whence He had descended, confirming their preaching with many signs.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Сꙋще́ственными сво́йствы сн҃ъ тво́й дв҃це, ꙗ҆́кѡ мр҃твъ ѿсна̀ возбнꙋ́въ, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ бг҃ъ воскр҃се: и҆стлѣ́нїа бо неви́даше, є҆го́же при́снѡ чⷭтая молѝ, лю́демъ и҆ ста́дꙋ твое́мꙋ на́мъ, свѣ́тъ посла́ти: дне́внаго и҆ но́щнаго претыка́нїа спасѝ, и҆́же со ѻ҆ц҃емъ и҆ дх҃омъ, є҆ди́номꙋ бг҃ꙋ покланѧ́ющымся.
items.english_text: By essential properties, O Virgin, Thy Son awoke from sleep as one dead, and rose as God; for He saw no corruption. Entreat Him unceasingly, O pure Lady, to send down light upon us, Thy people and Thy flock: save from daytime and nighttime stumbling us who worship Him together with the Father and the Spirit, one God.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Стїхи́ра, г҃. Є҆ѵа́лскаѧ Гла́съ, г҃.
items.english_text: When Mary Magdalene announced the Savior's resurrection from the dead and His appearance, the disciples, disbelieving, were reproached for their hardness of heart; yet, being filled with signs and wonders, they were sent forth to preach. But Thou, O Lord, didst ascend unto the Father, the primal Light; and they proclaimed the Word everywhere, confirmed by wonders. And having been enlightened through them, we glorify Thy resurrection from the dead, O Lord, Lover of mankind.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: и҆ содѣ́янномꙋ ᲂу҆дивль́шеся, пребꙋ́демъ хрⷭта ви́дѣти. Бг҃о.
items.english_text: Having shone forth in virtues, let us behold standing in the life-bearing tomb men in gleaming raiment; and as the myrrh-bearing women bowed their faces to the earth before Him Who rules the heavens, let us learn of the resurrection, and run with Peter to the life-bearing tomb [^287] and marveling at what was done, let us remain to behold Christ.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Во чре́во твоѐ гдⷭь вопло́щься, поги́бшаго мі́ра ѿ тлѝ призва́ти восхотѣ́въ, ꙗ҆́коже вѣ́сть всели́ся в тя̀ бцⷣе: сп҃се́нїе же всѝ ѡ҆брѣ́тше, вопїе́мъ тѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́гг҃лъ: ра́дꙋйся є҆ди́на чⷭтая, въ жена́хъ всѣ́хъ бл҃гослове́нная, сп҃се́нїе бо роди́ла є҆сѝ все́й вселе́ннѣй.
items.english_text: Having become incarnate in thy womb, O Lord, willing to call back from corruption a fallen world, as He alone knows, He dwelt in thee, O Mother of God; and having all found salvation, we cry unto thee like the angel: Rejoice, only pure Lady, blessed among all women, for thou didst bear salvation unto the whole universe!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Стїхи́ра є҆ѵⷢлскаѧ. Гла́съ, Четве́ртый.
items.english_text: It was early morning, and the women came unto Thy tomb, O Christ, but the body desired by them was not found. Therefore, as they were in perplexity, two men stood by them in gleaming raiment, saying: "Why seek ye the living among the dead? He is risen, as He said before! Why remember ye not His words?" And believing them, they proclaimed what they had seen; but their glad tidings seemed an idle tale:

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: [О]у҆́тренняя бѣ̀ ра́но* и҆ же́ны прїидо́ша на гро́бъ тво́й х҃е* но тѣ́ло не ѡ҆брѣ́теся дне́нмое и҆́ми* тѣ́мъ недомышля́ющымся* и҆́же блица́ющимися ри́зами предста́ша что̀ жива́го с ме́ртвыми и҆́щете гла́голаста* воста̀ ꙗ҆́коже пре́же* что̀ непо́мните глаго́лъ є҆го̀* и҆̀ма же вѣ́ровавше* ви́дѣнная проповѣда́хꙋ* но мня́шеся лжа̀ бл҃говѣ́щенїе
items.english_text: so slumbering were the disciples still! But Peter ran and beheld, and glorified within himself Thy wonders.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: нїе* та́ко бы́ша є҆щѐ со́ннїи ᲂу҆ч҃нцы* но̀ Пе́тръ течѐ и҆ ви́дѣвъ* и҆ просла́ви твоя̑ всебѣ̀ чꙋдеса̀.
items.english_text: Christ, the Life and the Way, rose from the dead: journeying on the road with Cleopas and Luke, He was made known unto them in Emmaus in the breaking of bread; whose hearts and souls were burning when He spoke unto them on the way and expounded from the Scriptures what He had suffered; with them we also cry: "He hath appeared also unto Peter!"

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: [Ж]иво́тъ и҆ пꙋ́ть х҃съ, воста̀ и҆зме́ртвыхъ: клео́пѣ и҆ лꙋцѣ̀ в пꙋ́ть ше́ствꙋя, и҆́ма же позна́ся в є҆ммаꙋ́сѣ в преломле́нїи хлѣ́ба: є҆ю́же срⷣца и҆ дꙋ́ша горя́ще бѧ́хꙋ, є҆гда̀ тѣ́ма гла́ше на пꙋ́ти, и҆ писа́нїа сказова́ше ꙗ҆́же пострада̀: и҆ ни́ми же зове́мъ, ꙗ҆ви́жеся и҆ Петро́ви. Бг҃о.
items.english_text: The Creator and Lord and God of all things, taking earthly flesh from thy pure blood, O all-praised Mother of God, made my corrupted nature new, leaving thee after childbearing again even as thou wast before childbirth: therefore we all praise thee in faith, crying: Rejoice, glory of the world!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Творе́цъ и҆ гдⷭь, и҆ бг҃ъ вся́ческимъ: пло́ть земнꙋ́ю прїе́мъ, ѿ чⷭты́хъ крове́й твои́хъ всепѣ́тая бцⷣе: и҆ нетлѣ́вшее мнѣ̀ є҆стество̀ но́во содѣ́ла, па́ки ꙗ҆́коже пре́же ржⷭтва̀, ѡ҆ста́вль по ржⷭтвѣ̀: тѣ́мже тя̀ вѣ́рою всѝ восхваля́емъ зовꙋ́ще, ра́дꙋйся мі́рови сла́ва.
items.english_text: *Evangelical Sticheron 5, Tone 5:* [^288]

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: [Ѽ] премꙋ́рыхъ сꙋде́бъ твои́хъ х҃е! ка́ко петрꙋ̀ ᲂу҆́бѡ ри́зами є҆ди́нѣми* вда́лъ є҆сѝ разꙋмѣ́ти твоѐ воскресе́нїе* лꙋцѣ́ же и҆ клеѡ́пѣ впꙋ́ть ше́ствꙋя гла́ше* и҆ гла́голя неско́ро себѐ ꙗ҆вля́ше* тѣ́мъ и҆ поноси́мъ быва́ше* ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ прише́лствꙋяй во І҆ерꙋсали́мъ* и҆ невѣ́дый в коне́цъ совѣ́та є҆я̀* но вся̑ козда́нїю напо́льзꙋ стро́я* и҆ ꙗ҆́же ѡ҆тебѣ̀ проро́чествїа ѿкры́лъ є҆сѝ* и҆ во бл҃гве́нїи хлѣ́ба позна́ся и҆́ма* є҆́юже и҆ пре́жде того̀ срⷣца, к позна́нїю твое́мꙋ распала́стася* ꙗ҆́же и҆ ᲂу҆ч҃нкѡ собра́нномъ* ᲂу҆жѐ ꙗ҆́вено проповѣ́да́ста твоѐ воскрⷭнїе* и҆́мже поми́лꙋй на́съ.
items.english_text: O how wise are Thy judgments, O Christ! How unto Peter indeed by the graveclothes alone Thou gavest to understand Thy resurrection; yet walking on the way with Luke and Cleopas, Thou didst converse with them, and speaking, didst not quickly reveal Thyself. Therefore Thou wast reproached as one journeying alone in Jerusalem, not knowing her counsel unto the end. Yet disposing all things for the benefit of the creation, Thou didst unfold the prophecies concerning Thyself, and in the blessing of the bread wast made known unto them, whose hearts even before that were kindled unto the knowledge of Thee; and they openly proclaimed Thy resurrection unto the assembled disciples: through whom have mercy upon us!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Показа́лся є҆сѝ сп҃се ꙗ҆́кѡ чл҃къ по є҆сꙋ́ществꙋ, посредѣ̀ ста́въ, воскр҃се ѿ гро́ба, и҆ пи́щꙋ совкꙋше́ная ᲂу҆ча́ше кр҃ще́нїю покаѧ́нїа:
items.english_text: Thou didst show Thyself, O Savior, as man by nature, standing in their midst when Thou didst rise from the tomb; and partaking of food, Thou didst teach the baptism of repentance:

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: нїа: а҆́бїе же к нбⷭномꙋ вознесе́ся ѿц҃ꙋ, и҆ ᲂу҆ч҃нкѡм посла́ти ᲂу҆тѣ́шителѧ ѡ҆бѣща́ся, пребж҃твеннѣ чл҃колю́бче, сла́ва твое́мꙋ воста́нїю. Бг҃о.
items.english_text: and straightway Thou didst ascend unto the heavenly Father, and didst promise to send the Comforter unto the disciples: O supremely divine Lover of mankind, glory to Thy rising!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Свое́го сн҃а ꙗ҆́кѡ ви́дѣвши ѿ ме́ртвыхъ воста́вша, ра́дости и҆спо́лнися прⷭтая, и҆ неизрече́нное є҆го̀ воспѣва́ше бл҃гоᲂу҆тро́бїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ ѿ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ нѣ́дръ не ѿстꙋ́пльшаго, и҆ ѿ тебѐ вои́лꙋъ, всѣ́хъ ѿ и҆стлѣ́нїа стра́стїю раздрѣшѝ крⷭтно́ю, и҆ ко живо́тꙋ возведѐ своего̀ мл҃дїа.
items.english_text: Beholding her Son risen from the dead, the all-holy Virgin was filled with joy, and praised His ineffable lovingkindness; for, not having departed from the Father's bosom, and born of thee, by His passion on the Cross He released all from corruption, and led back to life His own infant creature.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: че невѣ́рꙋющимъ и҆̀мъ є҆щѐ* бра́шна вкꙋше́нїемъ* и҆ ᲂу҆че́нїй воспомина́нїемъ* ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ и҆́мъ ᲂу҆́мъ разꙋмѣ́ти писа́нїа* и҆́мже и҆ ѻ҆́тческое ѡ҆бѣтова́нїе ѡ҆бѣща́въ* и҆ бл҃гви́въ и҆́хъ возы́нде на нб҃о* тѣ́мже сни́ми покланя́емтисѧ* гдⷭи сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_text: Truly Thou art peace, O Christ, granting Thy peace of God unto men; after the resurrection showing Thyself unto the disciples, Thou didst find them terrified, supposing that they beheld a spirit; but Thou didst quell the turmoil of their souls, showing them Thy hands and Thy feet [^289] yet while they still disbelieved, by the partaking of food and the recalling of teachings Thou didst open their mind to understand the Scriptures; and having promised them the Father's promise, and blessed them, Thou didst ascend into heaven: therefore with them we worship Thee: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: [Ꙗ҆́]кѡ взя́ша гдⷭа мр҃і́а ре́кши, на гро́бъ теча́ста си́монъ пе́тръ, и҆ дрꙋгі́и, ᲂу҆ч҃нкъ хв҃ъ, є҆го́же любля́ше: теча́ста же ѻ҆́ба вкꙋ́пѣ, и҆ ѡ҆брѣто́ша ри́зы є҆ди́ны внꙋ́трь лежа́ща, и҆ гла́вныи бя́ше сꙋда́рь кро́мѣ и҆́хъ. тѣ́мже па́ки ᲂу҆молча́ша, до́ндеже х҃а ви́дѣша. Бг҃о.
items.english_text: Saying that they had taken away the Lord, Mary ran to the tomb, and Simon Peter and the other disciple of Christ whom He loved ran with her: and both ran together, and found only the linen clothes lying within, and the napkin for the head was apart from them. Therefore they held their peace again until they beheld Christ.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Поѝ тво́й безчи́сленꙋю мл҃ть сп҃се мо́й, ꙗ҆́кѡ себѐ и҆злїя́лъ є҆сѝ, понестѝ и҆ сп҃сти
items.english_text: Sing of Thy countless mercy, O my Savior, for Thou didst pour Thyself out to bear and to save the fallen nature of earthly beings: being God, Thou wast pleased to become like me from the pure Virgin Maiden of God, and to descend into Hades, and to lead me forth thence: by her prayers, O Lord, save our souls!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: є҆́стество земны́хъ поги́бшее: бг҃ъ сы́й и҆зво́лилъ є҆сѝ ѿ чⷭтыя бг҃оѿрокови́ца по мнѣ̀ бы́ти, и҆ сни́ти во а҆́дъ, и҆ ѿтꙋ́дꙋ мя̀ и҆звестѝ, є҆́яже моли́твами гдⷭи спасѝ дꙋ́ша на́ша.
items.english_text: Lo, it is dark and early: why standest thou at the tomb, O Mary, having great darkness in thy mind, asking where Jesus was laid? But look upon the disciples running together: how by the linen clothes and the napkin they came to know of the resurrection, and remembered the Scriptures concerning them! With whom and for whose sake having believed, we hymn Thee, O Christ Giver of life.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: зна́вши всебѣ̀, сп҃са слы́ша неприкаса́ися мнѣ̀, ко ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ́ бо восхождꙋ̀, рцы̀ бра́тїи мое́й. Бг҃о.
items.english_text: Beholding two angels within the tomb, Mary was amazed; and not knowing Christ, she questioned Him as the gardener: "Sir, where hast thou laid the body of my Jesus?" But having recognized Him by His call [^290] within herself, she heard the Savior say: "Touch Me not, for I ascend unto My Father: say unto My brethren!"

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: [Ѽ]тч҃ескихъ нѣ́дръ не ѡ҆ста́вль, а҆́ще и҆ воплоти́ся ѿ дв҃ы гдⷭь, спастѝ мя̀ па́дшаго, и҆ прекло́нь нб҃са соше́дъ, и҆ и҆схити́ти хотя̀ ѿ ᲂу҆́стъ ѕвѣ́ря разꙋ́мнаго, того̀ мя̀ плени́цами ѡ҆держи́ма, тѣ́м и҆зба́вся сп҃се, сла́влю твою̀ си́лꙋ.
items.english_text: Not having left the Father's bosom, though He became incarnate of the Virgin, the Lord came down, bowing the heavens, to save me who was fallen, and desiring to snatch me from the mouth of the intelligible beast, held fast in his bonds: therefore, having been delivered, O Savior, I glorify Thy power.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Мр҃і́ины сле́зы* небе́зꙋма пролива́ются те́плѣ* сѐ ᲂу҆́бѡ сподо́бися ᲂу҆че́нїй а҆́гглъскихъ* и҆ ѡ҆́бразꙋ само́го І҆и҃са* но̀ и҆ є҆щѐ земна́я мы́слитъ ꙗ҆́кѡ немо́щна* тѣ́м и҆ ѿсыла́ется неприкаса́тися х҃ꙋ* но ѡ҆ба́че проповѣ́дница посыла́ется твои́мъ ᲂу҆ч҃нкѡмъ* и҆̀мже бл҃говѣще́нїе нося́ще
items.english_text: Not without reason were Mary's warm tears poured forth: for lo, she was accounted worthy of the instruction of angels and the vision of Jesus Himself! Yet still she thought earthly thoughts, being frail: therefore she was sent away not to touch Christ. But nevertheless she was sent as a herald unto Thy disciples, bearing the glad tidings unto them, announcing Thine ascent unto the Father's portion: and by these things vouchsafe Thine appearance unto us also, O Master and Lord!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: є҆́же ко ѻ҆тч҃ескомꙋ жре́бїю восхо́дъ возвѣща́етъ* си́ми же сподо́би и҆ на́съ* ꙗ҆вле́нїа твое́го влⷣко гдⷭи.
items.english_text: When Thou camest in, O Master, the doors being shut, Thou didst fill the apostles with the All-Holy Spirit, breathing peace upon them, unto whom Thou saidst to bind and to loose sins; and after eight days Thou didst show Thy side and hands unto Thomas, with whom we also cry: "Thou art my Lord and my God!"

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Затворе́ннымъ влⷣко две́ремъ ꙗ҆́коже вни́де, а҆́плы и҆спо́лни дх҃а прⷭта́го, ми́рно дꙋ́нꙋ, и҆́мже вяза́ти и҆ разрѣша́ти грѣхѝ ре́клъ є҆сѝ: и҆ по̀ ѡ҆смѝ дні́и твоя̑ ре́бра ѳѡмѣ̀ показа́лъ є҆сѝ и҆ рꙋ́цѣ, сни́ми же воста̀ зове́[мъ], гдⷭь и҆ бг҃ъ мо́й ты̀ є҆сѝ. Бг҃о.
items.english_text: O Birthgiver of God, pure and all-holy Virgin, Joy of the afflicted, Protection of the world, Intercessor for sinners: by thy prayers console the hearts of the sorrowful; for we the faithful have no other hope after God besides thee, O pure Mother, our hope loving mankind, and thou savest the world, O Maiden.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ороди́телнице чⷭтая прⷭтая дв҃о, ско́рбящымъ ра́дости, мі́рꙋ покро́ве, грѣ́шникѡмъ предста́телнице, скорбя́щихъ срⷣца твои́ми мл҃твами ᲂу҆блажѝ: ꙗ҆́кѡ и҆но́я наде́жда по бз҃ѣ вѣ́рнїи неи́мамы, ра́звѣ тебѐ мт҃и чⷭтая, ᲂу҆пова́нїе на́ше міролю́бная, и҆ спаса́еши ми́ра ѿрокови́це.
items.english_text: *Evangelical Sticheron 9, Tone 5:* [^291]

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: [Ꙗ҆́]кѡ во послѣ́дная времена̀* та́ко и҆ во ве́черъ сꙋбо́тный* предста́лъ є҆сѝ дрꙋгѡ́мъ си х҃е* и҆ чꙋдесе́мъ чꙋ́до и҆звѣ́ствꙋеши* затворе́нномъ вхо́домъ две́рнымъ* є҆́же и҆зме́ртвыхъ твоѐ воскресе́нїе* но̀ и҆спо́лнилъ є҆сѝ ра́дости ᲂу҆ч҃нки* и҆ дх҃а ст҃а́го пода́лъ є҆сѝ и҆́мъ, и҆ ѡ҆́бласть вда́сть ѡ҆ставле́нїи грѣхѡ́мъ* и҆ ѳомы̀ не ѡ҆ста́вилъ є҆сѝ в невѣ́рствїи, погрꙋжа́тися бꙋ́рею* тѣ́мже пода́ждь на́мъ ра́зꙋмъ и҆́стинный* и҆ ѡ҆ставле́нїе прегрѣше́нїемъ* бл҃агосе́рде гдⷭи.
items.english_text: As in the latter times, on the evening of the Sabbath, Thou didst appear unto Thy friends, O Christ, and by a wonder didst confirm a wonder: entering through shut doors, Thou didst confirm Thy resurrection from the dead! But Thou didst fill the disciples with joy, and didst bestow upon them the Holy Spirit, and gavest authority for the remission of sins; and Thou didst not leave Thomas to drown in the tempest of unbelief: therefore grant unto us true understanding and remission of transgressions, O tender-hearted Lord!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Тиверїа́дское мо́ре, со дѣ́тми зеведе́ѡвыми, наѳанаи́лъ съ петро́мъ, и҆ со дрꙋги́ма двѣ́ма дре́вле, и҆ ло́вꙋ и҆ма́ше на ло́вѣ, и҆́же хв҃ымъ повелѣ́нїемъ ѡ҆деснꙋ́ю вове́ргше, мно́жество и҆звлеко́ша ры́бъ: є҆го́же
items.english_text: At the Sea of Tiberias of old, with the sons of Zebedee, Nathanael was with Peter, and two other disciples, engaged in fishing; who at Christ's bidding cast the net on the right side, and drew out a multitude of fishes:

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: пе́тръ позна́въ, кнемꙋ̀ брода́ше. сѐ ᲂу҆жѐ трети́щен ꙗ҆ви́ся, хлѣ́бъ показа̀ и҆ ры́бꙋ на ᲂу҆́глехъ. Бг҃о.
items.english_text: whom Peter recognizing, waded toward Him. Behold, this was the third time He appeared, showing bread and fish upon the coals.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Покланя́ющеся прⷭтая твое́мꙋ чⷭтномꙋ ѡ҆́бразꙋ, сы́ны свѣ́тꙋ покажѝ, и҆ жи́теля ра́еви, и҆ црⷭтвїю прича́стники: моли́твеннци бо и҆ лю́дїе твоѝ є҆смы̀ всечⷭтая, да не ѿпаде́мъ покро́ва твое́го бл҃гце, и҆ ча́сти всѣ́хъ сп҃се́нныхъ сподо́би пренепоро́чная.
items.english_text: Venerating thine honorable icon, O all-holy Lady, show us to be sons of light, and dwellers of Paradise, and partakers of the Kingdom: for we are thy suppliants and thy people, O all-pure one; let us not fall from thy protection, O Good Lady, and account us worthy of the portion of all the saved, O all-immaculate Virgin.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: ско́рѣ* и҆ мно́жество ры́бъ мно́го* и҆ вече́ря стра́нна гото́ва на землѝ* є҆́яже прича́ститися тогда̀ твои́мъ ᲂу҆ч҃нкѡмъ* и҆ на́съ нн҃ѣ разꙋ́мно сподо́би насыти́тися* чл҃колю́бче гдⷭи.
items.english_text: After the descent into Hades and the resurrection from the dead, grieving as was meet over parting from Thee, O Christ, the disciples returned to work, and again took to the boat and nets; and of catch there was nothing! But Thou, O Savior, didst appear as Master of all, commanding to cast the net on the right side; and immediately the word became deed [^292] swiftly, and a great multitude of fishes, and a strange supper prepared on the earth! Of which Thy disciples then partook: vouchsafe us also now to be spiritually filled, O Lord Lover of mankind!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: По бж҃тве́ннѣмъ воста́нїи, три́щи петро́ви речѐ гдⷭь, лю́биши ли мя̀; свои́мъ ѡ҆вца́мъ предлага́етъ пастыренача́лника: ꙗ҆́коже ви́дѣ є҆го́же любля́ше І҆и҃съ вослѣ́дъ грядꙋ́ща, вопроша́ше влⷣко: се́йже что̀; а҆́ще хощꙋ̀ речѐ пребыва́ти семꙋ̀ до́ндеже па́ки прїидꙋ̀, что̀ є҆́сть тебѣ̀ дрꙋ́же пе́тре.
items.english_text: After the divine rising, thrice the Lord said unto Peter: "Lovest thou Me?" proposing him as chief shepherd over His sheep. When Peter beheld following him him whom Jesus loved, he questioned the Master: "And what shall this man do?" "If I will," He said, "that he tarry till I come again, what is that to thee, friend Peter?"

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: Ра́дꙋйся вопїе́мъ тѝ прⷭтая бцⷣе, ꙗ҆́кѡ ра́дость возвѣстѝ є҆ѵ́жинꙋ, ско́рбь на ра́дость претворѝ дв҃о, и҆ на́съ ра́дости твоея̀ и҆спо́лни, и҆ свѣ́тлости сн҃а твое́го, всѣ́хъ и҆збра́нныхъ ча́сти сподо́би пре-
items.english_text: Rejoice! we cry unto thee, O all-holy Mother of God, for thou didst announce joy unto Eve, turning sorrow into joy, O Virgin: and fill us with thy joy, and account us worthy of the radiant glory of thy Son and the portion of all the elect, O all-pure one, that we all may cry unto thee: Rejoice, pure Maiden!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: RESURRECTIONAL EXAPOSTILARIA AND ELEVEN EVANGELICAL STICHERA (EOTHINA)
items.slavonic_text: чⷭтая, да всѝ вспїе́мъ тѝ, ра́дꙋйся чи́стая ѿрокови́це.
items.english_text: Manifesting Himself unto the disciples after the resurrection, the Savior gave unto thee, Simon, the pasturing of His sheep as a recompense for love, requiring care of the flock; therefore He said unto thee: "If thou lovest Me, Peter, feed My lambs, feed My sheep." Whereupon, straightway showing his brotherly love, he questioned concerning the other disciple: by whose prayers, O Christ, preserve Thy flock from the wolves that destroy it!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: WEEKDAY TRIADIKA (HYMNS TO THE TRINITY) AND PHOTOGOGIKA (TONES 1–8)
items.slavonic_text: [Ꙗ҆́]вля́я себѐ ᲂу҆ч҃нкѡмъ сп҃съ по воскрⷭнїи* тебѣ̀ си́моне да́лъ є҆́сть є҆́же ѡ҆ ѡ҆вцахъ па́ствꙋ* за любо́вное возда́нїе* ꙗ҆́же ѡ҆ па́ствѣ попече́нїа прося̀* тѣ́мъ тебѣ̀ гла́ше* а҆́ще лю́биши мя̀ пе́тре* пасѝ а҆́гннца моя̑* пасѝ ѡ҆́вца моя̑* ѡ҆́нже а҆́бїе пока́зꙋ́я дрꙋголю́бное* ѡ҆ дрꙋгѡ́мъ ᲂу҆ч҃нцѣ вопроша́ше* є҆́нже мл҃твами хрⷭтѐ, ста́до своѐ сохранѧ́й* ѿ во́лкъ гꙋбѧ́щихъ є҆̀.
items.english_text: *Triadika of the days, which are chanted in the Holy Forty Days and other fasts when Alleluia is chanted; then Triadikon, Tone 1:*

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: WEEKDAY TRIADIKA (HYMNS TO THE TRINITY) AND PHOTOGOGIKA (TONES 1–8)
items.slavonic_text: мꙋ возводи́ми ᲂу҆мꙋ̀, и҆ трист҃ꙋю пѣ́снь трисоста́внаго бж҃тва прїе́мше зарю̀, херꙋвї́мски вопїе́: ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ є҆си бж҃е: застꙋпле́нїемъ безпло́тны твои́х помилꙋ́и на́. Сла́,
items.english_text: In the bodily configurations of the bodiless hosts, being led up in mind to the intelligible and immaterial [^293] mind, and receiving the illumination of the thrice-holy hymn of the tri-hypostatic Godhead, cherubically we cry: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God: through the intercession of Thy bodiless hosts, have mercy on us!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: WEEKDAY TRIADIKA (HYMNS TO THE TRINITY) AND PHOTOGOGIKA (TONES 1–8)
items.slavonic_text: Со всѣ́ми нбⷭными си́лами, херꙋвї́мски и҆́же ввы́шнихъ вопїе́мъ трист҃ꙋю посыла́юще хва́лꙋ: ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ є҆си б҃е: мл҃твами всѣ́хъ ст҃ы́хъ твои́х помя́лꙋй на́. И҆ нн҃ѣ,
items.english_text: With all the heavenly powers, cherubically sending up thrice-holy praise unto Him Who is in the highest, we cry: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God: by the prayers of all Thy saints, have mercy on us!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: WEEKDAY TRIADIKA (HYMNS TO THE TRINITY) AND PHOTOGOGIKA (TONES 1–8)
items.slavonic_text: Воста́вши ѿсна̀ припада́емъ тѝ бл҃же, и҆ а҆́гглскꙋю пѣ́снь вопїе́м тѝ всеси́лне: ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ є҆сѝ бж҃е: бц҃а ра́ди поми́лꙋй на́.
items.english_text: Having risen from sleep, we fall down before Thee, O Good One, and we cry unto Thee the angelic hymn, O Almighty One: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God: for the sake of the Mother of God, have mercy on us!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: WEEKDAY TRIADIKA (HYMNS TO THE TRINITY) AND PHOTOGOGIKA (TONES 1–8)
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же свѣ́тъ возсїя́вый гдⷭи, дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ ᲂу҆чи́сти ѿ вся́каго грѣха̀, застꙋпле́нїемъ безпло́тныхъ твои́хъ поми́лꙋй на́съ.
items.english_text: Thou Who hast shone forth the light, O Lord, cleanse my soul from every sin, and through the intercession of Thy bodiless hosts, have mercy on us.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: WEEKDAY TRIADIKA (HYMNS TO THE TRINITY) AND PHOTOGOGIKA (TONES 1–8)
items.slavonic_text: Несозда́нное є҆́сттво всѣ́х содѣ́телю ᲂу҆стнѣ̑ на́ша ѡ҆́верзи, ꙗ҆́кѡ да возвѣсти́мъ хва́лꙋ
items.english_text: O uncreated Nature, Creator of all, open our lips that we may proclaim Thy praise, crying: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: WEEKDAY TRIADIKA (HYMNS TO THE TRINITY) AND PHOTOGOGIKA (TONES 1–8)
items.slavonic_text: твою́ вопїю́ще: ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ є҆сѝ б҃е. Сла́.
items.english_text: Imitating the powers on high on earth, we offer Thee the triumphal hymn, O Good One: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God: by the prayers of all Thy saints, have mercy on us!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: WEEKDAY TRIADIKA (HYMNS TO THE TRINITY) AND PHOTOGOGIKA (TONES 1–8)
items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнымъ си́ла подо́бящеся на землѝ, побѣ́днꙋю пѣ́снь прино́си тѝ бл҃же: ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ є҆сѝ бж҃е, мл҃твами всѣ́хъ сты́хъ твои́х поми́лꙋй на́съ. И҆ нн҃ѣ.
items.english_text: From the bed and sleep Thou hast raised me up, O Lord; enlighten my mind and heart, and open my lips to hymn Thee, O Holy Trinity: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God: for the sake of the Mother of God, have mercy on us!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: WEEKDAY TRIADIKA (HYMNS TO THE TRINITY) AND PHOTOGOGIKA (TONES 1–8)
items.slavonic_text: Ѽдрѐ и҆ сна̀ воздви́глъ мя̀ є҆сѝ гдⷭи, и҆ ᲂу҆́мъ мо́й просвѣтѝ и҆ срⷣце, и҆ ᲂу҆стнѣ̑ моѝ ѡ҆́верзи, пѣ́ти тя̀ ст҃ая трⷪце: ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ ст҃ъ є҆сѝ бж҃е: бц҃а ра́ди поми́лꙋй на́съ.
items.english_text: Send forth Thy light everlasting, O Lord, and enlighten the secret eyes of my heart: through the intercession of Thy bodiless hosts, have mercy on us.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: WEEKDAY TRIADIKA (HYMNS TO THE TRINITY) AND PHOTOGOGIKA (TONES 1–8)
items.slavonic_text: Свѣ́тъ тво́й присносꙋ́щный поелѝ гдⷭи, и҆ просвѣтѝ ѡ҆́чи та́йнїи срⷣца мое́го: застꙋпле́нїемъ безпло́тныхъ твои́х поми́лꙋй на́.
items.english_text: The unoriginate Father, and the co-unoriginate Son, and the co-eternal Spirit, one Godhead, daring to glorify in cherubic praise, we say: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: WEEKDAY TRIADIKA (HYMNS TO THE TRINITY) AND PHOTOGOGIKA (TONES 1–8)
items.slavonic_text: [Ѻ҆]ц҃а̀ безна́чална, и҆ сн҃а собезнача́лна, и҆ дх҃а соприсносꙋ́щна, бж҃тво̀ є҆ди́но, херꙋвї́мски славосло́вити дерза́юще гле́мъ: ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ є҆сѝ бж҃е. Сла́ва.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: WEEKDAY TRIADIKA (HYMNS TO THE TRINITY) AND PHOTOGOGIKA (TONES 1–8)
items.slavonic_text: Тр҃це є҆диносꙋ́щнаѧ и҆ нераздѣ́лнаѧ, є҆дини́це трисоста́внаѧ, и҆ соприсносꙋ́щнаѧ: тебѣ̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ бг҃ꙋ а҆́гглскꙋю пѣ́снь вопїе́мъ: ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ є҆сѝ бж҃е, мл҃тва́ми всѣ́хъ ст҃ы́хъ твои́хъ поми́лꙋй на́съ. И҆ нн҃ѣ.
items.english_text: O Trinity consubstantial and undivided, Monad tri-hypostatic and co-eternal: unto Thee as God we cry the angelic hymn: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God: by the prayers of all Thy saints, have mercy on us!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: WEEKDAY TRIADIKA (HYMNS TO THE TRINITY) AND PHOTOGOGIKA (TONES 1–8)
items.slavonic_text: Напра́сно сꙋдїѧ̀ прїи́детъ, и҆ кого́ждо дѣѧ́нїа ѡ҆бнажа́тсѧ, но со стра́хомъ возопїи́ дꙋшѐ въ полꙋ́нощи: ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ є҆сѝ бж҃е: мл҃тва́ми бц҃а поми́лꙋй на́съ.
items.english_text: Suddenly the Judge shall come, and each one's deeds shall be laid bare; but with fear cry out in the midnight, O my soul: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God: by the prayers of the Mother of God, have mercy on us!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: WEEKDAY TRIADIKA (HYMNS TO THE TRINITY) AND PHOTOGOGIKA (TONES 1–8)
items.slavonic_text: Послѝ свѣ́тъ тво́й хрⷭтѐ бж҃е, и҆ просвѣти́ срⷣце моѐ: застꙋпле́нїемъ безпло́тныхъ твои́хъ спасѝ мѧ̀.
items.english_text: Send forth Thy light, O Christ God, and enlighten my heart: through the intercession of Thy bodiless hosts, save me.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: WEEKDAY TRIADIKA (HYMNS TO THE TRINITY) AND PHOTOGOGIKA (TONES 1–8)
items.slavonic_text: Безна́чалнаго тѝ ѿц҃а, и҆ тебѐ хрⷭтѐ бж҃е, и҆ прⷭты́й тво́й дх҃ъ, херꙋви́мски славослови́ти дерза́юще гле́мъ: ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ є҆сѝ бж҃е. Сла́ва.
items.english_text: Thine unoriginate Father, and Thee, O Christ God, and Thy Most-Holy Spirit, daring cherubically to glorify, we say: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: WEEKDAY TRIADIKA (HYMNS TO THE TRINITY) AND PHOTOGOGIKA (TONES 1–8)
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чи́ны нн҃ѣ а҆́гглстїи на нб҃се́хъ, и҆ стоя́нїа со стра́хомъ чл҃чскаѧ на землѝ, побѣ́днꙋю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тѝ бл҃же: ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ є҆сѝ бж҃е, мл҃твами всѣ́хъ ст҃ы́хъ твои́хъ поми́лꙋй на́съ. И҆ нн҃ѣ,
items.english_text: As now the angelic ranks in the heavens, and human assemblies with fear upon the earth, we offer Thee the triumphal hymn, O Good One: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God: by the prayers of all Thy saints, have mercy on us!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: WEEKDAY TRIADIKA (HYMNS TO THE TRINITY) AND PHOTOGOGIKA (TONES 1–8)
items.slavonic_text: Мы́сленыхъ твои́хъ слꙋ́гъ, прино́симъ тѝ мертве́ннїи пѣ́снь, дерза́юще гле́мъ: ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, є҆сѝ б҃е, бц҃а ра́ди поми́лꙋй на́съ.
items.english_text: Unto Thy noetic servants, we mortal ones offer Thee hymnody, daring to say: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God: for the sake of the Mother of God, have mercy on us!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: WEEKDAY TRIADIKA (HYMNS TO THE TRINITY) AND PHOTOGOGIKA (TONES 1–8)
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же свѣ́тъ возсїѧ́вый мї́рꙋ своемꙋ̀, во тмѣ̀ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ ѡ҆держи́мꙋ ѿ всѧ́каго грѣха̀ ѡ҆чи́сти: застꙋпле́нїемъ безпло́тныхъ твои́хъ поми́лꙋй на́съ. Тро́ич҃ Гла́съ є҆҃.
items.english_text: Thou Who hast shone forth the light unto Thy world, cleanse my soul held fast in darkness from every sin: through the intercession of Thy bodiless hosts, have mercy on us.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: WEEKDAY TRIADIKA (HYMNS TO THE TRINITY) AND PHOTOGOGIKA (TONES 1–8)
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́нїи вре́мѧ, и҆ мл҃твѣ ча́съ, прилѣ́жно возопїе́мъ є҆ди́номꙋ бг҃ꙋ: ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ є҆си бж҃е. Сла́ва.
items.english_text: *Triadika, Tone 5:* [^295]

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: WEEKDAY TRIADIKA (HYMNS TO THE TRINITY) AND PHOTOGOGIKA (TONES 1–8)
items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆бразова́ти смѣ́юще мы́сленаѧ твоѧ̑
items.english_text: It is the time of singing, and the hour for prayer: fervently let us cry unto the one God: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: WEEKDAY TRIADIKA (HYMNS TO THE TRINITY) AND PHOTOGOGIKA (TONES 1–8)
items.slavonic_text: во́инства, Тр҃це безна́чалнаѧ, ᲂу҆сты̑ недосто́йными вопїе́мъ тѝ: ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ є҆сѝ бж҃е, мл҃твами всѣ́хъ ст҃ы́хъ твои́хъ поми́лꙋй на́съ. И҆ нн҃ѣ.
items.english_text: Daring to emulate Thy noetic armies O unoriginate Trinity, with unworthy lips we cry unto Thee: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God: by the prayers of all Thy saints, have mercy on us!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: WEEKDAY TRIADIKA (HYMNS TO THE TRINITY) AND PHOTOGOGIKA (TONES 1–8)
items.slavonic_text: Во ᲂу҆тро́бꙋ дв҃и́ческꙋю вмѣ́щсѧ, и҆ нѣ́дръ ѿч҃ескихъ не ѿлꙋчсѧ, со а҆́гг҃лы и҆ на́съ прїимѝ хрⷭтѐ бж҃е вопїю́щихъ тѝ: ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ є҆сѝ бж҃е, бц҃а ра́ди поми́лꙋй на́съ.
items.english_text: Contained in the virgin womb, and not parted from the Father's bosom, with the angels receive also us, O Christ God, who cry unto Thee: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God: for the sake of the Mother of God, have mercy on us!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: WEEKDAY TRIADIKA (HYMNS TO THE TRINITY) AND PHOTOGOGIKA (TONES 1–8)
items.slavonic_text: Свѣтода́вче гдⷭи послѝ свѣ́тъ тво́й, и҆ просвѣтѝ срⷣце моѐ, мл҃твами безпло́тныхъ твои́хъ спасѝ мѧ̀. Тро́иченъ Гла́съ ѕ҃.
items.english_text: O Giver of light, Lord, send forth Thy light, and enlighten my heart: by the prayers of Thy bodiless hosts, save me.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: WEEKDAY TRIADIKA (HYMNS TO THE TRINITY) AND PHOTOGOGIKA (TONES 1–8)
items.slavonic_text: Безпло́тными ᲂу҆сты̑, немо́лчными славословлє́нїи, шестокры́лїи пою́тъ тѝ трист҃ꙋю пѣ́снь бж҃е на́шъ, и҆ мы̀ и҆́же на землѝ недосто́йными ᲂу҆стна́ми хвалꙋ̀ тѝ возсыла́емъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ є҆сѝ б҃е. Сла́ва.
items.english_text: With bodiless lips, with unceasing doxologies, the six-winged ones sing unto Thee the thrice-holy hymn, O our God; and we upon the earth with unworthy lips send up praise unto Thee: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: WEEKDAY TRIADIKA (HYMNS TO THE TRINITY) AND PHOTOGOGIKA (TONES 1–8)
items.slavonic_text: Предстоѧ́ще со стра́хомъ херꙋвї́ми, и҆ ᲂу҆жаса́ющесѧ со тре́петомъ серафї́ми, трист҃ꙋю пѣ́снь прино́сѧтъ немо́чнымъ гла́сомъ, сни́миже и҆ мы̀ грѣ́шнїи вопїе́мъ: ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ є҆сѝ бж҃е, мл҃твами всѣ́хъ ст҃ы́хъ твои́хъ поми́лꙋй на́съ. И҆ нн҃ѣ.
items.english_text: Standing before Thee with fear the Cherubim, and dreading with trembling the Seraphim, offer the thrice-holy hymn with unceasing voice; with whom also we sinners cry: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God: by the prayers of all Thy saints, have mercy on us!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: WEEKDAY TRIADIKA (HYMNS TO THE TRINITY) AND PHOTOGOGIKA (TONES 1–8)
items.slavonic_text: Трⷪцꙋ̀ є҆дини́цꙋ бж҃твомъ, несли́ѧнны є҆ди́нство просла́вимъ, и҆ а҆́гглскꙋю пѣ́снь возопїе́мъ: ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ є҆сѝ бж҃е, бц҃а ра́ди поми́лꙋй на́съ. Свѣ́тиленъ Гла́съ, ѕ҃.
items.english_text: The Trinity, a Monad in Godhead, the unconfused Unity let us glorify, and let us cry aloud the angelic hymn: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God: for the sake of the Mother of God, have mercy on us!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: WEEKDAY TRIADIKA (HYMNS TO THE TRINITY) AND PHOTOGOGIKA (TONES 1–8)
items.slavonic_text: Застꙋпле́нїемъ гдⷭи безпло́тныхъ, низпослѝ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ свѣ́тъ тво́й присносꙋ́щный. Тро́ич҃ гла́съ, з҃.
items.english_text: Through the intercession of the bodiless hosts, O Lord, send down upon our souls Thy light everlasting.

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED
items.section: WEEKDAY TRIADIKA (HYMNS TO THE TRINITY) AND PHOTOGOGIKA (TONES 1–8)
items.slavonic_text: Непристꙋ́пный бж҃твомъ, и҆́же во є҆ди́нствѣ трⷪци, серафі́мскꙋю трист҃ꙋю возсыла́юще хвалꙋ̀, и҆ со стра́хомъ вопїе́мъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ є҆сѝ бж҃е. Сла́ва.

items.english_text: Unapproachable in Godhead, Who art in the Unity of the Trinity, sending up the Seraphic thrice-holy praise, with fear we cry: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God!

items.english_text: Having cast off sluggish sleep, O my soul, and amendment toward standing show forth unto the Judge, and with fear cry out: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God: by the prayers of all Thy saints, have mercy on us!

items.office: SATURDAY MATINS: ALL SAINTS, MARTYRS, AND THE DEPARTED

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же вы́шнею си́лою, херꙋвї́мски воспѣва́емый, и҆ бж҃твеною сла́вою ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ поклоне́нїе прїе́мляѧ: прїимѝ и҆ на́съ грѣ́шныхъ со ᲂу҆миле́нїемъ вопїю́щихъ тѝ: ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ є҆сѝ бж҃е, бц҃а ра́ди поми́лꙋй на́съ. Свѣти́ленъ Гла́съ, з҃.
items.english_text: Thou Who by power on high art praised cherubically, and in divine glory receivest worship from angels: receive also us sinners who cry unto Thee with compunction: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God: for the sake of the Mother of God, have mercy on us!

items.english_text: [Lower Outer Binding Board: Contemporary blind-tooled calfskin binding of the first third of the 17th century (dark brown calf leather over bevelled wooden boards). Around the perimeter of the board runs a blind-tooled framework: an outer double-fillet frame and an inner ornamental frame rolled with a Renaissance palmette and foliate roll. The central panel is unadorned, displaying natural age patina, scuffs, surface abrasions, and isolated minor worming. On the left (fore-edge) of the board are preserved the brass catches and leather strap remnants of two original clasps. On the right edge near the lower spine corner are visible the remains of an early paper shelfmark label. The leather is turned in over the inner board edges with neat diagonal mitered folds at the corners.[^299]]
